loaTrackingNote.title: Tracking Loa Precursors
loaTrackingNote.content:
**Papa Legba's Precursor**: "5+ Essence generated this combat" tracks your TOTAL Essence generated across the entire fight — not your current Essence. This is a running total that never decreases, even when you spend Essence. Keep a separate counter or tally mark for each Essence point generated.

**Baron Samedi's Precursor**: "3+ enemies currently cursed" counts only living enemies on the battlefield who have your curse active RIGHT NOW. Cursed enemies who die no longer count. Plan your curses to ensure enough remain alive when you invoke.

**Simbi's Precursor**: "1+ ally below half HP" is checked at the time of invocation. If all allies heal above half before you invoke, the precursor is no longer met.

**Erzulie's Precursor**: "2+ allies within 15ft of you" is based on physical positioning. Communicate with your party to cluster before invoking.

**Ogoun's Precursor**: "Poison active on any target" means your poison buff is currently applied to your weapon or a poison debuff is active on any enemy. Venomous Sting (Level 1) and Venomous Weapon (Level 5) both satisfy this.

strategicConsiderations.title: The Ritual — Combat Phase Tactics
strategicConsiderations.content:
**Phase 1: The Foundation (Rounds 1-3)**:
Curse high-priority targets immediately. Each curse is a dual investment: +1 Essence on application and +3 when the enemy dies. Place a totem for area control. Apply weapon poison to enable Ogoun's precursor. Your goal is to reach 5+ Essence while establishing curses on 2+ enemies.

**Phase 2: Precursor Building (Rounds 4-6)**:
Start checking which loa you can invoke. Scan the battlefield for precursor conditions:
- **Simbi (5 Essence)**: Is any ally below half HP? If not, you may need to let damage happen — resist the urge to heal preemptively.
- **Erzulie (7 Essence)**: Are 2+ allies near you? Communicate positioning with your party.
- **Papa Legba (6 Essence)**: Have you generated 5+ Essence this fight? This one tracks itself — you either have it or you don't.
- **Ogoun (8 Essence)**: Is poison active on any target? Apply weapon poison early to enable this.
- **Baron Samedi (10 Essence)**: Are 3+ enemies cursed? This is your ultimate — requires the most setup.

**Phase 3: The Invocation (Rounds 7+)**:
Invoke the highest-impact loa available. Baron Samedi with 3+ cursed enemies is game-ending (14d6+spirit to all cursed). Ogoun turns you into a damage powerhouse. Erzulie can save the party from a wipe with mass healing and armor. Time your invocation for maximum impact — don't waste Baron Samedi on a single remaining enemy.

**The Curse-First Philosophy**:
Curses are your highest-priority action in round 1. A cursed enemy is worth +1 Essence now and +3 Essence later (6 Essence total from one enemy). This means 2-3 cursed enemies dying = 12-18 Essence, which is enough for any loa. Curse broadly, then focus fire on cursed targets to trigger the essence cascade.

**Loa Choice Priority**:
1. **Baron Samedi** (10): If 3+ enemies are cursed and you have the Essence, this is almost always the right call. The AoE devastation ends fights.
2. **Erzulie** (7): If the party is taking heavy damage and allies are clustered, the mass heal + armor + fear immunity is a clutch save.
3. **Ogoun** (8): If you need single-target damage and poison is active, the attack buff + fire damage + physical resistance makes you a frontline threat.
4. **Simbi** (5): If a single ally is critical, the targeted heal is efficient. Cheap and reliable.
5. **Papa Legba** (6): The teleport is situational but powerful for repositioning the entire party.

**The Spec Factor**:
Specializations reduce loa costs and relax precursors. A Bokor with Baron Samedi at 8 Essence and only 2 cursed enemies needed can invoke much earlier than a base Witch Doctor. Factor your spec discounts into your planning.

**Worked Example (Round 5, 8 Essence, 2 Enemies Cursed)**:
- **Option A** — Simbi (5 Essence, ally below half HP): Reliable heal, drops you to 3 Essence. Safe but small.
- **Option B** — Erzulie (7 Essence, allies grouped): Mass heal + armor. Drops you to 1 Essence. Party-saving but leaves you empty.
- **Option C** — Curse a third enemy, wait for Baron Samedi: Higher risk but massive payout. If the fight will last 3+ more rounds, this is often the best play.
- **Best default**: If the party is healthy, Option C. If someone is critical, Option B.

playingInPerson.title: Playing Witch Doctor In Person
playingInPerson.subtitle: Physical Tracking for Tabletop Play
playingInPerson.content:
The Witch Doctor is the most atmospheric class at the table. Skull beads, curse markers, totem miniatures, and the dramatic token dump when invoking a loa create a deeply immersive voodoo experience that the whole table will feel.

**Required Materials**:
- **15 Purple Tokens or Skull Beads** — Voodoo Essence. Add as you generate, remove when invoking.
- **Curse Markers** — Small skull tokens to place on cursed enemy miniatures.
- **Totem Miniatures** — Small tokens or minis to mark placed totems on the grid.
- **Loa Reference Card** — Printed card showing all 5 loa: cost, precursor condition, and effect summary.
- **Voodoo Doll Prop** (Optional) — A small figure placed on the table for flavor.

**Tracking Essence (Token Bowl Method)**:
Keep purple tokens in a small bowl or pouch. Add one for each Essence gained. When you invoke a loa, physically remove the tokens from the bowl and place them in a "spent" pile. The sound of tokens hitting the bowl builds anticipation. The dramatic moment of dumping 10 tokens for Baron Samedi creates a table-wide moment.

**Tracking Curses**:
Place a small skull token on each cursed enemy's miniature. At a glance, you and the DM can count how many enemies are cursed — this is critical for Baron Samedi's precursor (3+ cursed). When a cursed enemy dies, remove the skull and add 3 Essence tokens.

**Quick Reference**:
```
ESSENCE GENERATION (Max 15):
  Cast Curse: +1    | Apply Poison: +1    | Place Totem: +1
  Apply Poison: +1 | Place Totem: +1
  Complete Ritual: +2 | Defeat Cursed Enemy: +3
  (Per-action cap: 5 Essence max, except cursed enemy defeats)

LOA INVOCATIONS (Cost + Precursor):
  Simbi (5):         1+ ally below half HP
  Papa Legba (6):    5+ Essence generated this combat
  Erzulie (7):       2+ allies within 15ft of you
  Ogoun (8):         Poison active on any target
  Baron Samedi (10): 3+ enemies currently cursed

SPEC DISCOUNTS:
  Bokor: Baron 8 (2 cursed) | Mambo: Erzulie 5, Simbi 3
  Houngan: Ogoun 6, Legba 4
```

**The Physical Hacks**:
- **The Curse Spread**: When you curse a new enemy, physically walk your curse token to their mini and place it. The movement draws table attention and makes the DM aware.
- **Totem Placement**: Use a distinct mini or token for each totem type. Place it physically on the grid square so everyone knows the area of effect.
- **Loa Invocation Ritual**: When you invoke a loa, stand up, announce the loa's name, and remove the Essence tokens one by one while counting down. Make it ceremonial — the table will remember it.
- **Voodoo Doll**: Keep a small doll or figure near your character sheet. Point to it when describing loa effects for flavor.

**Pro Tips**:
- Communicate your precursor status to the party: "I have 8 Essence and poison is active — I can invoke Ogoun next turn if we need damage." This lets the party plan around your invocation timing.
- Curse broadly early, then focus fire. The curse-first philosophy means your early turns are about spreading debuffs, not maximizing damage. Your damage comes later when Essence pays off.
- Track which enemies are cursed on your character sheet too. If a skull token gets knocked off an enemy mini, your sheet backup prevents arguments.
- If you are Mambo spec, tell the party when you invoke Erzulie (now only 5 Essence). "Erzulie is up — everyone group near me for the heal." The cheaper cost means you can invoke more often, changing your role from occasional nuker to frequent support.

shadow_citadel.description: You can resist two damage types instead of one. When both resistances trigger on the same hit, the attacker takes 1d8 necrotic damage per rank from falling debris.

shadow_citadel.name: Void Portcullis
shadow_citadel.description: Shadow Shield can be cast as a reaction and absorbs 50% more damage. When Shadow Shield breaks, deal 2d6 necrotic damage per rank to all enemies within 10 feet as the gates slam shut.

shadow_citadel.name: Eternal Keep
shadow_citadel.description: At 40+ DRP, you become immune to critical hits. Your regeneration creates a 10-foot aura that heals allies for 1d4 HP per rank at the start of their turn.

shadow_citadel.name: Reflective Towers
shadow_citadel.description: When you resist damage, the attacker must succeed on a DC 13 + rank Agility save or take necrotic damage equal to half the resisted damage per rank from tower reflections.

shadow_citadel.name: Abyssal Foundations
shadow_citadel.description: Your resistances become immunity to chosen damage types. When an immune damage type would affect you, gain 1d6 DRP per rank instead as the foundations absorb the energy.

shadow_citadel.name: Citadel Lord
shadow_citadel.description: Dark Rebirth revives you with full HP and maximum DRP. You gain +2 to all saves per rank for 1 minute after rebirth, as the citadel rebuilds itself around you.

shadow_citadel.name: Siege Engines
shadow_citadel.description: Shadow Shield absorbs all damage from one source per rank. When used, all enemies within 15 feet have disadvantage on attack rolls against you for 1 round.

shadow_citadel.name: Impenetrable Palace
shadow_citadel.description: For 1 minute per rank, all damage you take is converted to healing at a 1:1 ratio — you still generate DRP from this damage. Costs all remaining DRP. Draw a card each turn while active — face cards grant +1d8 temporary HP.

shadow_citadel.name: Shadow Sovereign
shadow_citadel.description: Enemies within 20 feet have their damage reduced by 1d8 per rank. Allies gain +1d8 temporary HP per rank from the sovereign's blessing.

shadow_citadel.name: Cataclysmic Siege
shadow_citadel.description: Spend all DRP to unleash the citadel's siege weapons — deal 4d12 necrotic damage per rank in a 30-foot radius. For the next round, all damage you take converts to DRP at a 1:1 ratio instead of 4:1.

shadow_citadel.name: Eternal Fortress
shadow_citadel.description: When you would die, the citadel automatically triggers Dark Rebirth as if you had maximum DRP. Draw a card when this triggers — if it's a face card, you revive with full HP instead.

suffering_weaver.name: Suffering Nexus
suffering_weaver.description: Deal +1d4 necrotic damage per rank with weapon attacks. Gain +1 DRP per rank whenever you deal necrotic damage.

suffering_weaver.name: Agony Threads
suffering_weaver.description: Wraith Strike heals you for an additional 1d4 HP per rank. You can spend DRP to empower weapon attacks with necrotic damage.

suffering_weaver.name: Pain Conversion
suffering_weaver.description: Convert HP to DRP more efficiently: 3 HP = 1 DRP per rank (minimum 2 HP). When you convert HP, gain resistance to necrotic damage for 1 round.

suffering_weaver.name: Soul Bindings
suffering_weaver.description: Enemies you damage with necrotic effects take 1d6 necrotic damage per rank at the start of their turn as the web tightens. When you heal, steal 1d4 HP per rank from the nearest enemy through the bindings.

suffering_weaver.name: Weave Generator
suffering_weaver.description: Gain 1 DRP per 3 necrotic damage dealt per rank. When you reach 30+ DRP, your Wraith Strike has advantage on attack rolls as the web guides your strikes.

suffering_weaver.name: Torment Overflow
suffering_weaver.description: Your healing from Wraith Strike increases by 50%. When you heal above maximum HP, excess becomes temporary HP equal to the overflow per rank.

suffering_weaver.name: Death Harvester
suffering_weaver.description: When enemies die within 30 feet, gain 1d6 DRP per rank as their essence flows through the web. You can spend 10 DRP to automatically kill enemies below 25% HP.

suffering_weaver.name: Necrotic Tapestry
suffering_weaver.description: Wraith Strike can be used at range (30 feet) and deals maximum damage on critical hits. Draw a card when casting — hearts double the necrotic damage as the tapestry amplifies your power.

suffering_weaver.name: Blood Ritual
suffering_weaver.description: Spend HP instead of DRP for abilities: 4 HP = 1 DRP per rank. When you do this, gain +1d8 bonus necrotic damage per rank for 1 round as blood weaves through the pattern.

suffering_weaver.name: Vitality Drain
suffering_weaver.description: Allies within 15 feet heal for 1d4 HP per rank when you deal necrotic damage. You gain +1 to attack rolls per rank against enemies ensnared in your web.

suffering_weaver.name: Dark Pact
suffering_weaver.description: Dark Rebirth costs 50% less DRP but you must sacrifice 2d10 HP from nearby allies. In return, gain +2 to all abilities per rank for 1 minute.

suffering_weaver.name: Soul Consumer
suffering_weaver.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, gain maximum HP equal to their CR per rank, up to 20 HP.

suffering_weaver.name: Endless Weaving
suffering_weaver.description: You no longer have a DRP maximum as the web expands infinitely. Roll a d20 each time you deal damage: on 15+ per rank, gain an additional action on your next turn.

suffering_weaver.name: Soul Shattering
suffering_weaver.description: Target one creature. Deal 3d12 necrotic damage per rank and heal for 50% of damage dealt as their soul unravels. Costs 25 DRP.

suffering_weaver.name: Living Tapestry
suffering_weaver.description: Enemies you kill become woven constructs. Control up to 1d4 constructs per rank, each with 2d6 HP and necrotic attacks that spread the web.

suffering_weaver.name: Immortal Weaver
suffering_weaver.description: When you would reach 0 HP, enter Woven State — remain at 1 HP and regenerate 5d10 HP per turn for 3 rounds. During Woven State, you take double damage but generate double DRP from each hit.

doom_bringer.name: Doom Harbinger
doom_bringer.description: Deal +1d4 necrotic damage per rank to attackers who hit you in melee. Gain +1 to your next attack roll per rank whenever you take 20+ damage in a single hit.

doom_bringer.name: Vengeance Fissures
doom_bringer.description: Attackers take an additional 1d4 necrotic damage per rank as cracks appear beneath them. Necrotic Aura costs 2 less DRP and lasts 1 additional round per rank.

doom_bringer.name: Wrathful Resurrection
doom_bringer.description: Dark Rebirth grants +1 to attack and damage rolls per rank for 1 minute. You can choose to unleash necrotic damage equal to your DRP when you rebirth.

doom_bringer.name: Retribution Strikes
doom_bringer.description: When you take damage, your next attack deals +1d6 necrotic damage per rank. If the triggering attacker is your target, gain advantage on the attack.

doom_bringer.name: Apocalyptic Echoes
doom_bringer.description: When you use Wraith Strike, all enemies within 10 feet take 1d4 necrotic damage per rank from echoing cracks. This echo damage doubles if Wraith Strike deals a critical hit.

doom_bringer.name: Doom Tempest
doom_bringer.description: Necrotic Aura deals 1d4 necrotic damage per rank per turn to affected enemies. Enemies in the aura have disadvantage on concentration saves as reality frays.

doom_bringer.name: Wrathful Rebuke
doom_bringer.description: When hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to attack the attacker through a fracture. Deal +1d8 necrotic damage per rank and they have disadvantage on their next attack.

doom_bringer.name: Vengeful Manifestations
doom_bringer.description: Dark Rebirth summons 1d4 spectral warriors per rank with 2d6 HP each that attack your enemies for 1 round.

doom_bringer.name: Aura of Ruin
doom_bringer.description: Enemies within 15 feet provoke opportunity attacks from you through fractures. When they move, they take 1d8 necrotic damage per rank as cracks erupt beneath them.

doom_bringer.name: Eternal Curse
doom_bringer.description: Enemies that kill you are marked with doom fractures. They take 2d10 necrotic damage per rank at the start of each turn until they die or you are defeated.

doom_bringer.name: Final Reckoning
doom_bringer.description: Track damage taken from each enemy. Once per round per rank, deal necrotic damage equal to the damage they dealt you as cracks swallow them.

doom_bringer.name: Apocalypse Bringer
doom_bringer.description: Necrotic Aura causes enemies to take maximum damage from your attacks. When they die in the aura, their bodies explode for 2d8 necrotic damage per rank in a 10-foot radius.

doom_bringer.name: Doom Shield
doom_bringer.description: Redirect any attack against an ally through a fracture to yourself. The attacker takes 1d12 necrotic damage per rank and falls into a temporary fracture.

doom_bringer.name: Cataclysmic Wrath
doom_bringer.description: When you take damage, all enemies within 20 feet take necrotic damage equal to half the damage you took per rank through massive fractures. This damage cannot be reduced or resisted.

doom_bringer.name: Armageddon
doom_bringer.description: Spend all DRP to trigger global apocalypse. All enemies that damaged you this combat take 3d12 necrotic damage per rank as reality fractures around them. Flip a coin — on heads, they are also stunned for 1 round.

doom_bringer.name: Eternal Doom
doom_bringer.description: Enemies that move more than 10 feet away from you are slowed and take 4d12 necrotic damage per rank. Flip a coin — on heads, they are also pulled 10 feet back toward you as fractures drag at their feet.

colossal_strength.name: Tectonic Core
colossal_strength.description: The earth's fury burns within you. Deal +1d6 damage per rank with Strength-based attacks. When you hit with a melee attack, roll a d6: on 6, cause a minor earthquake in 10-foot radius.

colossal_strength.name: Seismic Force
colossal_strength.description: Your attacks create shockwaves. Deal an additional 1d4 thunder damage per rank to all enemies within 5 feet of your target. You can spend 1 ki point to make a Strength attack as a 1 action point.

colossal_strength.name: Tremor Strike
colossal_strength.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you can cause a tremor. The target and all creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone.

colossal_strength.name: Continental Force
colossal_strength.description: Your carrying capacity doubles per rank. You have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. Large or smaller creatures have disadvantage on attacks against you.

colossal_strength.name: Mountain Fist
colossal_strength.description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage per rank and count as magical. You can make unarmed strikes as a 1 action point.

colossal_strength.name: Earthshatter
colossal_strength.description: Once per short rest, you can slam the ground, dealing 2d8 thunder damage per rank in a 20-foot radius. Creatures must succeed on a Strength save or be stunned until the start of your next turn.

colossal_strength.name: Abyssal Might
colossal_strength.description: You gain resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Your movement speed increases by 10 feet per rank, and you can move through difficult terrain without penalty.

colossal_strength.name: Titanic Fury
colossal_strength.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, you can move up to your speed as a reaction and make one melee attack against another target within range.

colossal_strength.name: Geological Rage
colossal_strength.description: While raging, your Strength attacks deal an additional 1d6 thunder damage per rank, and you can use Strength instead of Constitution for your rage saves.

colossal_strength.name: Summit Dominance
colossal_strength.description: You can jump triple your normal distance, and you have advantage on Athletics checks. Creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you.

colossal_strength.name: Colossus Strike
colossal_strength.description: Once per turn when you critically hit, you can make an additional attack as a 1 action point. This attack deals maximum damage.

colossal_strength.name: Everest Fury
colossal_strength.description: Your Strength score increases by 2 per rank (maximum 24). You can use your action to enter a state of titanic rage for 1 minute, during which you deal double damage with Strength attacks.

colossal_strength.name: Continental Cataclysm
colossal_strength.description: Ultimate ability: Spend all ki points to unleash a cataclysm. All creatures in a 30-foot radius take 4d12 thunder damage per rank and must succeed on a Strength save or be stunned for 1 minute.

colossal_strength.name: Tectonic Supremacy
colossal_strength.description: You become a living embodiment of earth's power. You are immune to being moved against your will, and your attacks can shatter magical barriers. Your presence causes minor earthquakes in a 100-foot radius.

earth_dominion.name: Mineral Core
earth_dominion.description: The earth's minerals flow through your veins. You can speak Terran, and you have darkvision out to 120 feet. You gain proficiency in Nature and Survival checks related to stone and metal.

earth_dominion.name: Ore Sense
earth_dominion.description: You can detect metal and stone deposits within 60 feet per rank. You can cast Identify on metal or stone objects at will, and you gain advantage on checks to find hidden ore deposits.

earth_dominion.name: Stone Shaping
earth_dominion.description: You can shape stone and metal as if using a mold earth spell, but with a range of 30 feet and affecting up to 10 cubic feet per rank. This ability recharges after a short rest.

earth_dominion.name: Metal Skin
earth_dominion.description: Your skin becomes reinforced with living metal. You gain +1 armor per rank, and you have resistance to poison damage. You are immune to disease.

earth_dominion.name: Crystal Armor
earth_dominion.description: You can grow crystal spikes from your body. Once per turn when a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 1d6 piercing damage per rank. You can retract the spikes as a 1 action point.

earth_dominion.name: Geode Eruption
earth_dominion.description: You can cause crystals to erupt from the ground. Choose a point within 60 feet; creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 piercing damage per rank and must succeed on an Agility save or be restrained.

earth_dominion.name: Earthbind Totem
earth_dominion.description: You can cast Earthbind at will, and flying creatures within 30 feet have their flying speed reduced by 20 feet per rank. You can burrow through stone and metal at half your normal speed.

earth_dominion.name: Quake Lance
earth_dominion.description: You can launch a lance of stone and metal. Make a ranged spell attack; on hit, the target takes 3d6 piercing damage per rank and must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked back 10 feet.

earth_dominion.name: Mineral Mastery
earth_dominion.description: You gain immunity to being petrified and resistance to acid damage. You can cast Stoneskin on yourself at will, and the spell lasts until you dismiss it.

earth_dominion.name: Diamond Hardness
earth_dominion.description: You become immune to critical hits and have advantage on saving throws against being petrified or turned to stone. Your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d8 force damage per rank.

earth_dominion.name: Terraform
earth_dominion.description: You can reshape the battlefield. Choose a 30-foot radius area; you can raise or lower the ground by up to 10 feet per rank, creating difficult terrain or barriers as you wish.

earth_dominion.name: Gemstone Fury
earth_dominion.description: Your attacks cause gems to erupt from wounds. When you hit with a melee attack, the target takes an additional 2d6 piercing damage per rank from embedded gem shards.

earth_dominion.name: Earthen Apotheosis
earth_dominion.description: Ultimate ability: Transform into a being of living earth and metal for 1 minute. You gain 50 temporary hit points per rank, immunity to all damage except psychic, and can cast Wall of Stone at will.

earth_dominion.name: Mineral Supremacy
earth_dominion.description: You become the living embodiment of earth's mineral wealth. You can control all stone and metal within 1 mile, and creatures of earth and stone obey your commands. You are immune to all earth-based magic.

strain_endurance.name: Muscle Core
strain_endurance.description: Your body is forged for endurance. You gain +1 Constitution per rank (maximum 24). You have advantage on Constitution saving throws and can hold your breath for 1 hour.

strain_endurance.name: Adrenaline Rush
strain_endurance.description: When you take damage, you gain 1d6 temporary hit points per rank. Additionally, your movement speed increases by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

strain_endurance.name: Pain Threshold
strain_endurance.description: You can ignore the effects of exhaustion for 1 hour per rank. During this time, you have resistance to poison and psychic damage.

strain_endurance.name: Endurance Training
strain_endurance.description: You can carry 50 pounds more per rank without penalty. You have advantage on Athletics checks made to climb, swim, or lift heavy objects.

strain_endurance.name: Strain Recovery
strain_endurance.description: At the start of each turn, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier per rank. This healing increases to 2x your modifier when you have half or fewer hit points.

strain_endurance.name: Overexertion
strain_endurance.description: Once per short rest, you can push beyond your limits. For 1 minute, your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 2 per rank, but you take 1d6 necrotic damage at the end of each turn.

strain_endurance.name: Stress Fracture
strain_endurance.description: When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8 per rank. If you reduce the damage to 0, you gain advantage on your next attack.

strain_endurance.name: Breaking Point
strain_endurance.description: When you reach 0 hit points, you can continue fighting. You have 1 hit point per rank remaining and can take actions normally, but you die if you take any damage before the end of your next turn.

strain_endurance.name: Adaptive Metabolism
strain_endurance.description: You can survive without food or water for 1 week per rank. You gain resistance to cold and fire damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against environmental hazards.

strain_endurance.name: Peak Conditioning
strain_endurance.description: You can take the Dash action as a 1 action point, and you don't suffer penalties from difficult terrain. Your hit point maximum increases by 10 per rank.

strain_endurance.name: Unbreakable
strain_endurance.description: You are immune to the frightened and charmed conditions. You have advantage on saving throws against being stunned or paralyzed.

strain_endurance.name: Titanic Endurance
strain_endurance.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2 per rank (maximum 24). You can use your action to enter a state of unbreakable endurance for 1 minute, during which you are immune to all conditions and damage is reduced by 5.

strain_endurance.name: Berserker Rage
strain_endurance.description: Ultimate ability: Enter a berserker rage for 1 minute. You deal maximum damage with all attacks, have advantage on all attacks, and can move through creatures' spaces, but take 2d6 damage at the start of each turn.

strain_endurance.name: Infinite Endurance
strain_endurance.description: You transcend the limits of mortal flesh. You no longer age, you are immune to all conditions and environmental damage, and you can survive indefinitely without food, water, or air.

venomancer.name: Venomous Core
venomancer.description: Your body becomes a reservoir of deadly toxins. Gain +1d6 poison damage per rank to weapon attacks. When you take damage, you can spend 1 reaction to secrete venom that deals 1d8 poison damage per rank to adjacent enemies.

venomancer.name: Venom Channels
venomancer.description: Your toxins flow through specialized channels. Poison effects you apply have advantage on saves and last 2 additional rounds per rank. Enemies poisoned by you take 1d4 poison damage per rank at the start of their turns.

venomancer.name: Neurotoxin Channels
venomancer.description: Your venom affects the nervous system. Poisoned enemies have disadvantage on attack rolls and skill checks. Critical hits with poison weapons apply the stunned condition for 1 round per rank.

venomancer.name: Hemotoxin Network
venomancer.description: Your toxins attack the bloodstream. Poisoned enemies take maximum poison damage from your effects. When you poison an enemy, adjacent enemies take 1d6 poison damage per rank.

venomancer.name: Toxin Mastery
venomancer.description: You become a master of all poisons. All poison damage you deal is doubled. You can apply two different poison effects to the same weapon. Poison immunity grants you advantage on all saves.

venomancer.name: Cytotoxin Network
venomancer.description: Your toxins destroy cells at a molecular level. Poisoned enemies cannot regenerate hit points. When a poisoned enemy dies, it explodes in a 10-foot radius, dealing 2d8 poison damage per rank to nearby enemies.

venomancer.name: Lethal Injection
venomancer.description: Your venom becomes instantly lethal. Once per turn when you hit with a poison weapon, you can inject a lethal dose. Target takes 4d10 poison damage immediately and is poisoned for 1 minute per rank.

venomancer.name: Toxin Synthesis
venomancer.description: You can synthesize any poison instantly. You know all poison recipes and can create custom poisons with any combination of effects. Poisons you create have +2 to their save DCs per rank.

venomancer.name: Venom Cloud
venomancer.description: You can exhale a cloud of deadly venom. Create a 30-foot radius cloud centered on you. All enemies in the cloud take 3d8 poison damage per rank and are poisoned for 3 rounds.

venomancer.name: Apex Predator
venomancer.description: You become the ultimate venomous predator. All creatures within 30 feet take 2d6 poison damage per rank at the start of their turns if they are below half health. You are immune to all poisons and diseases.

venomancer.name: Toxin Overload
venomancer.description: Your venom overwhelms all defenses. Poison effects you apply ignore poison immunity and resistance. Enemies cannot be immune to your poisons, and resistance is reduced to half effectiveness.

venomancer.name: Toxic Nova
venomancer.description: Unleash a nova of pure venom. All enemies within 50 feet take 6d12 poison damage per rank. Poisoned enemies take double damage and are stunned for 1 minute. You are immune to all effects for the duration.

venomancer.name: Toxin God
venomancer.description: You transcend into a being of pure venom. You can cast Toxic Nova at will, all your attacks apply lethal poison automatically, and enemies within 100 feet cannot heal while poisoned by you.

venomancer.name: Toxic Ascension
venomancer.description: You become living venom incarnate. All damage you deal becomes poison damage, enemies cannot survive being poisoned by you, and you can control all poisons and toxins within 1 mile.

gadgeteer.name: Mechanical Core
gadgeteer.description: Your body houses intricate machinery. Gain proficiency with all tools and advantage on checks to repair or modify mechanical devices. You can spend 1 action point to deploy a simple contraption.

gadgeteer.name: Spring Mechanism
gadgeteer.description: Your gadgets become spring-loaded. Contraptions you deploy have +10 feet of trigger range per rank and can be triggered as reactions. You gain +1 to initiative rolls.

gadgeteer.name: Power Cell
gadgeteer.description: Your gadgets draw power from your life force. Contraptions deal +1d6 damage per rank and can be overcharged for double damage (but break after one use).

gadgeteer.name: Trap Matrix
gadgeteer.description: Your traps form a deadly network. When one trap triggers, all traps within 20 feet have advantage on their next trigger. You can have up to 6 active contraptions per rank.

gadgeteer.name: Device Mastery
gadgeteer.description: You become a master of all mechanical devices. You can modify any non-magical device or weapon as an action. Modified items gain +2 to attack/damage rolls and can have one additional property.

gadgeteer.name: Explosive Array
gadgeteer.description: Your explosives become devastating. Explosive contraptions deal +2d6 fire damage per rank in +10 foot radius. Enemies in the blast radius are pushed back 10 feet.

gadgeteer.name: Precision Engineering
gadgeteer.description: Your contraptions become surgically precise. All contraptions ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Enemies cannot gain advantage on saves against your contraptions.

gadgeteer.name: Automation Core
gadgeteer.description: Your gadgets operate autonomously. Contraptions can move 30 feet per round and can attack or activate independently. You can command up to 3 contraptions per rank as a 1 action point.

gadgeteer.name: Chain Reaction
gadgeteer.description: Your contraptions create devastating chain reactions. When a contraption triggers, it can cause up to 2 other contraptions within 30 feet to trigger immediately, dealing full damage.

gadgeteer.name: Field Generator
gadgeteer.description: You can create force fields with your gadgets. Create a 20-foot radius field that blocks projectiles and forces. The field lasts 1 minute per rank and can be moved as an action.

gadgeteer.name: Master Inventor
gadgeteer.description: You can invent any mechanical device. Create custom contraptions with any combination of effects. Custom contraptions have +2 to all effects and cannot be dispelled by non-magical means.

gadgeteer.name: Swarm Intelligence
gadgeteer.description: Your contraptions develop hive mind intelligence. All your contraptions share senses within 100 feet and can coordinate attacks. Each contraption gains +2 armor and can take reactions.

gadgeteer.name: Mechanical God
gadgeteer.description: You transcend into a being of pure machinery. You can cast any contraption effect at will, all mechanical devices obey your commands, and you can rebuild destroyed contraptions instantly.

gadgeteer.name: Technological Singularity
gadgeteer.description: You become living technology incarnate. All machines within 1 mile are under your control, you can create any device instantly, and your contraptions cannot be destroyed by any means.

saboteur.name: Disruption Core
saboteur.description: Your presence sows chaos and disorder. Enemies within 30 feet have disadvantage on concentration saves per rank. You can spend 1 action point to create a zone of confusion in a 10-foot radius.

saboteur.name: Electromagnetic Interference
saboteur.description: Your sabotage creates electronic chaos. Magical devices within 20 feet malfunction, requiring a DC 15 Intelligence save per rank to function. Spells targeting you have disadvantage.

saboteur.name: Psychological Warfare
saboteur.description: Your sabotage breaks minds before bodies. Enemies affected by your abilities have disadvantage on Spirit saves and cannot benefit from morale bonuses. Fear effects last twice as long.

saboteur.name: System Failure
saboteur.description: Your sabotage causes cascading failures. When you disable an enemy ability, all similar abilities are also disabled for 1 round per rank. Critical hits with sabotage effects affect all enemies within 15 feet.

saboteur.name: Debuff Mastery
saboteur.description: You become a master of weakening enemies. All debuffs you apply cannot be dispelled by spells of 5th level or lower. Enemies affected by multiple debuffs take 1d6 psychic damage per debuff per rank.

saboteur.name: Morale Breaker
saboteur.description: Your sabotage destroys enemy resolve. Enemies you debuff cannot benefit from bardic inspiration or similar morale effects. Affected enemies have disadvantage on death saves.

saboteur.name: Total Shutdown
saboteur.description: You can completely disable an enemy. Target creature cannot take actions or reactions for 2 rounds per rank. During this time, they have vulnerability to all damage and cannot be healed.

saboteur.name: Chaos Engine
saboteur.description: Your sabotage creates unpredictable chaos. When you apply a debuff, roll a d6: 1-2 (empower debuff), 3-4 (random additional effect), 5-6 (debuff affects all enemies within 20 feet).

saboteur.name: Pandemonium
saboteur.description: Your presence creates total disorder. Enemies within 30 feet cannot benefit from flanking, pack tactics, or coordinated attacks. Allies of affected enemies have disadvantage on attacks.

saboteur.name: Reality Glitch
saboteur.description: Your sabotage warps reality itself. Enemies you debuff have their attacks miss 25% of the time per rank, regardless of modifiers. They cannot critically hit while affected.

saboteur.name: Chaos Lord
saboteur.description: You become the embodiment of disorder. You can apply any debuff effect at will to enemies within 60 feet. Debuffs you apply are permanent until dispelled by a wish spell or similar magic.

saboteur.name: System Crash
saboteur.description: Trigger a total system failure in reality. All enemies within 50 feet are stunned for 1 minute per rank. During this time, they cannot take actions, reactions, or 1 action points.

saboteur.name: Chaos God
saboteur.description: You ascend to godhood through pure disruption. You can cast System Crash at will, all creatures within 100 feet cannot benefit from any beneficial effects, and reality warps around your whims.

saboteur.name: Chaos Ascension
saboteur.description: You become living chaos incarnate. All order ceases to exist around you, enemies cannot coordinate actions, beneficial magic fails automatically, and you can unravel any effect with a thought.

inferno.name: Burst Mastery
inferno.description: Rank 1: Fire spells have +5 ft range. Rank 2: Fire spells have +10 ft range. Rank 3: Fire spells have +10 ft range and ignore half cover. Rank 4: Fire spells have +15 ft range and ignore half cover. Rank 5: Fire spells have +15 ft range and ignore half and three-quarters cover.

inferno.name: Critical Blast
inferno.description: Rank 1: Fire spells can be cast as reactions when you take fire damage. Rank 2: Fire spells can be cast as reactions when you take fire damage, and deal +2 fire damage. Rank 3: Fire spells can be cast as reactions when you take fire damage, deal +2 fire damage, and have +5 ft range. Rank 4: Fire spells can be cast as reactions when you take fire damage, deal +2 fire damage, have +5 ft range, and can be cast through allies.

inferno.name: Rapid Ascent
inferno.description: Rank 1: You can spend 1 Action Point to reduce your Inferno Level by 1. Rank 2: You can spend 1 Action Point to reduce your Inferno Level by 1d3. Rank 3: You can spend 1 Action Point to reduce your Inferno Level by 1d4.

inferno.name: Inner Fire
inferno.description: Rank 1: You have resistance to fire damage. Rank 2: You have resistance to fire damage and can spend 1 Action Point to extinguish flames affecting you. Rank 3: You have resistance to fire damage, can spend 1 Action Point to extinguish flames affecting you, and take 2 less damage from Inferno drawbacks. Rank 4: You have resistance to fire damage, can spend 1 Action Point to extinguish flames affecting you, take 2 less damage from Inferno drawbacks, and can spend 1 Action Point to reduce your Inferno Level by 1.

inferno.name: Detonation
inferno.description: Rank 1: Unlocks Detonation - spend 1 Action Point to teleport 15ft to an unoccupied space within fire terrain. Rank 2: Unlocks Detonation - spend 1 Action Point to teleport 20ft to an unoccupied space within fire terrain. Rank 3: Unlocks Detonation - spend 1 Action Point to teleport 25ft to an unoccupied space within fire terrain.

inferno.name: Fiery Resurgence
inferno.description: Rank 1: You can spend 1 Action Point to create a 5ft radius zone of fire terrain that lasts 1 minute. Rank 2: You can spend 1 Action Point to create a 10ft radius zone of fire terrain that lasts 1 minute. Rank 3: You can spend 1 Action Point to create a 10ft radius zone of fire terrain that lasts 1 minute and deals 1d4 fire damage to creatures that enter it. Rank 4: You can spend 1 Action Point to create a 15ft radius zone of fire terrain that lasts 1 minute and deals 1d4 fire damage to creatures that enter it.

inferno.name: Overcharge
inferno.description: Rank 1: When you take fire damage, you can spend 1 Action Point to deal 1d6 fire damage to one creature within 30ft. Rank 2: When you take fire damage, you can spend 1 Action Point to deal 1d8 fire damage to one creature within 30ft. Rank 3: When you take fire damage, you can spend 1 Action Point to deal 1d10 fire damage to one creature within 30ft.

inferno.name: Ascended Burst
inferno.description: Rank 1: Unlocks Ascended Burst - create a 20ft radius zone of bright light centered on you for 1 minute. Enemies in the zone have disadvantage on attack rolls. Rank 2: Unlocks Ascended Burst - create a 25ft radius zone of bright light centered on you for 1 minute. Enemies in the zone have disadvantage on attack rolls. You have advantage on attack rolls against enemies in the zone. Rank 3: Unlocks Ascended Burst - create a 30ft radius zone of bright light centered on you for 1 minute. Enemies in the zone have disadvantage on attack rolls. You have advantage on attack rolls against enemies in the zone. Enemies that enter the zone take 2d6 radiant damage.

inferno.name: Immolation
inferno.description: Rank 1: Enemies within 5ft take 3 fire damage at the start of your turn. Rank 2: Enemies within 5ft take 6 fire damage at the start of your turn. Rank 3: Enemies within 5ft take 9 fire damage at the start of your turn. Rank 4: Enemies within 5ft take 12 fire damage at the start of your turn. Rank 5: Enemies within 5ft take 15 fire damage at the start of your turn.

inferno.name: Maximum Power
inferno.description: Rank 1: At Inferno Level 9, your fire spells have their range doubled. Rank 2: At Inferno Level 8, your fire spells have their range doubled and ignore half cover.

inferno.name: Power Surge
inferno.description: Rank 1: After spending 3+ Inferno Levels in one turn, gain advantage on all attack rolls for 1 round. Rank 2: After spending 2+ Inferno Levels in one turn, gain advantage on all attack rolls for 1 round and regain 1 action point.

inferno.name: Heat Death
inferno.description: Rank 1: When an enemy dies from your fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level if below Level 7. Otherwise, restore 5 HP. Rank 2: When an enemy dies from your fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level if below Level 8. Otherwise, restore 8 HP. Rank 3: When an enemy dies from your fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level if below Level 9. Otherwise, restore 10 HP and gain 1 action point.

inferno.name: Critical Cascade
inferno.description: Rank 1: When you crit with a fire spell, gain 1 action point. Rank 2: When you crit with a fire spell, gain 1 action point and reduce self-damage from Inferno drawbacks by half for 1 round. Rank 3: When you crit with a fire spell, gain 1 action point, reduce self-damage from Inferno drawbacks by half for 1 round, and your next fire spell costs 2 less mana (minimum 1).

inferno.name: Permanent Inferno
inferno.description: Rank 1: You can no longer descend below Inferno Level 3. Rank 2: You can no longer descend below Inferno Level 3. At Level 9, you deal +1d12 fire damage with all attacks. Rank 3: You can no longer descend below Inferno Level 3. At Level 9, you deal +2d12 fire damage with all attacks.

inferno.name: Supernova
inferno.description: Unlocks Supernova - consume all Inferno Levels to create a star that deals 8d12 fire damage in 50ft radius over 3 rounds. Enemies take damage at the start of each of their turns.

wildfire.name: Flame Spread
wildfire.description: Rank 1: When you deal fire damage, roll 1d20. On 16+ the damage jumps to a nearby enemy for half damage. Rank 2: When you deal fire damage, roll 1d20. On 15+ the damage jumps to a nearby enemy for half damage. Rank 3: When you deal fire damage, roll 1d20. On 14+ the damage jumps to a nearby enemy for half damage. Rank 4: When you deal fire damage, roll 1d20. On 13+ the damage jumps to a nearby enemy for half damage.

wildfire.name: Ground Fire
wildfire.description: Rank 1: Fire spells create patches of flame. Enemies entering these areas take 1d8 fire damage. Rank 2: Fire spells create patches of flame. Enemies entering these areas take 2d8 fire damage. Rank 3: Fire spells create patches of flame. Enemies entering these areas take 3d8 fire damage. Rank 4: Fire spells create patches of flame. Enemies entering these areas take 4d8 fire damage.

wildfire.name: Conflagration
wildfire.description: Unlocks Conflagration - ignite all enemies in 25ft radius. They take 2d6 fire damage per round for 4 rounds.

wildfire.name: Chain Reaction
wildfire.description: When a burning enemy dies, roll 1d6. On 4+: ignite a nearby enemy.

wildfire.name: Wild Growth
wildfire.description: Rank 1: Ground fire patches grow larger. Each patch now affects 10ft radius instead of 5ft. Rank 2: Ground fire patches grow larger. Each patch now affects 15ft radius instead of 5ft. Rank 3: Ground fire patches grow larger. Each patch now affects 20ft radius instead of 5ft.

wildfire.name: Firestorm
wildfire.description: Unlocks Firestorm - summon a storm of fire in 30ft radius. Deals 3d8 fire damage per round for 3 rounds.

wildfire.name: Searing Heat
wildfire.description: Rank 1: Enemies take +1d6 fire damage when they take fire damage while already burning. Rank 2: Enemies take +2d6 fire damage when they take fire damage while already burning. Rank 3: Enemies take +3d6 fire damage when they take fire damage while already burning. Rank 4: Enemies take +4d6 fire damage when they take fire damage while already burning.

wildfire.name: Infernal Rain
wildfire.description: Unlocks Infernal Rain - rain of fire in 40ft radius deals 2d8 damage per round for 4 rounds.

wildfire.name: Pandemic
wildfire.description: Rank 1: Your fire DoT effects can spread to nearby enemies. Roll 1d6 when a DoT ticks: on 4+ spread. Rank 2: Your fire DoT effects can spread to nearby enemies. Roll 1d6 when a DoT ticks: on 3+ spread. Rank 3: Your fire DoT effects can spread to nearby enemies. Roll 1d6 when a DoT ticks: on 2+ spread.

wildfire.name: Heat Wave
wildfire.description: Unlocks Heat Wave - 60ft cone dealing 4d8 fire damage. Creates ground fire in the area.

wildfire.name: Burn Out
wildfire.description: When fire DoT effects expire, roll 1d6. On 5+: explode dealing 2d6 fire damage to the target.

wildfire.name: Lingering Flames
wildfire.description: Rank 1: Your fire DoT effects reduce enemy movement speed by 5ft. Rank 2: Your fire DoT effects reduce enemy movement speed by 10ft. Rank 3: Your fire DoT effects reduce enemy movement speed by 15ft. Rank 4: Your fire DoT effects reduce enemy movement speed by 20ft.

wildfire.name: World on Fire
wildfire.description: All ground fire patches are connected. Moving between patches costs 2x movement and deals 1d8 damage.

wildfire.name: Calamity
wildfire.description: Once per combat, create a field of endless flame in 50ft radius. Enemies take 3d6 fire damage per round.

wildfire.name: Eternal Flame
wildfire.description: Your fire effects cannot be extinguished by any means. They persist until their duration ends naturally.

wildfire.name: Combustion Wave
wildfire.description: Unlocks Combustion Wave - 60ft line dealing 6d6 fire damage. Enemies hit lose 2d6 HP at start of their turns for 3 rounds.

wildfire.name: Volcanic Eruption
wildfire.description: Unlocks Volcanic Eruption - ground explodes in 20ft radius for 5d8 fire damage. Roll 1d6: on 5+, create lava pools.

wildfire.name: Apocalypse
wildfire.description: Unlocks Apocalypse - transform the battlefield into a hellscape. All enemies take 4d8 fire damage per round. Ground fire everywhere within 100ft.

hellfire.name: Demonic Resilience
hellfire.description: Rank 1: You gain +1 HP when ascending Inferno Levels. Fire damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP. Rank 2: You gain +2 HP when ascending Inferno Levels. Fire damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP. Rank 3: You gain +3 HP when ascending Inferno Levels. Fire damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP. Rank 4: You gain +4 HP when ascending Inferno Levels. Fire damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP. Rank 5: You gain +5 HP when ascending Inferno Levels. Fire damage cannot reduce you below 1 HP.

hellfire.name: Drain Life
hellfire.description: Unlocks Drain Life - deal 3d6 fire damage to target, heal for the damage dealt.

hellfire.name: Soul Fire
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Your fire spells drain life. Deal +1d4 extra fire damage, heal for half the fire damage you deal. Rank 2: Your fire spells drain life. Deal +1d4 extra fire damage, heal for half the fire damage you deal. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Rank 3: Your fire spells drain life. Deal +1d6 extra fire damage, heal for half the fire damage you deal. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Rank 4: Your fire spells drain life. Deal +1d6 extra fire damage, heal for half the fire damage you deal. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened and charmed.

hellfire.name: Dark Empowerment
hellfire.description: Rank 1: When you take fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level. Rank 2: When you take fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level. When you take non-fire damage, reduce the next Inferno drawback self-damage by 1d4. Rank 3: When you take fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level. When you take non-fire damage, reduce the next Inferno drawback self-damage by 1d6. Rank 4: When you take fire damage, ascend 1 Inferno Level. When you take non-fire damage, reduce the next Inferno drawback self-damage by 1d8 and gain 1d4 temporary HP.

hellfire.name: Soul Link
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Link your life force to an enemy. Roll 1d6 when they take damage: on 4+ you heal for 1d6. Rank 2: Link your life force to an enemy. Roll 1d6 when they take damage: on 4+ you heal for 2d6. Rank 3: Link your life force to an enemy. Roll 1d6 when they take damage: on 4+ you heal for 3d6. Rank 4: Link your life force to an enemy. Roll 1d6 when they take damage: on 4+ you heal for 4d6.

hellfire.name: Immortal
hellfire.description: At Inferno Level 5+, you cannot die from HP loss. Instead, you enter a weakened state at 1 HP. This does not protect against The Demon's Bargain (Inferno Level 9 death clock).

hellfire.name: Demonic Shield
hellfire.description: Rank 1: When you ascend to a new Inferno Level, gain a shield absorbing 1d6 damage per level reached. Rank 2: When you ascend to a new Inferno Level, gain a shield absorbing 2d6 damage per level reached. Rank 3: When you ascend to a new Inferno Level, gain a shield absorbing 3d6 damage per level reached.

hellfire.name: Demon Form
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Unlocks Demon Form - transform for 1 minute. +2 armor, +1 to all saves, regenerate 1d8 HP per round. Rank 2: Unlocks Demon Form - transform for 1 minute. +4 armor, +2 to all saves, regenerate 2d8 HP per round. Rank 3: Unlocks Demon Form - transform for 1 minute. +6 armor, +3 to all saves, regenerate 3d8 HP per round.

hellfire.name: Life Steal
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Your fire damage heals you for 1 HP for every 4 damage dealt. Rank 2: Your fire damage heals you for 1 HP for every 4 damage dealt. You can spend 1 action point to regain 1d8 HP when below half health. Rank 3: Your fire damage heals you for 1 HP for every 4 damage dealt. You can spend 1 action point to regain 1d8 HP when below half health. Rank 4: Your fire damage heals you for 2 HP for every 4 damage dealt. You can spend 1 action point to regain 1d10 HP when below half health.

hellfire.name: Dark Barrier
hellfire.description: Enemies within 15ft have disadvantage on saving throws against your fire effects.

hellfire.name: Fear Realm
hellfire.description: Unlocks Fear Realm - create a 40ft zone of terror. Enemies must save or be frightened and take 2d6 psychic damage per round.

hellfire.name: Hellish Aura
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Enemies within 20ft take 1d6 fire damage at the start of your turn and have -1 to attack rolls. Rank 2: Enemies within 20ft take 2d6 fire damage at the start of your turn and have -2 to attack rolls. Rank 3: Enemies within 20ft take 3d6 fire damage at the start of your turn and have -3 to attack rolls.

hellfire.name: Abyssal Summoning
hellfire.description: Unlocks Abyssal Summoning - summon a lesser demon. Roll 1d6: on 4+, summon succeeds.

hellfire.name: Soul Harvest
hellfire.description: Unlocks Soul Harvest - consume enemy souls in 30ft radius. Deal 3d8 damage, heal for total damage.

hellfire.name: Demonic Dominion
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Your summoned demons gain +2 to all rolls and deal +1d6 fire damage. Rank 2: Your summoned demons gain +4 to all rolls and deal +2d6 fire damage. Rank 3: Your summoned demons gain +6 to all rolls and deal +3d6 fire damage.

hellfire.name: Eternal Torment
hellfire.description: Rank 1: Enemies killed by your fire damage explode, dealing 2d6 fire damage to enemies within 10ft. Rank 2: Enemies killed by your fire damage explode, dealing 2d6 fire damage to enemies within 15ft. Each explosion heals you for 1d4 HP. Rank 3: Enemies killed by your fire damage explode, dealing 3d6 fire damage to enemies within 20ft. Each explosion heals you for 1d6 HP and you gain 1 temporary HP per enemy hit.

hellfire.name: Prince of Hell
hellfire.description: Unlocks Hell Portal - open a portal to the Abyss. Summon up to 3 demonic minions and deal 6d8 fire damage in 60ft radius per round. Demons last for 1 minute.

soulsinger.name: Tonic Resonance
soulsinger.description: Your builder spells that generate Note I (Tonic) also generate +1 Note IV (Subdominant) per rank. The foundation of every healing melody.

soulsinger.name: Restorative Chord
soulsinger.description: Your healing builder spells restore +1d4 HP per rank to the lowest-health ally within 30 feet when cast.

soulsinger.name: Gentle Tempo
soulsinger.description: Reduce the mana cost of your builder spells by 1 per rank. A calm performer plays longer.

soulsinger.name: Soothing Voice
soulsinger.description: When you generate Note III (Mediant), the nearest ally within 20 feet heals for 1d4 per rank. Emotion heals.

soulsinger.name: Submediant Shield
soulsinger.description: When you generate Note VI (Submediant), grant the nearest ally 1d4 temporary HP per rank. Melancholy becomes armor.

soulsinger.name: Authentic Mastery
soulsinger.description: Your Authentic Cadence heals for an additional 1d6 per rank. The grand finale resonates deeper.

soulsinger.name: Cadence Echo
soulsinger.description: When you resolve a 4-note cadence, retain 1 random note from the consumed set per rank. Nothing truly ends.

soulsinger.name: Plagal Bounty
soulsinger.description: Your Plagal Cadence grants affected allies +1d6 temporary HP per rank in addition to its speed bonus.

soulsinger.name: Healing Chorus
soulsinger.description: Unlocks Healing Chorus — resolve a cadence targeting all allies within 20 feet. Each ally is healed for 2d6 + your spirit modifier per rank. Consumes 3 notes of any type. Once per combat.

soulsinger.name: Picardy Enhancement
soulsinger.description: Your Picardy Third also removes 1 debuff per rank from all affected allies. Light purifies as it heals.

soulsinger.name: Lullaby Ward
soulsinger.description: When you complete any healing cadence, all allies within 15 feet gain +2 to saving throws for 2 rounds per rank. Your melody shields the mind.

soulsinger.name: Tonic Overflow
soulsinger.description: When you reach max stacks (5) of Note I, your next cadence resolves for 150% healing per rank. The tonic cannot be contained.

soulsinger.name: Renewing Resolution
soulsinger.description: Your healing cadences also grant regeneration: 1d4 HP per round for 2 rounds per rank. The song lingers.

soulsinger.name: Death-Defying Aria
soulsinger.description: Unlocks Death-Defying Aria — when an ally drops to 0 HP, you may immediately consume 5 notes of any type to revive them with 3d10 HP. Once per ally per day.

soulsinger.name: Grand Symphony
soulsinger.description: Unlocks Grand Symphony — consume 7 notes of any type to heal all allies within 30 feet for 3d8 + spirit modifier per rank and grant +2 Armor for 3 rounds. Once per combat.

soulsinger.name: Maestro of Mending
soulsinger.description: For 1 minute, all your builder spells generate double notes, and your healing cadences affect double the radius. When you complete a cadence, generate 2 random notes. You become the instrument of restoration itself.

battlechoir.name: Dominant Fury
battlechoir.description: Your builder spells that generate Note V (Dominant) also deal +1d4 damage per rank. The dominant demands violence.

battlechoir.name: Power Chord
battlechoir.description: When you generate Note V, your next attack roll gains +1 per rank. Build tension, then strike.

battlechoir.name: Battle Rhythm
battlechoir.description: When you generate Note IV (Subdominant), grant all allies within 15 feet +1 to damage rolls per rank for 1 round. Forward motion empowers.

battlechoir.name: Perfect Strike
battlechoir.description: When you resolve Perfect Cadence, the guaranteed critical hit also deals +1d8 bonus damage per rank. The perfect progression hits harder.

battlechoir.name: Cadence Momentum
battlechoir.description: After resolving any cadence, your next builder spell costs 2 less mana and generates +1 note per rank. The composition never stops.

battlechoir.name: War Cry
battlechoir.description: Your offensive builder spells also grant +1 to ally attack rolls within 10 feet per rank for 1 round. Your music is a call to arms.

battlechoir.name: Circle Mastery
battlechoir.description: Your Circle of Fifths deals +1d6 damage per rank per tick and lasts 1 additional round per rank. Eternal torment, indeed.

battlechoir.name: Double Time
battlechoir.description: Once per combat, you may resolve two cadences in a single turn. The second cadence consumes 1 fewer note per rank. Speed is power.

battlechoir.name: Phrygian Fire
battlechoir.description: Your Phrygian Cadence also deals 1d6 fire damage per rank to all enemies within 15 feet of affected allies. Ancient resolve burns.

battlechoir.name: Neapolitan Precision
battlechoir.description: Your Neapolitan Sixth also grants +1d8 bonus damage on the next critical hit per rank. Precision compounds into devastation.

battlechoir.name: Harmonic Cascade
battlechoir.description: When you resolve a 4-note cadence, all allies within 20 feet gain +1d4 to their next damage roll per rank. Resolved harmonics cascade outward.

battlechoir.name: Crit Resonance
battlechoir.description: When an ally scores a critical hit while affected by your cadence buff, you generate 2 random notes per rank. Your ally's triumph feeds your composition.

battlechoir.name: Dominant Supremacy
battlechoir.description: When you reach max stacks (5) of Note V, your next offensive cadence deals 150% damage per rank. The dominant cannot be denied.

battlechoir.name: War Drums
battlechoir.description: Unlocks War Drums — consume 4 notes of any type to grant all allies within 30 feet +1d8 damage per rank on all attacks for 3 rounds. Once per combat.

battlechoir.name: Cacophonous Ending
battlechoir.description: Unlocks Cacophonous Ending — consume ALL remaining notes. Deal 1d8 thunder damage per note consumed in a 40-foot radius to enemies. Allies are healed for the same amount. The louder the ending, the greater the impact.

battlechoir.name: Orchestral Mastery
battlechoir.description: Your builder spells now generate +1 note of a random type per rank. Your compositions grow richer with every measure.

battlechoir.name: Symphony of Destruction
battlechoir.description: Unlocks Symphony of Destruction — consume 8 notes of any type to conduct a devastating symphony. All enemies in 50 feet take 4d8 + spirit modifier thunder damage and are deafened for 2 rounds. All allies in range gain +3 to attack rolls and +2d6 damage for 5 rounds. Once per long rest.

dissonance.name: Dissonant Awareness
dissonance.description: Your builder spells that generate Note VII (Leading Tone) also generate +1 Note II (Supertonic) per rank. Urgency breeds tension.

dissonance.name: Unsettling Vibration
dissonance.description: When you generate Note II (Supertonic), enemies within 10 feet take 1d4 psychic damage per rank. Dissonance hurts.

dissonance.name: Echoing Tension
dissonance.description: Your control-effect builder spells have their save DC increased by 1 per rank. The mind cannot resist the wrong note.

dissonance.name: Deceptive Mastery
dissonance.description: Your Deceptive Cadence stun duration increases by 1 round per rank. The trick lingers longer than expected.

dissonance.name: Dissonant Spread
dissonance.description: When an enemy fails a save against your cadence, all enemies within 10 feet take 1d6 psychic damage per rank. Wrong notes echo.

dissonance.name: Half Cadence Fortification
dissonance.description: Your Half Cadence shield value increases by +1d6 per rank and lasts 1 additional round per rank. Incomplete resolution becomes strength.

dissonance.name: Tritone Amplification
dissonance.description: Your Tritone Substitution save DC increases by +2 per rank. Additionally, on a failed save, the target also becomes frightened for 1 round per rank.

dissonance.name: Chaos Resonance
dissonance.description: When you generate Note VII (Leading Tone), there is a 25% chance per rank to also generate +1 random note. Chaos breeds possibility.

dissonance.name: Cacophony
dissonance.description: Unlocks Cacophony — consume 4 notes of any type to create a 30-foot radius of discordant sound. Enemies take 2d8 psychic damage and must make a Spirit save (DC 14 + rank) or be stunned for 1 round. Once per combat.

dissonance.name: Fear Frequency
dissonance.description: When you resolve a control cadence, all enemies within 15 feet must make a Wisdom save (DC 13 + rank) or become frightened for 1 round. Terror propagates.

dissonance.name: Note Corruption
dissonance.description: When you generate Note VI (Submediant), the nearest enemy within 20 feet suffers -1 to their next saving throw per rank. Melancholy weakens resolve.

dissonance.name: Dissonant Echo
dissonance.description: When you resolve a control cadence, retain 2 random notes from the consumed set. The wrong note never truly dies.

dissonance.name: Reality Warping
dissonance.description: Your control cadences that target a single enemy now also affect 1 additional enemy within 15 feet per rank at half duration. Sound bends space.

dissonance.name: Sonic Annihilation
dissonance.description: Unlocks Sonic Annihilation — consume 6 notes of any type to unleash a shockwave in a 40-foot cone. Deals 3d8 thunder damage per rank and knocks all enemies prone. Deafened enemies take double damage.

dissonance.name: Void Melody
dissonance.description: When you consume Note VII as part of a cadence, all enemies within 20 feet lose their reaction until the start of their next turn per rank. The leading tone silences.

dissonance.name: Arcane Serenade
dissonance.description: Unlocks Arcane Serenade — consume ALL remaining notes. For each note consumed, all enemies in 50 feet take 1d6 psychic damage and are silenced for 1 round (Spirit save DC 18). For each note consumed, all allies in range heal 1d4 HP. The song between order and chaos reshapes reality. Once per long rest.

stasis.name: Temporal Precision
stasis.description: Stasis Field save DC increased by +1 per rank.

stasis.name: Frozen Momentum
stasis.description: Gain +1 Time Shard whenever you freeze or stun an enemy.

stasis.name: Sustained Stasis
stasis.description: Stasis Field and Temporal Shockwave duration +1 round per rank.

stasis.name: Strain Efficiency
stasis.description: Control-tagged Flux abilities cost -1 Temporal Strain per rank (minimum 1).

stasis.name: Chronal Lockdown
stasis.description: Enemies frozen or stunned by your spells have -2 to their save to break free per rank.

stasis.name: Barrier Strength
stasis.description: Temporal Barrier grants +5 temporary HP per rank and lasts +1 round.

stasis.name: Echo Dominance
stasis.description: Temporal Echoes spawns +1 illusory copy per rank and echo damage increased by +1d6.

stasis.name: Fracture Mastery
stasis.description: Temporal Fracture DoT deals +1d6 necrotic damage per rank and lasts +1 round.

stasis.name: Dominion Authority
stasis.description: Temporal Flux: Dominion affects a +10ft larger radius per rank and you are immune to its slow effect.

stasis.name: Shockwave Resonance
stasis.description: Temporal Shockwave deals +2d6 force damage per rank and its freeze save DC increases by +2.

stasis.name: Temporal Supremacy
stasis.description: Temporal Mastery Strain cost reduced by -2 per rank. Its slow radius increased by +10ft per rank.

stasis.name: Avatar of Stasis
stasis.description: Once per combat: freeze all enemies within 40ft for 1 round, no save. Costs 6 Time Shards, adds 5 Temporal Strain.

displacement.name: Swift Temporal
displacement.description: Temporal Step range increased by +10ft per rank.

displacement.name: Chronal Echo Boost
displacement.description: Chrono Echo radius increased by +5ft per rank and duration +1 round.

displacement.name: Repositioning Shards
displacement.description: Gain +1 Time Shard whenever you teleport an ally or enemy.

displacement.name: Dilation Expansion
displacement.description: Temporal Dilation AoE radius increased by +5ft per rank.

displacement.name: Phase Mastery
displacement.description: Temporal Flux: Speed grants +10ft additional movement speed per rank.

displacement.name: Crystal Tuning
displacement.description: Time Crystal zone radius increased by +5ft per rank. Haste Mode speed bonus +0.25x per rank.

displacement.name: Disruption Range
displacement.description: Chronal Disruption AoE radius increased by +5ft per rank and damage +1d6 force per rank.

displacement.name: Vortex Durability
displacement.description: Temporal Vortex summon HP increased by +25 per rank and duration +1 round per rank.

displacement.name: Anchor Weight
displacement.description: Temporal Anchor slow effect: enemies lose an additional -10ft speed per rank. Duration +1 round.

displacement.name: Chamber Amplification
displacement.description: Temporal Echo Chamber echo damage increased by +1d6 force per rank and duration +1 round.

displacement.name: Fate Intervention
displacement.description: Fate Manipulation AoE radius +10ft per rank. Save DC increased by +2 per rank.

displacement.name: Paradox Mastery
displacement.description: Chronal Paradox confusion damage increased by +1d6 psychic per rank. Save DC +2 per rank.

displacement.name: Chronal Vortex Master
displacement.description: Chronal Vortex cost reduced by -3 Time Shards and -2 Temporal Strain. Allies healed are also granted +15 temporary HP.

rewinding.name: Mending Threads
rewinding.description: Temporal Mend healing increased by +1d8 per rank.

rewinding.name: Rewind Depth
rewinding.description: Temporal Rewind restores +10% of damage taken per rank (up to 70% at rank 2).

rewinding.name: Restoration Shards
rewinding.description: Gain +1 Time Shard whenever you heal or restore an ally above 50% of the amount restored.

rewinding.name: Purifying Rewind
rewinding.description: Temporal Flux: Rewind removes +1 additional debuff per rank from each ally.

rewinding.name: Strain Absorption
rewinding.description: Healing-tagged Flux abilities cost -1 Temporal Strain per rank (minimum 1).

rewinding.name: Shield Reinforcement
rewinding.description: Temporal Flux: Shield grants +5 additional temporary HP per rank and healing +1d8 per rank.

rewinding.name: Buff Reversal
rewinding.description: Your rewind spells (Temporal Rewind, Chronal Reversal) can also target enemies. When cast on an enemy, strip 1 buff per rank instead of healing.

rewinding.name: Reversal Power
rewinding.description: Chronal Reversal healing increased by +2d6 per rank. Cooldown reduced by -1 turn per rank.

rewinding.name: Loop Mastery
rewinding.description: Temporal Loop duration +1 round per rank and save DC +2 per rank.

rewinding.name: Terrain Undo
rewinding.description: Temporal Loop and Reality Fracture can also revert terrain hazards and environmental effects in their area.

rewinding.name: Resurrection Mastery
rewinding.description: Temporal Flux: Resurrection Time Shard cost reduced by -2 per rank. Resurrected ally gains +10 temporary HP per rank.

rewinding.name: Fracture Undo
rewinding.description: Reality Fracture now also heals allies in its area for 3d6 + spirit. Strain cost reduced by -1 per rank.

rewinding.name: Restoration Supreme
rewinding.description: Chronal Restoration healing increased by +3d6 per rank. Damage reduction increased to 65% at rank 1, 75% at rank 2.

rewinding.name: Temporal Undoing
rewinding.description: Once per combat: revert the entire battlefield to its state from 2 rounds ago — ally HP, enemy HP, positioning, and active effects all reset. Costs 8 Time Shards, adds 7 Temporal Strain.

reality_bending.name: Chaos Seed
reality_bending.description: Generate +1 Mayhem per rank whenever you cast a Reality Bending spell. Mayhem economy.

reality_bending.name: Chaotic Door
reality_bending.description: Unlocks Chaotic Door — teleport to a random location within 60ft. Spend 2 Mayhem to choose the destination. Spell modifier.

reality_bending.name: Dimensional Burst
reality_bending.description: Your teleport spells deal 1d6 force damage per rank to creatures at the departure point. Damage.

reality_bending.name: Zone Warp
reality_bending.description: Your area spells increase in radius by 5ft per rank. Spell modifier.

reality_bending.name: Rift Anchor
reality_bending.description: When you cast a teleport or forced movement spell, gain +2 Mayhem per rank. Mayhem economy.

reality_bending.name: Mirror of Chaos
reality_bending.description: After casting Reality Flicker, create an illusory duplicate that draws one attack before shattering. 1 duplicate per rank per combat. Spell modifier.

reality_bending.name: Chaos Siphon
reality_bending.description: Whenever an enemy fails a save against your Reality Bending spells, steal 1 Mayhem per rank. Mayhem economy.

reality_bending.name: Chaos Nexus
reality_bending.description: Allies within 20ft of you gain +1 to saves against chaos effects per rank. Spend 3 Mayhem to redirect a chaos spell's area by 10ft. Spell modifier.

reality_bending.name: Spacial Dominance
reality_bending.description: Your teleport and position spells ignore line of sight. You can teleport through walls. +1d8 force damage per rank on all teleport effects. Damage + Spell modifier.

reality_bending.name: Reality Devourer
reality_bending.description: Whenever you spend 5+ Mayhem on a Reality Bending spell, the spell's duration doubles. Mayhem economy.

reality_bending.name: Chaos Incarnate
reality_bending.description: For 3 rounds: +4 spell damage, all Reality Bending spells auto-max one die, immune to forced movement and teleportation. Costs all remaining Mayhem (minimum 10). Long rest cooldown.

entropy_control.name: Decay Touch
entropy_control.description: Attacks deal +1d6 necrotic damage per rank. Your entropy damage ignores 10% armor per rank. Damage.

entropy_control.name: Decay Wave
entropy_control.description: Your Entropy spells that reduce stats also reduce the target's maximum HP by the same amount for the duration. Spell modifier.

entropy_control.name: Entropy Burst
entropy_control.description: Whenever an enemy dies while affected by your entropy debuff, gain +2 Mayhem per rank. Mayhem economy.

entropy_control.name: Deep Rot
entropy_control.description: Your entropy debuffs last +1 round per rank. When a debuff expires, deal 1d4 necrotic damage per rank to the target. Spell modifier.

entropy_control.name: Entropy Shield
entropy_control.description: +1 armor per rank. When hit in melee, attacker takes 1d4 necrotic damage per rank. Damage.

entropy_control.name: Decay Aura
entropy_control.description: At the start of your turn, gain +1 Mayhem per rank for each enemy within 25ft affected by your entropy debuffs. Mayhem economy.

entropy_control.name: Decay Mastery
entropy_control.description: Your entropy debuffs now stack twice on the same target (double the stat reduction). Spend 2 Mayhem to spread a debuff from one target to an adjacent enemy. Spell modifier.

entropy_control.name: Corrupting Blows
entropy_control.description: Your entropy damage critically hits on 18-20. Crit damage bonus is +2d6 necrotic per rank instead of normal crit dice. Damage.

entropy_control.name: Unmake
entropy_control.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP with an entropy spell, refund 3 Mayhem per rank and reduce your entropy spell cooldowns by 1. Mayhem economy.

entropy_control.name: Entropy Convergence
entropy_control.description: Entropy spells that hit 3+ targets deal +1d8 necrotic damage per rank to all targets hit. Damage.

entropy_control.name: Entropy Storm
entropy_control.description: Your entropy AoE spells leave a hazard zone (10ft radius, 1d6 necrotic/turn, 2 rounds) per rank. Spell modifier.

entropy_control.name: Eternal Decay
entropy_control.description: Creatures killed by your entropy effects rise as decaying undead (HP = your level x 3) for 3 rounds. Max 2 undead per rank. Spell modifier.

entropy_control.name: Oblivion's Embrace
entropy_control.description: Immune to necrotic damage. +1d12 necrotic on all attacks. Whenever you take damage, gain +1 Mayhem per rank. Mayhem economy + Damage.

entropy_control.name: Decay Incarnate
entropy_control.description: For 3 rounds: all your entropy spells gain +3d8 necrotic damage, all stat reductions are doubled, and you generate 2 Mayhem per enemy damaged. Costs all remaining Mayhem (minimum 10). Long rest cooldown.

chaos_dice.name: Chaos Dice
chaos_dice.description: Gain chaos dice that enhance your magic. Roll 1d20 when casting chaos table spells: on 16+ per rank, gain a chaos die (max 3). Chaos dice add +1d6 to table spell damage. Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Random Magic
chaos_dice.description: When you spend Mayhem to adjust a table result, reduce the cost by 1 per rank (minimum cost 1). Mayhem economy.

chaos_dice.name: Wild Bolt
chaos_dice.description: When your chaos table spell rolls a natural maximum on the table die, deal +2d6 damage per rank of a random type. Damage.

chaos_dice.name: Dice Storm
chaos_dice.description: Your chaos table spells that hit an area gain +5ft radius per rank. Your chaos dice also increase area by 5ft each. Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Probability Shift
chaos_dice.description: Allies within 30ft roll twice and take higher on d20 saves against your chaos effects. Spend 3 Mayhem to force an enemy to roll twice and take lower on one save per rank. Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Chaos Shield
chaos_dice.description: +1 armor per chaos die you hold. When attacked, spend 2 Mayhem per rank to force the attacker to reroll the attack. Mayhem economy.

chaos_dice.name: Loaded Table
chaos_dice.description: Increase the minimum result on any chaos table by 1 per rank (e.g., d20 minimum becomes 3 at rank 2). Stacks with spec passive. Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Critical Chaos
chaos_dice.description: When a chaos table spell rolls a natural 1 on the table die (worst result), gain 1d4 Mayhem per rank and your next chaos spell costs no mana. Mayhem economy.

chaos_dice.name: Chaos Nova
chaos_dice.description: Your chaos table spells that deal AoE damage gain +1 target affected per rank. Damage.

chaos_dice.name: Fate Weaver
chaos_dice.description: Once per combat, dictate the exact result of one chaos table roll (no Mayhem cost). Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Double Down
chaos_dice.description: When you spend 5+ Mayhem on a single table adjustment, gain a free chaos die and deal +1d8 random damage per rank. Damage + Mayhem economy.

chaos_dice.name: Random Power
chaos_dice.description: Rolling a natural maximum on any chaos table generates +2 Mayhem per rank and your next table spell has advantage (roll twice, pick better). Mayhem economy + Spell modifier.

chaos_dice.name: Dice God
chaos_dice.description: Your Mayhem Modifier cap increases by +5 per rank. Whenever you reach your cap, your next chaos spell auto-hits and can't be saved against. Mayhem economy.

chaos_dice.name: Ultimate Chaos
chaos_dice.description: All chaos table spells deal +1d10 random damage per rank. Rolling on a d100 table costs 2 less Mayhem to adjust per rank. Damage.

chaos_dice.name: Chaos Deity
chaos_dice.description: For 3 rounds: all chaos table results automatically shift up by 2 tiers, you gain unlimited Mayhem spending (no cap per roll), and chaos spells cost 50% less mana. Costs all remaining Mayhem (minimum 10). Long rest cooldown.

wild_magic.name: Surge Attunement
wild_magic.description: Whenever a Wild Magic Surge triggers (from your spec passive or spells), gain +1 Mayhem per rank and deal 1d6 random damage to a random enemy within 30ft. Mayhem economy + Damage.

wild_magic.name: Chain Reaction
wild_magic.description: When a Wild Magic Surge triggers, there is a 25% chance per rank it triggers again immediately. These chain triggers also generate Mayhem. Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Mana Leak
wild_magic.description: Whenever a Wild Magic Surge triggers, refund 2 mana per rank. At rank 3, surges also restore 1 action point. Mayhem economy.

wild_magic.name: Unstable Aura
wild_magic.description: Enemies that hit you in melee must roll on the Wild Surge table (d6). On a 1, the attack is negated. On 6, the attacker takes 2d6 random damage per rank. Damage + Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Chaos Magnet
wild_magic.description: Your Wild Magic Surge chance from the spec passive increases by +5% per rank (base: nat 1 on d20). At rank 4, nat 1-2 trigger surges. Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Wild Fury
wild_magic.description: Whenever a surge triggers, your next spell deals +1d8 random damage per rank. Damage.

wild_magic.name: Surging Power
wild_magic.description: Each Wild Magic Surge that triggers during combat gives you a stacking +1 to spell damage per rank (max 5 stacks). Resets on long rest. Damage.

wild_magic.name: Chaos Amplifier
wild_magic.description: Spend 4 Mayhem to force a Wild Magic Surge on your next spell cast (guaranteed). Surge effects from this talent are 50% stronger per rank. Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Mayhem Overload
wild_magic.description: Whenever you reach 15+ Mayhem, all your spells gain the Wild Surge trigger (d20, nat 1 = surge) for free. Lose this effect when Mayhem drops below 10. Mayhem economy + Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Cascade Master
wild_magic.description: Your Chaos Cascade spell now rolls 3 times instead of 2. All wild magic table effects that deal damage gain +1d6 per rank. Damage + Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Safe Haven
wild_magic.description: Once per combat, when a Wild Magic Surge would harm you or an ally, spend 5 Mayhem to redirect the effect to a random enemy instead. Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Wild Sovereignty
