wild_magic.description: You are immune to the negative effects of your own Wild Magic Surges. Allies within 20ft take 50% less damage from your surges per rank. Spell modifier.

wild_magic.name: Apex Surge
wild_magic.description: When a Wild Magic Surge triggers, all enemies within 30ft take 2d8 random damage per rank and you gain +3 Mayhem. Damage + Mayhem economy.

wild_magic.name: Wild Incarnate
wild_magic.description: For 3 rounds: every spell you cast triggers a Wild Magic Surge automatically, all surge effects are doubled, and you generate 2 Mayhem per surge. Costs all remaining Mayhem (minimum 10). Long rest cooldown.

fortune_teller.name: Crystal Gaze
fortune_teller.description: When you draw cards for spells, draw 1 extra card per rank and keep the best. Face cards drawn this way grant +1 Thread.

fortune_teller.name: Future Sight
fortune_teller.description: At combat start, draw 3 cards and set them aside as your Prophecy. Once per round, spend 1 Thread to swap a drawn card with a Prophecy card. Each rank lets you store 1 more Prophecy card.

fortune_teller.name: Prophetic Dreams
fortune_teller.description: At the start of each day, draw a card. Face cards grant you +1d8 temporary HP per rank for the first combat. Aces grant +2 Threads at combat start.

fortune_teller.name: Crystal Clarity
fortune_teller.description: When you cast a card-based spell, each face card in your hand grants +1d4 damage per rank to that spell.

fortune_teller.name: Fate Whispers
fortune_teller.description: Once per round, draw a card and show it to the DM. Red card: the DM must answer one yes/no question about immediate future events. Black card: gain 1 Thread per rank instead.

fortune_teller.name: Prescient Strike
fortune_teller.description: When an enemy attacks you, draw a card. Spades: redirect their attack to another enemy (deals 1d6 extra damage per rank). Hearts: reduce the damage by 1d8 per rank. Other suits: no effect, gain 1 Thread.

fortune_teller.name: Ally Foresight
fortune_teller.description: Allies within 30ft gain +1 to saves per rank. When an ally rolls a natural 1 on a save, draw a card — face cards let them reroll once per combat.

fortune_teller.name: Lucky Break
fortune_teller.description: When you take damage, draw a card. Aces reduce the damage by 2d6 per rank. Face cards reduce it by 1d6 per rank. Numbered cards: no reduction, gain 1 Thread.

fortune_teller.name: Crystal Reflection
fortune_teller.description: When targeted by a spell, draw a card. Matching the suit of the spell school reflects 1d6 damage per rank back to the caster. Non-matching: gain 1 Thread.

fortune_teller.name: Fate Binding
fortune_teller.description: Once per combat, draw a card. Face card: force an enemy to reroll a successful attack or save and take the worse result. Numbered card: no effect, gain 2 Threads per rank.

fortune_teller.name: Crystal Shield
fortune_teller.description: Draw 3 cards. Each matching suit adds 1d8 damage absorption per rank to a shield that lasts 3 rounds. No matches: gain 1 Thread per card instead.

fortune_teller.name: Shared Vision
fortune_teller.description: Allies within 20ft can see your Prophetic cards. When they make an attack, draw a card from your Prophecy — face cards grant +1d4 to their attack per rank.

fortune_teller.name: Doom Divination
fortune_teller.description: When you first see an enemy, draw a card. Black cards reduce their damage output by 1d6 per rank for the combat. Red cards: no reduction, gain 2 Threads per rank.

fortune_teller.name: Prophetic Blessing
fortune_teller.description: When an ally scores a critical hit, draw a card. Face cards add +1d10 damage per rank to the crit. Numbered cards: the ally gains 1 Thread per rank instead.

fortune_teller.name: Fate Intervention
fortune_teller.description: Once per combat, when an ally would die, draw 3 cards. If any 2 share a suit, prevent their death and heal them for 3d10. No matches: they still fall, you gain 5 Threads.

fortune_teller.name: Oracle Supremacy
fortune_teller.description: You are immune to surprise. At combat start, draw 5 cards as Prophecy instead of 3. Each face card in your Prophecy grants all allies +1 to initiative per rank.

fortune_teller.name: Crystal Cataclysm
fortune_teller.description: Your card-based spells that deal damage also deal +2d8 force damage per rank to all enemies within 10ft of the primary target. Face cards drawn double this bonus for that cast.

fortune_teller.name: Fate Crystal
fortune_teller.description: Draw 13 cards and arrange them in a circle around you. Allies within 60ft gain advantage on all rolls. Enemies within 60ft have disadvantage. Each round, flip the top card — if it matches an enemy's suit, they lose their reaction. Lasts 5 rounds or until all 13 cards are flipped.

card_master.name: Deck Mastery
card_master.description: When you draw cards for a spell, draw 1 extra card per rank and discard your choice. Red cards discarded this way refund 2 mana per rank.

card_master.name: Card Sleight
card_master.description: After drawing cards for a spell, discard 1 card and redraw from the deck per rank. If the new card is a face card, your spell deals +1d6 damage per rank.

card_master.name: Royal Advantage
card_master.description: Face cards in your drawn hands grant +1 to all rolls per rank for 1 round. Multiple face cards stack (2 face cards = +2 per rank).

card_master.name: Pair Mastery
card_master.description: When your drawn hand contains a pair, your next spell deals +1d6 damage per rank. Three of a kind: +2d6 per rank. Four of a kind: +4d6 per rank.

card_master.name: Flush Power
card_master.description: Each card in a flush grants a bonus per rank: Hearts heal +1d8, Diamonds deal +1d8 force damage, Clubs reduce enemy Armor by 1, Spades grant +1 to your Armor.

card_master.name: Straight Magic
card_master.description: Straights in your hand grant +1 to spell DC per rank per card in the straight. A straight of 5 cards (full straight) auto-succeeds against one target.

card_master.name: Full House Mastery
card_master.description: Full houses create shields absorbing 2d6 damage per rank. Four of a kind doubles the shield. The suit of the three-of-a-kind determines the shield element resistance.

card_master.name: Card Storm
card_master.description: When you cast a card-based spell with 3+ matching cards, deal 1d6 force damage per rank to all enemies within 15ft of the target. Draw a card — face cards double the storm damage.

card_master.name: Royal Flush Dominion
card_master.description: When you achieve a Royal Flush, you may control one enemy for 2 rounds per rank. They follow your commands. Spend 6 Threads to guarantee a Royal Flush (still requires casting Hand of Fate).

card_master.name: Deck Rearrangement
card_master.description: Once per combat, look at the top 5+rank cards of your deck and rearrange them in any order. Face cards in the rearranged top 5 generate 1 Thread each.

card_master.name: Living Cards
card_master.description: When you discard cards from your hand, they persist for 3 rounds as hovering projectiles. Each living card deals 1d4 force damage per rank to the next enemy that enters melee range.

card_master.name: Infinite Deck
card_master.description: Your deck never runs out. When you would reshuffle the discard pile, instead regenerate the full 52-card deck. Draw 1 extra card at the start of each of your turns per rank.

card_master.name: Card Typhoon
card_master.description: When you cast a card-based spell, all discarded cards from that spell spin outward dealing 2d8 force damage per rank to enemies within 20ft. Face cards deal double. You gain 1 Thread per enemy hit.

card_master.name: Deck of the Gods
card_master.description: Once per long rest, draw 5 cards. Each card becomes a permanent passive for 1 minute: Aces = +5 to all rolls. Face cards = immunity to one damage type. Numbered cards = your spells cost 5 less mana. The gods deal in absolutes.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Sense
thread_weaver.description: When you generate Threads, draw a card. Face cards generate +1 additional Thread per rank. Aces generate +2 additional Threads per rank.

thread_weaver.name: Failure Harvest
thread_weaver.description: When your spells fail or produce negative outcomes, gain +1 additional Thread per rank. Your maximum Threads increase by 3 per rank (up to 25 at max ranks).

thread_weaver.name: Thread Binding
thread_weaver.description: Spend 1 Thread to force any creature to reroll a die. Draw a card — face cards: you choose which result. Numbered cards: the roller chooses. Aces: both results apply (take the better for allies, worse for enemies).

thread_weaver.name: Thread Weaving
thread_weaver.description: Spend 2 Threads to enhance your next card draw — draw 2 additional cards and choose the best per rank. Discarded cards still count for Thread generation.

thread_weaver.name: Fate Redirection
thread_weaver.description: Spend 2 Threads to redirect an attack targeting an ally to yourself. Draw a card — each pip reduces the damage you take by 2 per rank. Face cards: take no damage instead.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Armor
thread_weaver.description: Spend Threads at the start of your turn to weave armor: +1 Armor per 2 Threads spent per rank. Lasts until you spend Threads again. The more Threads you spend, the stronger the weave.

thread_weaver.name: Chance Manipulation
thread_weaver.description: Spend 1 Thread to add +1d6 to any roll per rank. Spend 3 Threads to guarantee a roll succeeds (draw a card — if face card, also add a bonus effect of your choice).

thread_weaver.name: Thread Barrier
thread_weaver.description: Spend 3 Threads to create a 20ft barrier of woven fate. Enemies passing through draw a card — red cards: they are restrained for 1 round per rank. Black cards: they take 1d8 force damage per rank. Lasts 1 minute.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Snare
thread_weaver.description: Spend 2 Threads to create snares in a 20ft area. Enemies entering draw a card — Clubs: restrained for 1 round per rank. Other suits: slowed for 1 round per rank. Aces: both effects.

thread_weaver.name: Fate Weaving
thread_weaver.description: Spend 4 Threads and draw 3 cards. All same suit: heal 4d8 per rank OR deal 4d8 force damage per rank. Pair: teleport 60ft. No matches: gain 2 Threads per rank back.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Leech
thread_weaver.description: Spend 3 Threads to attach fate threads to a creature. Each round, draw a card — red cards drain 1d6 HP per rank and convert it to Threads for you. Lasts 3 rounds. Face cards: drain is doubled.

thread_weaver.name: Web of Fate
thread_weaver.description: Spend 4 Threads to link all creatures in 30ft with fate threads. When one creature takes damage, all linked creatures of the same type take 1d4 per rank. Draw a card each round — Aces sever the link for your allies.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Storm
thread_weaver.description: Spend 3 Threads to create a storm of threads in 30ft. Each round, draw a card — face cards deal 2d6 force damage per rank to enemies in the area. Numbered cards deal 1d6 per rank and generate 1 Thread. Lasts 3 rounds.

thread_weaver.name: Destiny Reweaving
thread_weaver.description: Spend 5 Threads to rewind 1 round for yourself or an ally. They redo their turn with +1d4 per rank to all rolls. Draw a card — Aces: the rewind costs no Threads.

thread_weaver.name: Thread Overflow
thread_weaver.description: When you would gain Threads beyond your maximum, instead deal 1d6 force damage per rank per excess Thread to enemies within 20ft. Face cards double the overflow damage.

thread_weaver.name: Fortune Drain
thread_weaver.description: Spend 4 Threads to drain an enemy's luck. Draw a card — the enemy has disadvantage on all rolls for a number of rounds equal to the card's value per rank (Aces = 5 rounds, Face = 4 rounds, others = pip value).

thread_weaver.name: Infinite Threads
thread_weaver.description: Maximum Threads increased by 5 per rank. When you reach your new maximum, all your Thread costs are reduced by 1 (minimum 1) for 3 rounds.

thread_weaver.name: Fate Tapestry
thread_weaver.description: Spend 8 Threads and draw 5 cards. Arrange them as the Tapestry — allies in 50ft gain advantage matching the suits present (Hearts = attack advantage, Diamonds = save advantage, Clubs = skill advantage, Spades = Armor +2). Number of matching suits = number of advantages active. Lasts 5 rounds.

thread_weaver.name: Cosmic Web
thread_weaver.description: Spend 13 Threads (the King's price). For 1 minute, draw 1 card at the start of each turn. That card's suit dictates cosmic power: ♠ = reroll any enemy die, ♥ = heal all allies 4d8, ♦ = deal 4d8 force damage to all enemies, ♣ = all enemies lose their reaction. Face cards = apply ALL four effects.

fortunes_favor.name: Lucky Charm
fortunes_favor.description: You carry a personal lucky charm. Once per day, reroll any die and take the higher result.

fortunes_favor.name: Charm of Luck
fortunes_favor.description: Create charms that grant +1d4 to rolls. Each charm lasts 1 hour per rank.

fortunes_favor.name: Probability Bend
fortunes_favor.description: Bend probability around you. Allies within 20ft can reroll 1s on attack rolls.

fortunes_favor.name: Lucky Streak
fortunes_favor.description: After a critical hit, your next attack has advantage. Stacks up to 3 times.

fortunes_favor.name: Four-Leaf Clover
fortunes_favor.description: Find four-leaf clovers in unlikely places. Once per day, guarantee success on a skill check.

fortunes_favor.name: Lucky Break
fortunes_favor.description: When reduced below 0 HP, roll 1d20. On 10+ per rank, survive with 1 HP.

fortunes_favor.name: Serendipity
fortunes_favor.description: Lucky discoveries occur. When searching, find an extra item or clue 25% of the time per rank.

fortunes_favor.name: Lady Luck's Favor
fortunes_favor.description: Lady Luck smiles upon you. +1 to all saving throws. Roll 1d20 after failed saves: on 15+ per rank, succeed instead.

fortunes_favor.name: Luck Field
fortunes_favor.description: Create a 30ft field of good luck. Allies inside reroll 1s and 2s on all rolls.

fortunes_favor.name: Jackpot
fortunes_favor.description: Critical hits deal maximum damage on the base dice. Rank 1: base dice deal max on crits. Rank 2: crits also generate +2 Fortune Points instead of +1.

fortunes_favor.name: Golden Touch
fortunes_favor.description: Your Fortune Point spending is more efficient. Reduce the FP cost of any adjustment by 1 (minimum 0) once per turn per rank. Rank 1: first adjustment each turn costs 1 less FP. Rank 2: first two adjustments each turn cost 1 less FP.

fortunes_favor.name: Luck Incarnate
fortunes_favor.description: You become a being of pure luck. Reroll any die result once per turn. Choose the better result.

high_roller.name: Risk Assessment
high_roller.description: You can assess risks instinctively. +1d4 to Insight checks when evaluating dangerous situations.

high_roller.name: Hedge Bet
high_roller.description: Split your actions between safety and risk. Once per turn, take a 1 action point to create a safety net.

high_roller.name: Contingency Plan
high_roller.description: Prepare for failure. When a plan fails, you can immediately attempt a different approach as a reaction.

high_roller.name: Calculated Risk
high_roller.description: Take calculated risks for greater rewards. +1d6 to damage when attacking at disadvantage.

high_roller.name: Safety Net
high_roller.description: Create safety nets for allies. Once per combat, prevent an ally from taking damage from an attack.

high_roller.name: Backup Plan
high_roller.description: Always have a backup. When an action fails, you can immediately attempt it again at disadvantage.

high_roller.name: High Stakes
high_roller.description: Risk everything for glory. Critical hits deal +2d6 damage, but critical failures take +1d6 damage.

high_roller.name: Insurance Policy
high_roller.description: Take out insurance on dangerous actions. If a high-risk action fails, take half damage or effect.

high_roller.name: Balanced Gamble
high_roller.description: Balance risk and reward perfectly. When you succeed on a risky action, gain temporary HP equal to the DC.

high_roller.name: Mitigated Loss
high_roller.description: Turn failures into learning experiences. Failed actions grant +1 to future attempts against the same target.

high_roller.name: Perfect Timing
high_roller.description: Time your risks perfectly. Once per combat, delay an enemy's action until after yours.

high_roller.name: Hedged Bets
high_roller.description: When you fail a saving throw, you may spend 2 Fortune Points to halve the damage or effect. Allies within 30ft gain resistance to that damage type for 1 round.

high_roller.name: Ultimate Gamble
high_roller.description: Make the ultimate gamble. Once per day, reroll all dice for an action and take the higher result.

high_roller.name: Perfect Balance
high_roller.description: Achieve perfect balance between risk and safety. You can choose to succeed or fail any roll once per day.

card_sharp.name: Wheel of Fortune
card_sharp.description: You can sense the turning of fate's wheel. Once per day, glimpse into possible futures.

card_sharp.name: Destiny Thread
card_sharp.description: Pull on threads of destiny. Once per combat, force a creature to reroll an attack against you.

card_sharp.name: Fate Intervention
card_sharp.description: Intervene in fate. Once per day, change the result of any die roll by ±1 per rank.

card_sharp.name: Turning Wheel
card_sharp.description: The wheel turns in your favor. After failing a save, you can reroll it once.

card_sharp.name: Karmic Balance
card_sharp.description: Karma balances the scales. When you help an ally, they gain +1d4 to their next roll.

card_sharp.name: Fate Binder
card_sharp.description: Bind fate to your will. Creatures within 30ft have disadvantage on saves against your abilities.

card_sharp.name: Wheel Spin
card_sharp.description: Spin fate's wheel. Once per combat, force all creatures in 20ft to reroll initiative.

card_sharp.name: Fate Engine
card_sharp.description: Power fate itself. Your abilities that manipulate fate have +1d6 to effect strength.

card_sharp.name: Destiny Weaver
card_sharp.description: Weave threads of destiny. Create fate effects that last 1 minute per rank.

card_sharp.name: Eternal Return
card_sharp.description: Events repeat in your favor. Failed attacks against you can be made again with advantage.

card_sharp.name: Fate Dominator
card_sharp.description: Dominate fate in your domain. Creatures in 60ft cannot benefit from luck or probability effects.

card_sharp.name: House Edge
card_sharp.description: Gain the house edge. All enemy rolls have a 10% chance per rank to be reduced by 1d6.

card_sharp.name: Loaded Dice
card_sharp.description: Load the dice of fate. Once per day, all your rolls for 1 minute have advantage.

card_sharp.name: Cosmic Wheel
card_sharp.description: Control the cosmic wheel of fate. Once per day, dictate the outcome of any event within 100ft.

redemption.name: Lay on Hands
redemption.description: Lay hands on a creature to heal 2d6 HP per rank. Can be used as an action.

redemption.name: Healing Touch
redemption.description: Your touch heals wounds. Spend a 1 action point to heal 1d8 + your level HP.

redemption.name: Restoring Light
redemption.description: Emit restoring light. Heal one condition from an ally within 30ft.

redemption.name: Purify
redemption.description: Purify toxins and diseases. Remove poison and disease effects from one creature.

redemption.name: Cure Wounds
redemption.description: Cure wounds with divine energy. Heal 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

redemption.name: Mass Healing
redemption.description: Heal multiple targets. Heal up to 3 creatures within 30ft for 2d6 HP each.

redemption.name: Greater Restoration
redemption.description: Restore life force completely. Remove all curses, diseases, and poisons from one creature.

redemption.name: Healing Aura
redemption.description: Emit a healing aura. Allies within 20ft regain 2d6 HP at the start of their turns.

redemption.name: Miracle
redemption.description: Perform a miracle. Duplicate any spell of 5th level or lower.

redemption.name: Resurrection
redemption.description: Bring the dead back to life. Restore a creature that has been dead for no more than 10 days.

redemption.name: True Resurrection
redemption.description: True resurrection. Restore a creature that has been dead for any amount of time.

redemption.name: Divine Intervention
redemption.description: Call upon divine intervention. Automatically succeed on one roll or save.

zealot.name: Divine Judgment
zealot.description: Pass divine judgment. Deal 2d6 radiant damage to one creature. Spirit modifier + rank.

zealot.name: Sacred Flame
zealot.description: Ignite enemies with sacred flame. Deal 2d8 radiant damage, no attack roll required.

zealot.name: Wrathful Smite
zealot.description: Smite with divine wrath. Next attack deals +2d6 radiant damage and forces a Spirit save.

zealot.name: Avenging Angel
zealot.description: Become an avenging angel. Gain flying speed and +2 to attack and damage rolls.

zealot.name: Holy Avenger
zealot.description: Wield a holy avenger weapon. Your weapon becomes magical and deals +1d6 radiant damage.

zealot.name: Divine Retribution
zealot.description: Divine retribution strikes down attackers. Deal 2d6 radiant damage when hit in melee.

zealot.name: Crusader Strike
zealot.description: Strike with crusader fury. Deal weapon damage + 2d6 radiant damage, heal for half the damage.

zealot.name: Wrath of Heaven
zealot.description: Call down wrath of heaven. 20ft radius deals 4d6 radiant damage, half to allies.

zealot.name: Sword of Justice
zealot.description: Wield the sword of justice. Attacks ignore resistance and deal maximum damage on critical hits.

zealot.name: Final Judgment
zealot.description: Execute final judgment. Instantly kill a creature with 50 HP or less per rank.

zealot.name: Divine Vengeance
zealot.description: Divine vengeance empowers you. Deal +2d6 radiant damage per rank when an ally is reduced to 0 HP.

zealot.name: Apocalypse
zealot.description: Unleash apocalypse. 60ft radius deals 8d6 radiant damage. Creatures reduced to 0 HP are destroyed.

ascetic.name: Divine Shield
ascetic.description: Create a divine shield that absorbs 2d6 damage per rank. Lasts 1 minute.

ascetic.name: Sacred Barrier
ascetic.description: Create sacred barriers that block enemy movement. 10ft walls per rank, armor 18.

ascetic.name: Protective Aura
ascetic.description: Emit a protective aura. Allies within 10ft gain +1 armor per rank.

ascetic.name: Shield Wall
ascetic.description: Form a shield wall with allies. Adjacent allies gain +2 armor and can use your shield bonus.

ascetic.name: Divine Protection
ascetic.description: Divine protection surrounds you. Resistance to all damage from one source per rank.

ascetic.name: Warding Circle
ascetic.description: Create a warding circle that prevents teleportation and planar travel within 20ft.

ascetic.name: Impenetrable Barrier
ascetic.description: Your barriers become impenetrable. Creatures cannot pass through or attack through them.

ascetic.name: Sanctuary
ascetic.description: Create a sanctuary area. Creatures cannot attack within 15ft of you.

ascetic.name: Fortress of Faith
ascetic.description: Create a fortress of faith. 30ft radius area where allies cannot be critically hit.

ascetic.name: Divine Bulwark
ascetic.description: Become a divine bulwark. Redirect all damage from one ally to yourself per rank.

ascetic.name: Eternal Guardian
ascetic.description: Become an eternal guardian. Immune to unconsciousness while protecting allies.

ascetic.name: Invincible Fortress
ascetic.description: Create an invincible fortress. 50ft radius area is completely protected from all external effects. Allies within the fortress can still be targeted by melee attacks from creatures inside the area.

voidcaller.name: Opening Hymn
voidcaller.description: Your sermons begin with a taste of the void. Generate +1 Madness whenever you deal damage with a spell for the first time each turn. Once per day, unleash void tendrils dealing 2d8 necrotic damage per rank.

voidcaller.name: Congregation's Grasp
voidcaller.description: Your preaching snares the unbelievers. Creatures within 10ft have speed reduced by 10ft per rank. When you generate Madness, affected enemies take 1 psychic damage per Madness point generated.

voidcaller.name: Heretic's Whisper
voidcaller.description: Whisper void scripture that shatters sanity. One creature within 30ft takes 1d6 psychic damage per rank. Each time this damage kills a target, gain 1d4 Madness.

voidcaller.name: Blinding Fervor
voidcaller.description: Your conviction blinds you to danger. When you generate Madness and the roll is maximum (e.g., 4 on 1d4, 6 on 1d6), you generate double the amount. Gain resistance to psychic damage.

voidcaller.name: Hellfire Passage
voidcaller.description: Quote the void god's wrath. 15ft radius deals 3d6 necrotic damage, half to allies. Generates +1d4 Madness when cast.

voidcaller.name: Embrace the Void
voidcaller.description: The void god rewards the faithful. While at 10+ Madness, gain resistance to necrotic damage. Your Madness damage bonus also applies to psychic damage.

voidcaller.name: Anointed Strike
voidcaller.description: Lay hands of the void upon the unbeliever. Next attack deals +2d6 necrotic damage per rank. If this attack drops a target below half HP, generate 1d6 Madness.

voidcaller.name: Resonant Liturgy
voidcaller.description: Your sermons echo with void power. Your sermon spells deal +1d6 damage per rank. Sermon spells generate +1 Madness per rank when cast.

voidcaller.name: Apocalyptic Sermon
voidcaller.description: Deliver the final sermon. 30ft radius deals 4d6 necrotic damage. Damage increases by +1d6 for every 5 Madness you currently have.

voidcaller.name: Beacon of the Void
voidcaller.description: Become a living altar to the void god. Summon a void acolyte that attacks enemies. While the acolyte lives, your Madness generation rolls gain +1.

voidcaller.name: Transcendent Conviction
voidcaller.description: At 15+ Madness, your spells ignore resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. Your Convulsion self-damage is halved.

voidcaller.name: The Final Revelation
voidcaller.description: Preach the end of all things. 60ft radius becomes difficult terrain and deals 2d6 necrotic damage per turn. If cast while at 18+ Madness, the area also silences enemies for 1 round.

deceiver.name: Baptism of Lies
deceiver.description: Your words carry the weight of false divinity. Change your appearance and that of up to 2 allies per rank. When an enemy fails a save against your control spell, gain 1 Madness.

deceiver.name: Seed of Doubt
deceiver.description: Plant doubt in the minds of the faithful. Enemies within 15ft have disadvantage on the first save against your spells each combat. Generates 1d4 Madness when activated.

deceiver.name: False Witness
deceiver.description: Conjure a false witness that testifies against your enemies. Creates a deceptive apparition that deals 2d6 psychic damage per rank to a single target and marks them. Marked targets have -2 to saves against your spells.

deceiver.name: Aura of False Faith
deceiver.description: Emit an aura of corrupted divinity. Enemies within 10ft cannot distinguish friend from foe while you have 6+ Madness.

deceiver.name: False Prophecy
deceiver.description: Deliver a prophecy of the void god. Creatures believe your lies for 1 minute per rank. If you spend Madness to cast this spell, affected creatures also attack their nearest ally once.

deceiver.name: Corrupting Whisper
deceiver.description: Whisper the void god's truth into a target's mind. Charm or frighten creatures within 30ft. The duration increases by 1 round for every 3 Madness you currently have.

deceiver.name: Turn the Faithful
deceiver.description: Turn an enemy's convictions against them. When you successfully charm or confuse an enemy, you may spend 1d6 Madness to make them attack their strongest ally with advantage on their next turn.

deceiver.name: Heresy
deceiver.description: Declare an enemy a heretic in the void god's name. Target is marked for 3 rounds. Marked enemies take psychic damage equal to your current Madness whenever they attack you. Generates 1d6 Madness when cast.

deceiver.name: Congregation of Doubt
deceiver.description: Preach doubt to the masses. All enemies within 20ft must save or become confused for 2 rounds. Each enemy that fails generates 1 Madness for you.

deceiver.name: Rewrite Truth
deceiver.description: Warp what your enemies perceive as reality. Teleport creatures or objects within 60ft. Spending Madness on this spell allows you to reposition enemies into hazardous terrain. Costs 1d4 Madness per target moved.

deceiver.name: The Grand Lie
deceiver.description: Your deceptions become indistinguishable from truth. Enemies automatically fail their first save each combat against your control spells. If you have 12+ Madness, this also applies to their second save.

deceiver.name: Storm of Lies
deceiver.description: Unleash a torrent of void scripture. 30ft radius filled with damaging whispers dealing 3d6 psychic damage per rank. Enemies damaged by this have disadvantage on saves against your next control spell. Generates 1d8 Madness.

deceiver.name: Shatter the Faith
deceiver.description: Destroy everything your enemies believe. Create a 60ft zone for 3 rounds where you control all perception. Enemies in the zone see allies as enemies and enemies as allies. Each round, enemies in the zone generate 1d4 Madness for you. Costs 2d6 Madness to cast.

cultist.name: Profane Communion
cultist.description: Perform the void god's first rite. Sacrifice hit points to gain temporary hit points (2 per HP sacrificed). When you sacrifice HP this way, generate 1d4 Madness per rank.

cultist.name: Curse of the Unbeliever
cultist.description: Curse enemies with the void god's torment. Target takes 1d6 necrotic damage per turn for 1 minute. For every 3 Madness you have, this curse also reduces the target's speed by 5ft.

cultist.name: Summon Void Acolyte
cultist.description: Summon a void acolyte to perform your rites. It has armor 13 and deals 1d6 necrotic damage. When the acolyte hits an enemy, you generate 1 Madness.

cultist.name: Blood Offering
cultist.description: Offer blood to the void god. Deal 2d6 necrotic damage to yourself, allies regain 3d6 HP. You generate 1d6 Madness and your next curse spell costs no mana.

cultist.name: Pact of the Void
cultist.description: Form a pact with the void god. Your summoned creatures gain +1 damage per 3 Madness you have. You may spend 1d4 Madness to refresh a summon's duration.

cultist.name: Forbidden Scripture
cultist.description: Study the void god's hidden texts. Learn additional curse and ritual spells. Your spending spells are 15% more efficient per rank (round up fractions).

cultist.name: Ritual Empowerment
cultist.description: Your rituals draw power from your madness. +1d6 to spell damage per rank while at 10+ Madness. Spending Madness on spells heals you for 2 HP per point spent plus your proficiency bonus.

cultist.name: Congregation of the Void
cultist.description: Summon a congregation of void entities. Create 1d4 additional void acolytes per rank. Each acolyte that dies generates 1d4 Madness for you.

cultist.name: Shepherd of the Void
cultist.description: Master the art of leading the void god's flock. Summoned creatures have +2 armor and damage per rank. Your Curse of the Unbeliever spreads to 1 additional target per rank when the original target dies.

cultist.name: Channel the Void God
cultist.description: Become a direct conduit for the void god's power. Your spells ignore spell resistance. When you trigger Insanity Convulsion, you may choose the result instead of rolling.

cultist.name: Void Priest
cultist.description: Summon a powerful void priest to preach alongside you. It casts curses autonomously and generates 1d6 Madness for you each round it survives.

cultist.name: Invocation of the Void God
cultist.description: Perform the ultimate rite. Summon an avatar of the void god for 3 rounds. It deals 4d6 necrotic damage per turn to all enemies within 30ft. While active, your Madness does not reset from Convulsion—instead, you retain half your current Madness (rounded down). Costs 1d8 Madness to cast.

demonologist.name: Binding Sigil
demonologist.description: Your binding rituals are more efficient. Reduce mana cost of all binding spells by 5 per rank.

demonologist.name: Legion Mind
demonologist.description: Your mind splits to track multiple demons. +1 demon slot per rank (max 4 total).

demonologist.name: Steady Rein
demonologist.description: Dominance Die degrades every 2 actions instead of every action for demons you command. Your grip holds longer.

demonologist.name: Mass Restoration
demonologist.description: When you cast a DD restoration spell, all bound demons gain +1 DD step as well (half effect on non-targeted demons).

demonologist.name: Swarm Tactics
demonologist.description: When 3+ demons attack the same target, each deals +1d6 bonus damage per rank. The legion overwhelms.

demonologist.name: Economical Dominance
demonologist.description: Reduce mana cost of all DD restoration spells by 1 per rank. Control becomes cheaper with experience.

demonologist.name: Quick Dismiss
demonologist.description: Dismissing a demon at d6 DD or higher refunds 50% of its binding mana cost. Strategic retreat has its rewards.

demonologist.name: Chain Resonance
demonologist.description: When one demon escapes, all remaining demons' DD improves by 1 step. Fear of loss strengthens your remaining grip.

demonologist.name: Demon Synergy
demonologist.description: Each demon beyond the first grants +1d4 damage to all other demons' attacks. They compete for your favor.

demonologist.name: Iron Will
demonologist.description: When a demon reaches 0 DD, it gains advantage on its escape save (you roll twice, take better result for the demon). Wait — this helps YOU. The demon has disadvantage on escape saves.

demonologist.name: Demon Cyclone
demonologist.description: Once per combat: Command all demons to attack simultaneously. Each degrades DD by 1 step but deals +2d6 damage.

demonologist.name: Infernal General
demonologist.description: Your demons no longer degrade DD on the first action each turn. Only subsequent actions cost DD. You are the undisputed commander of the legion.

demon_lord.name: Infernal Pact
demon_lord.description: Forge a deeper bond with your single demon. It gains +1d6 damage per rank and you gain resistance to its damage type.

demon_lord.name: Iron Grip
demon_lord.description: Your demon's DD degrades every 2 actions instead of every action. Your singular focus yields stronger control.

demon_lord.name: Shared Will
demon_lord.description: When your demon takes damage, you may redirect up to half to yourself. Pain shared is dominance maintained.

demon_lord.name: Empowered Strikes
demon_lord.description: Your demon's attacks deal +1d8 damage per rank. When your demon crits, restore 1 DD step.

demon_lord.name: Fel Presence
demon_lord.description: Enemies within 10ft of your demon have disadvantage on attacks against it. Your demon radiates terrifying authority.

demon_lord.name: Demon Armor
demon_lord.description: Gain +2 armor per rank while your demon is bound. Its power bleeds into you, fortifying your mortal frame.

demon_lord.name: Dominant Wrath
demon_lord.description: When your demon is at d8 DD or lower, it deals +2d8 damage. Desperation sharpens its fury — and your grip.

demon_lord.name: Soul Tether
demon_lord.description: When your demon kills an enemy, restore 1 DD step. Each soul claimed reinforces the chain between you.

demon_lord.name: Greater Binding
demon_lord.description: Your demon's starting DD improves by 1 step (d6→d8, d8→d10). Can bind Tier 4 Greater Demons.

demon_lord.name: Infernal Surge
demon_lord.description: Once per combat: Your demon takes 3 actions in a single turn without DD degradation. The leash snaps tight.

demon_lord.name: Throne of Will
demon_lord.description: Your demon cannot escape while you have more than 50% HP. At 0 DD, instead of escaping, it becomes stunned for 1 turn then resets to d6. You are its god.

demon_lord.name: Become Demon Lord
demon_lord.description: Transform into a Demon Lord for 6 rounds. Gain +6 Str, +4 Con, immunity to fear, and your bound demon doubles all damage. When it ends, take 4d10 psychic damage.

possessed.name: Demonic Embrace
possessed.description: Channel a demon within yourself. Your Internal DD starts at d10. Melee attacks deal +1d6 necrotic damage per rank but degrade your Internal DD by 1 step.

possessed.name: Held Leash
possessed.description: Internal DD only degrades every 2 demon-ability uses instead of every use. Your iron will holds the beast at bay.

possessed.name: Mutated Form
possessed.description: Your body adapts to the demon within. +2 Strength per rank and resistance to necrotic damage.

possessed.name: Demonic Regeneration
possessed.description: At the start of your turn, if Internal DD is d8 or higher, regenerate 1d8 HP per rank. The demon sustains its vessel.

possessed.name: Corruption Aura
possessed.description: Enemies within 10ft take 1d6 necrotic damage per rank at the start of their turn. The demon bleeds into the world around you.

possessed.name: Tendril Strike
possessed.description: Attack with demonic tendrils (15ft reach) for weapon damage + 2d6 necrotic. Degrades Internal DD by 1 step.

possessed.name: Inner Peace
possessed.description: When your Internal DD reaches 0 and the demon takes over, you regain control after 1 turn instead of 2. Additionally, the demon's turn deals +2d6 damage to enemies (not allies) per rank.

possessed.name: Demon Form
possessed.description: Activate for 1 AP: Enter demon form for 3 rounds. +2 armor, darkvision, immunity to poison. Internal DD degrades by 1 step per round while active.

possessed.name: Corruption Nova
possessed.description: Unleash the demon's fury in a 20ft burst. Deal 3d6 necrotic damage per rank. Resets Internal DD to d6 regardless of current level. The beast exhausts itself.

possessed.name: Harmonious Duality
possessed.description: When you restore your Internal DD, gain temporary HP equal to the die size × 2 (d10 = 20 temp HP). Control brings vitality.

possessed.name: Abyssal Armor
possessed.description: Gain +3 armor and resistance to all damage while Internal DD is d8 or higher. The demon shields its prison.

possessed.name: Demon Prince
possessed.description: You no longer lose control when Internal DD reaches 0. Instead, enter Ascended Form for 3 rounds: +8 Str, +6 Con, attacks deal 4d10 necrotic. After Ascended Form ends, take 4d10 psychic damage and Internal DD resets to d6.

seer.name: Clairvoyance
seer.description: Spend 2 Visions to see and hear a creature within 1 mile for 1 minute. Range increases by 1 mile per rank.

seer.name: Future Vision
seer.description: Spend 1 Vision to glimpse a possible future, gaining advantage on your next attack roll or save. +1 use per rank before needing to spend again.

seer.name: Prescience
seer.description: Sense immediate threats. Passive: You cannot be surprised and have +1 armor against opportunity attacks per rank.

seer.name: Fortune Telling
seer.description: Spend 1 Vision to read fortunes and ask the DM 1 yes/no question about the future per rank.

seer.name: Prophecy
seer.description: Passive: Creatures within 30ft have disadvantage on deception checks against you. Range increases by 10ft per rank.

seer.name: Foresight
seer.description: Passive: See the immediate future. You cannot be surprised and attacks against you have disadvantage.

seer.name: True Seeing
seer.description: Passive: See through illusions and invisibility. Automatically detect hidden creatures within 30ft.

seer.name: Scrying
seer.description: Spend 3 Visions to scry on a creature you have seen within the last 24 hours. Duration increases by 10 minutes per rank.

seer.name: Oracle of Fate
seer.description: Passive: See the active buffs, debuffs, and status effects of creatures within 60ft (but not raw HP/armor). Gain +1 Vision when you witness a buff or debuff be applied.

seer.name: Fate Reveal
seer.description: Spend 2 Visions to learn one secret or weakness about a creature you can see.

seer.name: Timeless Body
seer.description: Passive: Your body becomes timeless. You age at half the normal rate and are immune to magical aging.

seer.name: Foresight Supreme
seer.description: Passive: Achieve supreme foresight. You can see 1 minute into the future and act accordingly.

seer.name: Prophetic Visions
seer.description: Spend 5 Visions to receive a vision of a major future event (GM provides meaningful foreshadowing).

seer.name: Divine Omniscience
seer.description: Passive: Achieve divine omniscience. You know everything that happens within 1 mile and can see all possible futures.

truthseeker.name: Detect Lies
truthseeker.description: Passive: Automatically detect lies. Creatures have disadvantage on deception checks against you. Can detect lies from +1 creature per rank.

truthseeker.name: Reveal Hidden
truthseeker.description: Spend 1 Vision to learn if a creature is lying about a specific topic. +1 use per rank before needing to spend again.

truthseeker.name: Past Vision
truthseeker.description: Spend 2 Visions to witness an event that occurred up to 24 hours ago within 30 feet of your location.

truthseeker.name: Exploit Weakness
truthseeker.description: Passive: When you reveal a hidden truth about an enemy, you and your allies gain +1 to attack rolls against them for 1 round per rank.

truthseeker.name: Zone of Truth
truthseeker.description: Spend 2 Visions to create a zone of truth. Creatures in 15ft radius cannot lie and illusions are revealed for 10 minutes.

truthseeker.name: Mind Reading
truthseeker.description: Spend 2 Visions to read a creature's surface thoughts for 1 minute. Target gets a Spirit save to resist.

truthseeker.name: Historical Knowledge
truthseeker.description: Passive: You know the history of any location or object you examine. Spend 1 Vision for deep historical detail.

truthseeker.name: Discern Lies
truthseeker.description: Passive: When you detect a lie, spend 1 Vision to compel the liar to reveal one additional truth they were trying to hide. The target gets a Spirit save to resist. Gain 1 Vision per forced truth revealed.

truthseeker.name: True Sight
truthseeker.description: Passive: See through all illusions, invisibility, and detect all hidden creatures within 60ft.

truthseeker.name: Legend Lore
truthseeker.description: Spend 3 Visions to learn the complete history and purpose of any object or location, including magical properties.

truthseeker.name: Deep Memory
truthseeker.description: Spend 3 Visions to extract forgotten or suppressed memories from a creature or object. Target gets a Spirit save to resist.

truthseeker.name: Reality Check
truthseeker.description: Spend 1 Vision to determine if something within your sight is an illusion or real. Automatically dispels minor illusions.

truthseeker.name: Omniscient Truth
truthseeker.description: Passive: You know all truths, see all illusions, and can reveal any hidden knowledge. Activated: Spend 5 Visions to force absolute truth from any creature for 1 minute (no save).

fateseer.name: Fate Binding
fateseer.description: Spend 1 Vision to bind a thread of fate. Force a creature to reroll an attack, save, or check. You must have predicted the original outcome.

fateseer.name: Lucky Break
fateseer.description: Spend 1 Vision to grant yourself or an ally advantage on any roll. You must declare this BEFORE the roll is made (foresight required). +1 use per rank before spending again.

fateseer.name: Ill Omen
fateseer.description: Spend 2 Visions to curse a creature with ill fortune. They reroll their next successful roll and must take the new result. You must have predicted their success.

fateseer.name: Fate Link
fateseer.description: Passive: When you take damage, spend 1 Vision to redirect up to half of it to another creature within 30ft.

fateseer.name: Twist Fate
fateseer.description: Spend 2 Visions to change any die roll result by ±1d6 per rank. Requires a correct prediction this combat.

fateseer.name: Cursed Fate
fateseer.description: Spend 3 Visions to give a creature disadvantage on all rolls for 1 minute. Requires a correct prediction about the target this combat.

fateseer.name: Fate Sever
fateseer.description: Spend 3 Visions to sever a fate thread, ending one magical effect or condition affecting a creature. You must have predicted the effect.

fateseer.name: Destiny Weave
fateseer.description: Spend 4 Visions to weave new destinies. Give yourself or an ally +2d6 to all rolls for 1 minute. Requires a correct specific prediction this combat.

fateseer.name: Rewrite Fate
fateseer.description: Spend 5 Visions to retroactively change one event from the last minute. Requires a correct precise prediction about the event.

fateseer.name: Fate Shield
fateseer.description: Passive: When you or an ally within 30ft fails a saving throw, spend 4 Visions to automatically succeed instead.

fateseer.name: Fateseer Supreme
fateseer.description: Passive: All your correct predictions generate +1 bonus Vision. Activated: Spend 8 Visions to become untouchable for 1 round — all attacks against you automatically miss and all your attacks automatically hit (but do not crit unless they would naturally).

virulent_spreader.name: Field Seeding
virulent_spreader.description: Base affliction spells apply to 1 additional adjacent target per rank. Both targets receive the same Seed.

virulent_spreader.name: Rapid Contagion
virulent_spreader.description: Fester category spells have +10ft spread range per rank. Contagion triggers deal +1d4 damage per rank.

virulent_spreader.name: Virulence Surge
virulent_spreader.description: +2 Virulence gained per rank when afflictions spread through contagion.

virulent_spreader.name: Auto-Contagion
virulent_spreader.description: When an affliction reaches Stage 2+, it auto-spreads to 1 adjacent enemy as a Stage 0 Seed. +1 target per rank.

virulent_spreader.name: Chain Infection
virulent_spreader.description: Spread afflictions can trigger secondary spreads. +10% chance per rank.

virulent_spreader.name: Pandemic Wave
virulent_spreader.description: Fester category spells affect all enemies within 10ft per rank of the primary target.

virulent_spreader.name: Viral Burst
virulent_spreader.description: When any affliction reaches its final form, it spreads to all enemies within 15ft as Stage 0 Seeds.

virulent_spreader.name: Infectious Aura
virulent_spreader.description: Enemies within 10ft of any target with a Stage 1+ affliction gain a Stage 0 Seed. +5ft radius per rank.

virulent_spreader.name: Wide Harvest
virulent_spreader.description: Harvest finales (Amplify ending) also deal 50% of their damage to all enemies within 15ft per rank of the target.

virulent_spreader.name: Plague Zone
virulent_spreader.description: Create a 20ft zone lasting 2 rounds per rank. Enemies entering gain a random Stage 0 Seed affliction.

virulent_spreader.name: Global Pandemic
virulent_spreader.description: Once per combat: All active afflictions spread to 1 new target each per rank. Spread afflictions retain their current stage.

torment_weaver.name: Psychic Link
torment_weaver.description: When multiple targets have the same base affliction, they become linked. Cultivating one advances all linked targets. Max 2 + 1 per rank linked targets.

torment_weaver.name: Resonance Damage
torment_weaver.description: When any linked affliction is activated (advanced, ticks, spreads), all linked targets take +1d4 psychic damage per rank.

torment_weaver.name: Shared Torment
torment_weaver.description: Torment category effects on one linked target also apply to 1 additional linked target per rank at 50% potency.

torment_weaver.name: Web Cultivation
torment_weaver.description: Casting any category spell on a linked target costs 1 less mana per rank (minimum 1).

torment_weaver.name: Nightmare Fuel
torment_weaver.description: Psychic afflictions reduce enemy spell attack rolls by 1 per rank. Linked targets have shared reduced Spirit saves.

torment_weaver.name: Cascade Finale
torment_weaver.description: When a final form triggers on a linked target, all linked targets suffer 50% of the finale effect per rank.

torment_weaver.name: Psychic Storm
torment_weaver.description: Create a 30ft storm for 3 rounds. Linked targets inside take 1d8 psychic/turn per rank. Non-linked enemies take half.

torment_weaver.name: Psychic Nexus
torment_weaver.description: Once per combat: All psychic links become permanent (persist even if base affliction type differs). Linked finales now trigger at 75% potency on all linked targets.

decay_harbinger.name: Infinite Growth
decay_harbinger.description: Afflictions have no final form. After Stage 3, each category spell adds permanent stacks instead. Max 15 stacks per target. +1 permanent stack type unlocked per rank.

decay_harbinger.name: Accelerated Rot
decay_harbinger.description: Permanent stacks from Decay category deal +1d4 necrotic/turn per rank. All permanent stacks last until Greater Restoration.

decay_harbinger.name: Dark Rejuvenation
decay_harbinger.description: When any permanent stack is applied, you heal for 1d4 HP per rank. Afflicted enemies' healing is reduced by 1d6 per rank.

decay_harbinger.name: Withering Touch
decay_harbinger.description: Decay category permanent stacks also reduce healing received by 10% per rank for 3 rounds. Stacks with itself.

decay_harbinger.name: Necrotic Burst
decay_harbinger.description: When a target reaches 5+ permanent stacks, they burst for 2d8 necrotic in 15ft radius per rank. Can trigger once per target per combat.

decay_harbinger.name: Life Drain
decay_harbinger.description: When stacked enemies take damage from any source, you heal for 1d6 HP per rank per 5 permanent stacks on that target.

decay_harbinger.name: Withering Aura
decay_harbinger.description: Targets with 5+ permanent stacks emit a 20ft aura: no healing, 1d6 necrotic/turn per rank to enemies within.

decay_harbinger.name: Eternal Rot
decay_harbinger.description: Permanent stacks from any category persist even AFTER combat ends. +1 additional permanent stack per rank applied per category spell post-Stage 3.

decay_harbinger.name: Vampiric Decay
decay_harbinger.description: Life Drain heals for double when triggered by Decay category spells. Gain 5 temporary HP per rank per permanent stack on the target.

decay_harbinger.name: Necrotic Dominion
decay_harbinger.description: All enemies within 40ft of targets with 10+ permanent stacks have healing reduced by 50%. You gain 25% lifesteal on all damage to stacked targets.

decay_harbinger.name: Total Collapse
decay_harbinger.description: When a target with 10+ permanent stacks dies, all their stacks spread to enemies within 20ft as fresh Stage 0 Seeds with 3 permanent stacks each.

decay_harbinger.name: Apocalyptic Decay
decay_harbinger.description: All Decay category spells affect all enemies within 25ft of the target. Each enemy hit gains permanent stacks independently.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Eternal Focus
frostbound_tyrant.description: Your Eternal Frost Aura reduces chill duration to 1 round instead of 1 turn. +1 to chill save DC per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Chilling Presence
frostbound_tyrant.description: Enemies within 10ft of frozen targets must save or be chilled. +5ft radius per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Frozen Precision
frostbound_tyrant.description: Frost spells have +1d4 bonus to hit frozen targets. Bonus increases by +1d4 per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Glacial Shards
frostbound_tyrant.description: Frozen targets that take damage shatter, dealing 1d6 frost damage to adjacent enemies per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Ice Bond
frostbound_tyrant.description: Frozen targets share 50% of damage taken with other frozen targets within 20ft. Sharing range increases by 5ft per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Crystal Fracture
frostbound_tyrant.description: When you freeze a target, adjacent frozen targets have their freeze duration extended by 1 round per rank. Extension range increases by 5ft per rank.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Permafrost Dominion
frostbound_tyrant.description: Frozen targets cannot be healed. Healing effects on frozen targets instead deal frost damage equal to healing amount.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Absolute Zero
frostbound_tyrant.description: Frozen targets have vulnerability to all damage. +1d6 frost damage per rank to frozen targets.

frostbound_tyrant.name: Shatter Protocol
frostbound_tyrant.description: When a frozen enemy takes damage, there is a 50% chance they Shatter, taking an additional 3d6 frost damage per rank but the freeze ends immediately. Creates an active freeze-shatter-refreeze loop.

spectral_reaper.name: Necrotic Essence
spectral_reaper.description: Your frost spells deal +1d4 necrotic damage per rank. Every enemy killed by your spells rises as a spectral minion (guaranteed, max 4 minions, lasts 1d4 rounds).

spectral_reaper.name: Deathly Echo
spectral_reaper.description: When an enemy dies from your hybrid spells, they explode, dealing 1d8 necrotic damage in 10ft radius per rank.

spectral_reaper.name: Spectral Harvest
spectral_reaper.description: Spectral minions deal +1d6 damage per rank. Minions last 2 additional rounds.

spectral_reaper.name: Reaper Command
spectral_reaper.description: Command up to 2 spectral minions per rank as a 1 action point. Minions can attack or defend. Minion HP increases by 1d6 per rank.

spectral_reaper.name: Spectral Swarm
spectral_reaper.description: When you have 3+ spectral minions, they form a swarm, dealing 2d6 necrotic damage per rank to enemies in 15ft. Swarm radius increases by 5ft per rank. Minions gain +2 HP per rank.

spectral_reaper.name: Necrotic Link
spectral_reaper.description: Spectral minions share 50% of damage taken by you. You heal for 1d6 HP per rank when a minion dies. Minions gain +1 armor per rank.

spectral_reaper.name: Deathly Precision
spectral_reaper.description: Hybrid spells ignore resistance to frost or necrotic damage. +10% to hit per rank vs undead targets. +1d4 necrotic damage per rank to undead.

spectral_reaper.name: Obliteration Wave
spectral_reaper.description: Frost spells create waves of necrotic energy, dealing 1d8 necrotic damage per rank to enemies in 10ft line.

spectral_reaper.name: Necrotic Dominion
spectral_reaper.description: All enemies within 30ft take 1d6 necrotic damage per round per rank. Damage doubled vs undead.

spectral_reaper.name: Spectral Legion
spectral_reaper.description: Spectral minions can merge into a powerful wraith, dealing 3d8 necrotic damage per rank and controlling minds.

spectral_reaper.name: Apocalyptic Harvest
spectral_reaper.description: When you kill an enemy, all spectral minions deal their damage again to nearby enemies. +1 max minion per rank (up to 6 total).

phylactery_guardian.name: Soul Anchor
phylactery_guardian.description: Phylactery kill charge increased to +1d8 HP per rank (instead of +1d6). +2 HP maximum storage per rank. Death Trigger freeze radius increased by 5ft per rank.

phylactery_guardian.name: Vital Reserve
phylactery_guardian.description: Maximum Phylactery HP increased by 10 per rank. Kill charge grants an additional +1d4 HP per rank. Store HP from kills more efficiently.

phylactery_guardian.name: Deathly Resilience
phylactery_guardian.description: Reduce Phylactery resurrection cost by 1 HP per rank. Resurrection revives you with +2 HP per rank.

phylactery_guardian.name: Ice Shield
phylactery_guardian.description: While Eternal Frost Aura is active, gain +2 armor per rank. Aura drain reduced by 1d6 HP.

phylactery_guardian.name: Frost Barrier
phylactery_guardian.description: Create barriers of ice that absorb damage. Barrier has 3d6 HP per rank and lasts 2 rounds.

phylactery_guardian.name: Phylactery Link
phylactery_guardian.description: Allies within 30ft can spend 5 HP to reduce damage you take by 1d6 per rank. Link range increases by 10ft per rank.

phylactery_guardian.name: Emergency Resurrection
phylactery_guardian.description: Once per combat, automatically resurrect when reduced below 0 HP (costs double Phylactery HP).

phylactery_guardian.name: Eternal Guardian
phylactery_guardian.description: Phylactery creates a protective field, reducing all damage by 2 per rank. Field lasts while Phylactery has HP.

phylactery_guardian.name: Soul Siphon
phylactery_guardian.description: When enemies die within 30ft (regardless of who killed them), automatically store 1d4 HP per rank in Phylactery (maximum once per round). Siphon range increases by 10ft per rank.

phylactery_guardian.name: Immortal Essence
phylactery_guardian.description: Once per combat, if your Phylactery has 20+ HP, resurrection costs only 20 Phylactery HP instead of all stored HP. You revive with full Phylactery HP minus the cost. If Phylactery is below 20 HP, resurrection works normally (spends all stored).

arcane_warden.name: Arcane Absorption
arcane_warden.description: Passively absorb magical damage. Gain 2 AEP for every point of fire, cold, lightning, or necrotic damage taken. Gain 1 AEP for every 2 points of physical damage taken.

arcane_warden.name: Enhanced Shielding
arcane_warden.description: Your Arcane Shield absorbs +20 damage per rank and lasts +1 minute per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Warden's Fortitude
arcane_warden.description: While you have an active shield, gain +1 armor per rank and +5% resistance to all damage per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Absorption Mastery
arcane_warden.description: Gain +1 AEP per rank from all magical damage absorbed.

arcane_warden.name: Barrier of Protection
arcane_warden.description: Barrier of Protection costs -5 AEP per rank and affects +1 additional ally per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Mass Shielding
arcane_warden.description: All shield abilities absorb +15 damage per rank and last +30 seconds per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Arcane Overflow
arcane_warden.description: When your shields absorb damage, gain +1 AEP per 3 damage absorbed per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Elemental Resistance
arcane_warden.description: Elemental Resistance grants +1 resistance per rank to chosen element and lasts +1 minute per rank.

arcane_warden.name: Energy Conversion
arcane_warden.description: Convert 1 additional AEP per rank from physical damage.

arcane_warden.name: Fortress Mode
arcane_warden.description: Activate Fortress Mode: All active shields absorb double damage and you gain immunity to magical damage for 1 turn. Costs 25 AEP.

arcane_warden.name: Warden's Sacrifice
arcane_warden.description: Spend 20 AEP to redirect all damage from a single ally to you for 1 minute.

arcane_warden.name: Anti-Magic Zone
arcane_warden.description: Create a 15ft anti-magic zone for 1 minute. Spells cast in the zone cost +3 mana per rank. Costs 20 AEP.

arcane_warden.name: Ultimate Ward
arcane_warden.description: Create an Ultimate Ward that absorbs 50 damage and prevents all magical effects. Costs 30 AEP, lasts 1 minute.

spell_breaker.name: Spell Reflection
spell_breaker.description: Passively absorb magical damage. Gain 2 AEP for every point of fire, cold, lightning, or necrotic damage taken. Gain 1 AEP for every 2 points of physical damage taken.

spell_breaker.name: Reflective Barrier
spell_breaker.description: Reflective Barrier costs -5 AEP per rank and reflects +25% damage per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Spell Disruption
spell_breaker.description: Spell Disruption costs -5 AEP per rank and has +10% success chance per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Counter Magic
spell_breaker.description: When you successfully reflect a spell, gain +2 AEP per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Mirror Shield
spell_breaker.description: Create a mirror shield that reflects the next 2 spells per rank cast at you.

spell_breaker.name: Reflection Chain
spell_breaker.description: When you reflect a spell, the next reflection costs -10 AEP per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Echo Damage
spell_breaker.description: Reflected spells deal +1d6 arcane damage per rank to the caster.

spell_breaker.name: Mana Burn
spell_breaker.description: Reflected spells burn 1d4 mana per rank from the caster.

spell_breaker.name: Spell Echo
spell_breaker.description: After reflecting a spell, you can cast the same spell once per rank this turn.

spell_breaker.name: Perfect Reflection
spell_breaker.description: Reflected spells are uncounterable and deal maximum damage per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Mirror Field
spell_breaker.description: Create a 20ft mirror field. Spells targeting allies within the field are reflected back at the caster. Costs 20 AEP.

spell_breaker.name: Spell Nullification
spell_breaker.description: Instead of reflecting, you can nullify a spell completely, gaining 3 AEP per spell level per rank.

spell_breaker.name: Reflection Nova
spell_breaker.description: Release a nova of reflected energy, reflecting all spells cast at you this turn and dealing 4d6 arcane damage per reflected spell in 30ft radius. Costs 30 AEP.

mana_reaver.name: Mana Drain
mana_reaver.description: Passively absorb magical damage. Gain 2 AEP for every point of fire, cold, lightning, or necrotic damage taken. Gain 1 AEP for every 2 points of physical damage taken.

mana_reaver.name: Empowered Strike
mana_reaver.description: Empowered Strike costs -5 AEP per rank and deals +1d6 arcane damage per rank.

mana_reaver.name: Mana Vampirism
mana_reaver.description: Melee attacks drain +1 mana per rank and heal you for 1 HP per mana drained.

mana_reaver.name: Arcane Strike
mana_reaver.description: Arcane Strike costs -5 AEP per rank and silences targets for +1 turn per rank.

mana_reaver.name: Drain Specialization
mana_reaver.description: Choose a damage type. Melee attacks drain +50% mana per rank from targets vulnerable to that damage type.

mana_reaver.name: Burst Damage
mana_reaver.description: After draining mana, your next attack deals +1d4 arcane damage per 5 mana drained per rank.

mana_reaver.name: Mana Burn
mana_reaver.description: When you drain mana, target takes 1 arcane damage per 2 mana drained per rank.

mana_reaver.name: Vampiric Empowerment
mana_reaver.description: For every 10 mana drained per rank, your next melee attack gains +1 to hit and damage.

mana_reaver.name: Energy Surge
mana_reaver.description: Spend 15 AEP to instantly restore mana equal to twice the AEP spent.

mana_reaver.name: Overcharge
mana_reaver.description: Your melee attacks can drain up to 2x normal mana per rank, but you take 1 damage per excess mana.

mana_reaver.name: Arcane Combustion
mana_reaver.description: When you kill a target with a melee attack, deal 3d6 arcane damage per rank to all enemies within 10ft.

mana_reaver.name: Spell Theft
mana_reaver.description: When you drain mana from a spellcaster, you can steal one of their prepared spells per rank (usable once before disappearing).

mana_reaver.name: Mana Rend
mana_reaver.description: Ultimate ability: Rend all mana from target creature within 30ft. Gain 5 AEP per 10 mana drained. Target cannot cast spells for 1 minute. Costs 25 AEP.

runebinder.name: Runic Mastery
runebinder.description: Gain 1 Runic Resonance whenever you place a rune. While you have 5+ Resonance, runes deal +1 force damage per rank to enemies entering their radius.

runebinder.name: Zone Amplification
runebinder.description: Runes in zones deal +1d4 damage per rank. Zones have +5 ft radius per rank.

runebinder.name: Rune Efficiency
runebinder.description: Rune placement costs -1 mana per rank (minimum 1). Runes last +10 seconds per rank.

runebinder.name: Zone Control
runebinder.description: Enemies in zones have -1 to saves per rank. Can move runes 5 ft per rank as a 1 action point.

runebinder.name: Damage Runes
runebinder.description: Create damage runes that deal 2d6 force damage per rank when stepped on. Maximum 3 runes per rank.

runebinder.name: Barrier Runes
runebinder.description: Create barrier runes that block movement. Creatures must succeed on DC 12 + rank Strength save or be stopped.

runebinder.name: Zone Empowerment
runebinder.description: Zones grant +1 to spell attack rolls per rank. Spells in zones have advantage on attack rolls.

runebinder.name: Rune Chain
runebinder.description: When a rune activates, adjacent runes have 25% chance per rank to activate as well.

runebinder.name: Control Runes
runebinder.description: Create control runes that apply conditions. Choose from: slow, silence, or blind. DC 13 + rank.

runebinder.name: Teleport Runes
runebinder.description: Create paired teleport runes. Creatures stepping on one rune teleport to the paired rune.

runebinder.name: Zone Mastery
runebinder.description: Create zones with 2 runes instead of 3. Zones can overlap and stack effects per rank.

runebinder.name: Runic Devastation
runebinder.description: Detonate all runes simultaneously. Each rune deals 4d6 damage per rank in 15 ft radius, total damage cannot exceed 50d6.

enchanter.name: Enchantment Mastery
enchanter.description: Gain 1 Runic Resonance whenever an inscription effect triggers (weapon hit, armor block, etc.). While you have 5+ Resonance, inscriptions are 10% more effective per rank.

enchanter.name: Weapon Enhancement
enchanter.description: Weapon inscriptions grant +1 to attack and damage rolls per rank.

enchanter.name: Armor Enhancement
enchanter.description: Armor inscriptions grant +1 armor per rank.

enchanter.name: Elemental Weapon
enchanter.description: Weapons gain elemental damage. Choose fire, cold, lightning, or force. Deals 1d6 per rank.

enchanter.name: Accessory Enhancement
enchanter.description: Accessory inscriptions grant +1 to saves per rank.

enchanter.name: Defensive Armor
enchanter.description: Armor grants resistance to chosen damage type per rank (fire, cold, lightning, force).

enchanter.name: Utility Enchantment
enchanter.description: Accessories provide utility effects: +10 ft movement, darkvision, or advantage on stealth checks.

enchanter.name: Magical Armor
enchanter.description: Armor provides +2 armor against magical attacks per rank.

enchanter.name: Power Accessory
enchanter.description: Accessories restore 1d6 mana per rank when you cast a spell.

enchanter.name: Enchantment Duration
enchanter.description: All enchantments last +1 hour per rank (maximum 24 hours).

enchanter.name: Enchantment Sharing
enchanter.description: Enchantments can be shared with adjacent allies within 5 ft per rank.

enchanter.name: Enchantment Efficiency
enchanter.description: Enchantment costs -2 mana per rank (minimum 1). Enchantments take -1 action per rank to apply.

enchanter.name: Legendary Enchantment
enchanter.description: Create a legendary enchantment that grants +3 to all rolls, resistance to all damage, and 3d6 temporary HP per rank for 1 minute.

glyphweaver.name: Glyph Mastery
glyphweaver.description: Gain 2 Runic Resonance whenever you detonate a rune. While you have 5+ Resonance, detonation radius increases by 5 ft per rank.

glyphweaver.name: Detonation Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create detonation glyphs that explode for 3d6 fire damage per rank in 10 ft radius when triggered.

glyphweaver.name: Chain Reaction
glyphweaver.description: When a glyph detonates, adjacent glyphs have 50% chance per rank to detonate as well.

glyphweaver.name: Glyph Efficiency
glyphweaver.description: Glyph placement costs -1 mana per rank. Glyphs last +30 seconds per rank.

glyphweaver.name: Damage Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create damage glyphs that deal 2d8 force damage per rank. Can chain to other damage glyphs.

glyphweaver.name: Control Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create control glyphs that apply stun, slow, or silence. DC 14 + rank.

glyphweaver.name: Empowerment Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create empowerment glyphs that grant +2 to attack rolls per rank to allies within 5 ft.

glyphweaver.name: Healing Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create healing glyphs that restore 2d6 HP per rank when allies step on them.

glyphweaver.name: Teleport Glyph
glyphweaver.description: Create paired teleport glyphs. Creatures teleport between pairs. Maximum 2 pairs per rank.

glyphweaver.name: Glyph Overload
glyphweaver.description: Overload glyphs to increase damage by 50% per rank, but they become unstable and may detonate prematurely.

glyphweaver.name: Glyph Network
glyphweaver.description: Create glyph networks that share effects. Networks have +10 ft range per rank.

glyphweaver.name: Glyph Synchronization
glyphweaver.description: All glyphs within 20 ft activate simultaneously per rank. Can choose activation order.

glyphweaver.name: Cataclysmic Chain
glyphweaver.description: Trigger a cataclysmic chain reaction. All glyphs detonate in sequence, each dealing maximum damage per rank with +10 ft chain range.

prism_mage.name: Sphere Purity
prism_mage.description: Pure element combinations (same element twice) deal +1d6 damage per rank. Roll 1d20 when you generate spheres - on 15+ per rank, add one extra sphere of your choice.

prism_mage.name: Elemental Resonance
prism_mage.description: When you roll 3 or more spheres of the same element, make a Fortune Roll (1d6, odd = Red). Red result grants +1d4 temporary mana per rank.

prism_mage.name: Reroll Mastery
prism_mage.description: You can reroll up to 2 spheres per turn (costs 1 mana per reroll). Roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, the reroll costs no mana.

prism_mage.name: Pure Amplification
prism_mage.description: Pure element spells can affect +5 ft radius per rank. Enemies in the area take half damage from the pure element type.

prism_mage.name: Crystal Focus
prism_mage.description: Once per turn, spend 2 mana to lock in one element type. You cannot roll that element but pure combinations of it deal +2d6 damage per rank.

prism_mage.name: Sphere Hunting
prism_mage.description: When rerolling spheres, roll 1d8. On 7+ per rank, choose the exact element you want instead of rerolling.

prism_mage.name: Elemental Dominion
prism_mage.description: You gain resistance to the element type you've used most this combat. At rank 3, you also gain advantage on saves against that element.

prism_mage.name: Prismatic Burst
prism_mage.description: Unlocks Prismatic Burst - consume 4 spheres of the same element to deal 3d8 damage per sphere consumed in a 30ft cone. Crits on 18+.

prism_mage.name: Perfect Clarity
prism_mage.description: Once per combat, spend 5 mana to reroll all your spheres and choose their exact composition (up to your normal sphere limit).

prism_mage.name: Elemental Surge
prism_mage.description: Pure element spells have +10 ft range per rank and can pass through creatures without losing damage.

prism_mage.name: Crystal Armor
prism_mage.description: While you have 3+ spheres banked of the same element, you gain +2 armor per rank and resistance to that element.

prism_mage.name: Sphere Perfection
prism_mage.description: Pure element combinations deal maximum damage dice per rank (2 ranks = all dice max, 3 ranks = double max damage).

prism_mage.name: Elemental Transcendence
prism_mage.description: You become immune to the element you've used most this combat. Once per turn, transform any sphere into your dominant element.

prism_mage.name: Prismatic Cataclysm
prism_mage.description: Unlocks Prismatic Cataclysm - consume up to 6 spheres of one element to deal 4d12 damage per sphere consumed in a 50ft radius. Damage type matches the element.

entropy_weaver.name: Chaos Generation
entropy_weaver.description: Roll 5d8 for sphere generation instead of 4d8 (one extra sphere per turn). When you roll Chaos spheres, make a Fortune Roll (1d6, odd = Red) per Chaos sphere. Red result doubles that sphere's effect.

entropy_weaver.name: Wild Magic Surge
entropy_weaver.description: When you use Chaos spheres in any combination, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table for additional effects. Chaos spells have +5% crit chance per rank.

entropy_weaver.name: Chaos Amplification
entropy_weaver.description: All Chaos element combinations deal +1d6 damage per rank. When you generate Chaos spheres, roll 1d6 - on 5+ per rank, generate an extra Chaos sphere.

entropy_weaver.name: Volatile Power
entropy_weaver.description: Chaos spells can chain to nearby enemies within 10 ft per rank. Each chain deals half damage but triggers Wild Magic Surge.

entropy_weaver.name: Entropy Field
entropy_weaver.description: Create a 20 ft radius field for 1 minute per rank. Enemies inside have disadvantage on saves against your spells.

entropy_weaver.name: Sphere Conversion
entropy_weaver.description: Once per turn, convert any sphere to Chaos (costs 2 mana). Chaos spheres you convert deal +2d6 damage per rank.

entropy_weaver.name: Reality Fracture
entropy_weaver.description: Wild Magic Surges can now affect allies beneficially. Roll 1d20 - on 15+ per rank, choose whether the surge helps or harms.

entropy_weaver.name: Chaos Nova
entropy_weaver.description: Unlocks Chaos Nova - deal 3d8 chaos damage to all enemies in 30 ft. For each Chaos sphere in your bank, add +1d8.

entropy_weaver.name: Unstable Sphere
entropy_weaver.description: Your Chaos spheres become unstable. When consumed, roll 1d6 - on 1-2, they deal +4d6 bonus damage; on 3-4, normal damage; on 5-6, they fizzle but grant +2d6 temp HP.

entropy_weaver.name: Catastrophic Surge
entropy_weaver.description: Wild Magic Surges deal maximum damage per rank. You can trigger a Wild Magic Surge voluntarily once per turn (costs 3 mana).

entropy_weaver.name: Chaos Armor
entropy_weaver.description: While you have Chaos spheres banked, you gain +1 armor per Chaos sphere per rank and resistance to random elemental damage.

entropy_weaver.name: Sphere Detonation
entropy_weaver.description: When a Chaos sphere fizzes, it explodes dealing 2d8 chaos damage per rank to enemies within 10 ft.

entropy_weaver.name: Chaos Mastery
entropy_weaver.description: You are immune to Wild Magic Surge effects. Once per turn, all spheres become Chaos spheres for the next spell you cast.

entropy_weaver.name: Apocalypse
entropy_weaver.description: Unlocks Apocalypse - consume up to 6 Chaos spheres to deal 5d12 chaos damage per sphere consumed in a 60ft radius. All enemies affected trigger Wild Magic Surge.

sphere_architect.name: Runic Precision
sphere_architect.description: 3-sphere spells cost 3 less mana (10→7 mana). You can store up to 15 spheres. Make a Fortune Roll (1d6, odd = Red) when you cast spells. Red result restores 1 mana per rank.

sphere_architect.name: Sphere Manipulation
sphere_architect.description: Once per turn, swap 2 spheres for different element types (costs 3 mana total). Roll 1d20 - on 16+ per rank, the swap costs no mana.

sphere_architect.name: Efficient Banking
sphere_architect.description: Spheres you bank persist between encounters (up to your maximum). You gain +1 maximum spheres per rank to store (base 15 → 16/17/18).

sphere_architect.name: Sphere Lock
sphere_architect.description: At end of turn, lock 1 sphere type to guarantee it appears in your next roll. Locked spheres deal +1d6 damage per rank when used.

sphere_architect.name: Precision Casting
sphere_architect.description: Your spells have +1 to hit per rank. Once per turn, spend 2 mana to automatically hit with a spell (no attack roll needed).

sphere_architect.name: Sphere Economy
sphere_architect.description: 2-sphere spells cost 1 less mana per rank (5→4→3 mana). You can bank spheres from multiple turns before spending them.

sphere_architect.name: Runic Matrix
sphere_architect.description: Create combination matrices that persist for 1 minute per rank. Matrix spells cost 2 less mana and deal +1d6 damage.

sphere_architect.name: Sphere Synthesis
sphere_architect.description: Unlocks Sphere Synthesis - combine 2 spheres of different elements to create a new element of your choice (costs 4 mana).

sphere_architect.name: Mana Crystal
sphere_architect.description: Store mana in crystal form (up to 20 mana per rank). Crystals can be used as 1 action point to restore mana.

sphere_architect.name: Sphere Network
sphere_architect.description: Spheres in your bank can share effects. Network spells affect +1 additional target per rank within 30 ft.

sphere_architect.name: Perfect Control
sphere_architect.description: You can rearrange your sphere bank as a 1 action point. Controlled spheres have advantage on all spell effects per rank.

sphere_architect.name: Arcane Efficiency
sphere_architect.description: 4-sphere spells cost 3 less mana per rank, to a maximum reduction of 8 (28→22→19→20). You can cast spells without verbal components.

sphere_architect.name: Runic Ascendancy
sphere_architect.description: You can maintain 2 runic matrices simultaneously. All spells cast through matrices have their effects maximized.

sphere_architect.name: Elemental Convergence
sphere_architect.description: Unlocks Elemental Convergence - consume spheres to create any spell effect. Cost: 8 mana + spheres equal to spell level. Range, damage, and effects of your choice.

metamorph.name: Primal Adaptation
metamorph.description: Your transformations generate +1 additional Wild Instinct per rank. Roll 1d8 when transforming - on 7+ per rank, gain temporary HP equal to your Wild Instinct.

metamorph.name: Form Fusion
metamorph.description: You can combine two forms together, creating hybrid abilities. Roll 1d6 when fusing - on 4+ per rank, the hybrid gains +1d4 damage.

metamorph.name: Adaptive Physiology
metamorph.description: When damaged by a specific damage type, spend 2 WI to gain resistance to that type for 1 minute. Roll 1d6 - on 5+ per rank, also heal 1d6 HP.

metamorph.name: Trait Synthesis
metamorph.description: You can manifest individual traits from any form (claws, wings, gills) without full transformation. Roll 1d20 - on 16+ per rank, manifest two traits simultaneously.

metamorph.name: Morphological Resilience
metamorph.description: While transformed, you gain +1 armor per rank and resistance to poison. When you transform, roll 1d8 - on 6+ per rank, remove one debuff from yourself.

metamorph.name: Evolutionary Burst
metamorph.description: Once per turn, spend 3 WI to instantly transform and gain advantage on your next attack. Roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, the attack also deals +2d6 damage.

metamorph.name: Chimeric Mastery
metamorph.description: Hybrid forms cost 1 less WI to maintain per rank. When you create a hybrid, roll 1d10 - on 8+ per rank, gain a random bonus trait for 1 minute.

metamorph.name: Metabolic Acceleration
metamorph.description: Your movement speed increases by 10 ft per rank while transformed. Roll 1d6 when you move 30+ ft in one turn - on 5+ per rank, gain +1d6 temp HP.

metamorph.name: Adaptive Evolution
metamorph.description: Spend 4 WI to temporarily evolve resistance to the last damage type that harmed you this combat. Roll 1d8 - on 7+ per rank, this resistance becomes permanent.

metamorph.name: Genetic Memory
metamorph.description: You can store one hybrid form per rank for instant recall. Switching to a stored form costs 1 WI instead of 2. Roll 1d20 when storing - on 18+ per rank, store two forms.

metamorph.name: Rapid Metamorphosis
metamorph.description: Transform as a 1 action point instead of an action. Roll 1d6 when transforming - on 4+ per rank, also gain advantage on your first attack in the new form.

metamorph.name: Perfect Chimera
