metamorph.description: Create a perfect chimera by combining three forms at once. This ultimate form gains abilities from all three forms and +3 to all rolls. Costs 8 WI.

metamorph.name: Evolutionary Transcendence
metamorph.description: You can maintain hybrid forms indefinitely. When you transform, roll 1d20 - on 18+ per rank, permanently evolve one of your base forms.

metamorph.name: Omega Transformation
metamorph.description: Unlocks Omega Transformation - spend all Wild Instinct to become a legendary chimera with abilities from all four base forms plus three random traits. Lasts 1 minute.

form_thief.name: Form Harvest
form_thief.description: When you defeat an enemy, roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, you can harvest their form for your collection. Harvesting costs 1 less WI per rank (base cost 3 WI).

form_thief.name: Mimicry Mastery
form_thief.description: While in a stolen form, you are indistinguishable from the original. Roll 1d6 when mimicking - on 5+ per rank, you also gain their memories and knowledge.

form_thief.name: Form Vault
form_thief.description: You can store 2 additional forms per rank. Forms in your vault generate 1 WI per day each. Roll 1d20 when storing a form - on 16+ per rank, gain an extra ability from it.

form_thief.name: Stolen Power
form_thief.description: You can use one ability from your current stolen form per rank. Roll 1d8 when using a stolen ability - on 7+ per rank, you can use it at full power without limitations.

form_thief.name: Perfect Mimic
form_thief.description: Your stolen forms fool even magical detection. Roll 1d20 when scrutinized magically - on 16+ per rank, the detector believes you are the genuine article.

form_thief.name: Form Synthesis
form_thief.description: Combine traits from two stored forms into a new hybrid ability. Roll 1d10 when synthesizing - on 8+ per rank, the hybrid ability is more powerful than either original.

form_thief.name: Form Amplification
form_thief.description: Stolen forms are 25% more effective per rank. When using a stolen ability, roll 1d6 - on 5+ per rank, amplify it by +50% power.

form_thief.name: Legendary Harvest
form_thief.description: You can harvest forms from legendary creatures and bosses. Roll 1d100 when defeating such a foe - on 90+ per rank, you can harvest their form (even if normally immune).

form_thief.name: Form Vault Expansion
form_thief.description: Your form vault can hold 5 additional forms per rank. Stored forms now generate 2 WI per day each instead of 1.

form_thief.name: Mimicry Perfection
form_thief.description: You can perfectly mimic any creature you've seen, even without harvesting them. Roll 1d6 when mimicking - on 4+ per rank, gain their full stat block for 1 hour.

form_thief.name: Collector's Instinct
form_thief.description: You can sense valuable forms within 100 ft. Roll 1d20 when encountering new creatures - on 16+ per rank, learn one of their abilities without harvesting them.

form_thief.name: Legendary Mimicry
form_thief.description: You can mimic legendary creatures without harvesting them first. Roll 1d100 when encountering legends - on 95+ per rank, you can use their most powerful ability once per day.

form_thief.name: Form Hoarder
form_thief.description: You can maintain 3 stolen forms simultaneously. Switching between them costs 1 WI instead of 2. Roll 1d8 when switching - on 7+ per rank, keep beneficial effects from the previous form.

form_thief.name: Panmorphic Apotheosis
form_thief.description: Unlocks Panmorphic Apotheosis - spend all Wild Instinct to become every form in your vault simultaneously. You gain all their abilities but take 4d6 damage each round from the strain.

primordial.name: Elemental Affinity
primordial.description: Elemental transformations generate +1 additional Wild Instinct per rank. Roll 1d8 when transforming elementally - on 7+ per rank, gain resistance to your opposite element.

primordial.name: Inferno Essence
primordial.description: Your fire transformations deal +1d6 fire damage per rank. When you transform into Inferno, roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, create a 10 ft radius fire zone that deals 1d4 fire damage per turn.

primordial.name: Tsunami Essence
primordial.description: Your water transformations gain +10 ft swim speed per rank. When you transform into Tsunami, roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, create water barriers that block line of sight.

primordial.name: Avalanche Essence
primordial.description: Your earth transformations gain +2 armor per rank. When you transform into Avalanche, roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, create stone spikes that deal 2d6 piercing damage in 20 ft.

primordial.name: Tempest Essence
primordial.description: Your air transformations gain +10 ft fly speed per rank. When you transform into Tempest, roll 1d6 - on 4+ per rank, create wind gusts that push enemies 10 ft away.

primordial.name: Elemental Fusion
primordial.description: You can combine two elements in one transformation. Roll 1d8 when fusing - on 7+ per rank, create a unique elemental effect (steam clouds, mud slides, etc.).

primordial.name: Terrain Reshape
primordial.description: While in elemental form, you can reshape terrain within 30 ft. Roll 1d6 when reshaping - on 5+ per rank, the terrain changes persist for 1 minute.

primordial.name: Elemental Immunity
primordial.description: While in your elemental form, you are immune to your element and resistant to all others. Roll 1d20 when taking elemental damage - on 16+ per rank, redirect it to heal yourself.

primordial.name: Elemental Storm
primordial.description: Create a 40 ft radius elemental storm that damages enemies based on your current form. Roll 1d6 when creating the storm - on 4+ per rank, enemies take half damage on saves.

primordial.name: Primal Overload
primordial.description: Your elemental forms gain +50% damage output per rank but cost 1 extra WI to maintain. When you take damage while overloaded, roll 1d6 - on 5+ per rank, unleash an elemental burst.

primordial.name: Elemental Ascension
primordial.description: Transform as a 1 action point and maintain elemental forms indefinitely. Roll 1d8 when ascending - on 7+ per rank, gain a new elemental ability permanently.

primordial.name: Tetra-Elemental
primordial.description: You can manifest all four elemental forms simultaneously. Each element grants its benefits but you take 2d6 damage per round from elemental strain. Costs 6 WI.

primordial.name: Elemental Godhood
primordial.description: Your elemental transformations can affect up to 100 ft radius. When you transform, roll 1d100 - on 95+ per rank, you become immune to all damage for 1 round.

primordial.name: Cosmic Elemental Fury
primordial.description: Unlocks Cosmic Elemental Fury - spend all Wild Instinct to unleash all four elemental forces simultaneously. Creates a 60 ft radius cataclysm dealing 5d8 elemental damage of each type.

bokor.name: Cursed Essence
bokor.description: Curses generate +1 additional Voodoo Essence per rank. Curse damage dice increase by 1 per rank (e.g., 1d6 becomes 1d6+1, then 1d6+2).

bokor.name: Necrotic Burst
bokor.description: When cursed enemies die, they explode dealing 2d6 necrotic damage per rank to enemies within 10 ft. You heal for half the damage dealt.

bokor.name: Soul Drain
bokor.description: Curses drain 1d4 HP per rank from cursed enemies each turn. You gain this amount as temporary HP.

bokor.name: Curse Amplification
bokor.description: Curses last 2 additional rounds per rank and can stack up to 2 times on the same target. Each stack adds +1d4 necrotic damage per turn.

bokor.name: Death Link
bokor.description: Link two cursed enemies. When one dies, the other takes 3d6 necrotic damage per rank. You can maintain 1 additional Death Link per rank.

bokor.name: Mass Curse Mastery
bokor.description: Mass Curse affects +1 additional target per rank and its damage-over-time increases by +1d6 per rank.

bokor.name: Baron's Favor
bokor.description: Baron Samedi invocations cost 1 less Voodoo Essence per rank and require 1 fewer cursed enemy per rank. Baron Samedi deals +1d8 damage per rank to each target.

bokor.name: Curse Mastery
bokor.description: You can maintain 2 additional curses per rank. Curses now reduce enemy healing received by 25% per rank.

bokor.name: Vampiric Curses
bokor.description: All curse damage heals you for 25% of damage dealt per rank. When you kill an enemy with curse damage, gain 2d6 temporary HP per rank.

bokor.name: Spectral Armor
bokor.description: While you have 2+ cursed enemies active, gain +1 armor per rank and resistance to necrotic damage. When cursed enemies die within 30 ft, gain +1d6 temporary HP per rank.

bokor.name: Death Ritual Mastery
bokor.description: Ritual of Death creates a 15 ft radius zone of necrotic energy that persists for 2 rounds per rank. Enemies in the zone take 2d6 necrotic damage per round.

bokor.name: Death Lord
bokor.description: You become resistant to necrotic damage and poison. Baron Samedi invocations can now target undead allies, raising them as powerful minions for 1 minute.

bokor.name: Apocalypse of Death
bokor.description: Unlocks Apocalypse of Death — spend all Voodoo Essence to curse all enemies in 60 ft. They take 3d8 necrotic damage per Essence spent and are frightened for 1 minute.

mambo.name: Healing Essence
mambo.description: Healing spells generate +1 additional Voodoo Essence per rank. Healing rolls gain +1 per rank to their total.

mambo.name: Totem Mastery
mambo.description: Totems last 2 additional rounds per rank and their radius increases by 5 ft per rank. Your totems gain +5 HP per rank.

mambo.name: Spirit Bond
mambo.description: Bond with 1 additional ally per rank. Bonded allies gain +1d4 temporary HP when you heal them and share your resistance to necrotic damage.

mambo.name: Healing Wave
mambo.description: Healing spells chain to 1 nearby ally within 10 ft per rank. Each chain heals for 50% of the original amount.

mambo.name: Erzulie's Blessing
mambo.description: Erzulie invocations cost 1 less Voodoo Essence per rank and heal +2d6 additional HP. Erzulie's buff duration increases by 1 round per rank.

mambo.name: Protective Barrier
mambo.description: You can create a barrier around bonded allies that absorbs 2d6 damage per rank before breaking. When the barrier breaks, the ally is healed for half the absorbed damage.

mambo.name: Totem Network
mambo.description: When you have 2+ totems on the field, their effects are enhanced by 25% per rank. Totems within 20 ft of each other share their effects.

mambo.name: Life Transfer
mambo.description: You can transfer 2d6 HP per rank from yourself to bonded allies as 1 action point. Once per combat, if you would be reduced to 0 HP, a bonded ally takes the damage instead.

mambo.name: Simbi's Rain
mambo.description: Simbi invocations create a persistent rain effect for 2 rounds per rank that heals allies 1d6 HP per round and cures poisons. The rain radius is 15 ft per rank.

mambo.name: Spirit Ward
mambo.description: Allies within 30 ft of your totems gain +1 to all saves per rank and resistance to curse effects. Bonded allies gain an additional +1 to saves.

mambo.name: Spirit Resurrection
mambo.description: Resurrection spells work on allies who died up to 1 minute ago per rank. Resurrected allies return with full HP and gain +2 to all rolls for 1 minute.

mambo.name: Spirit Ascendant
mambo.description: You gain resistance to all damage while within 30 ft of a totem. Erzulie and Simbi invocations can now be maintained simultaneously, and their effects stack.

mambo.name: Heavenly Intervention
mambo.description: Unlocks Heavenly Intervention — spend all Voodoo Essence to heal all allies in 60 ft for 4d8 HP per Essence spent and remove all curses, diseases, and poisons.

mambo.name: Eternal Spring
mambo.description: Once per long rest, create an Eternal Spring that heals all allies within 30 ft for 3d8 HP per round for 1 minute. The spring persists through combat and cannot be dispelled.

houngan.name: Warrior Essence
houngan.description: Weapon attacks and combat spells generate +1 additional Voodoo Essence per rank. Weapon damage increases by +1 per rank.

houngan.name: Combat Blessing
houngan.description: Bless 1 additional ally per rank. Blessed allies gain +1 to attack rolls and +1d4 weapon damage for the duration.

houngan.name: Poison Mastery
houngan.description: Poisons last 2 additional rounds per rank and deal +1d4 damage per round. Your poisons cannot be removed by lesser magic.

houngan.name: War Cry
houngan.description: Activate a war cry as 1 action point. Allies within 30 ft gain +1d6 weapon damage for 3 rounds per rank. This effect does not stack with itself.

houngan.name: Ogoun's Might
houngan.description: Ogoun invocations cost 1 less Voodoo Essence per rank and grant +1 additional attack/damage per rank. Ogoun's duration increases by 1 round per rank.

houngan.name: Battle Totem
houngan.description: Your totems provide half cover to adjacent allies per rank and deal 2d6 damage to enemies who enter within 5 ft. Enemies damaged are slowed for 1 round.

houngan.name: Poison Cloud Mastery
houngan.description: Poison effects create a 10 ft radius cloud for 2 rounds per rank. Enemies in the cloud take 2d6 poison damage per round and have disadvantage on attack rolls.

houngan.name: Spirit Weapon
houngan.description: Your weapon attacks deal +1d6 damage per rank while poison is active. On critical hits, the target is stunned for 1 round.

houngan.name: Toxic Burst
houngan.description: When poisoned enemies die, they explode dealing 3d6 poison damage per rank to enemies within 15 ft. The explosion leaves a poison cloud in the area for 1 round.

houngan.name: Spirit Communication
houngan.description: You can communicate telepathically with all allies within 1 mile per rank. During Papa Legba invocations, you can also see through allies' eyes for 1 minute, granting them +2 to attack rolls.

houngan.name: Berserker Rage
houngan.description: When you or blessed allies drop below 50% HP, they gain +2 to attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases by +1 per rank. The rage lasts until combat ends.

houngan.name: War Spirit
houngan.description: You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls while wielding a weapon. Ogoun and Papa Legba invocations can now be maintained simultaneously, combining their combat and utility effects.

houngan.name: Papa Legba's Trickery
houngan.description: Papa Legba invocations cost 1 less Voodoo Essence per rank and allow teleporting +2 additional allies. Teleported allies gain +2 to their next attack roll.

houngan.name: Armageddon
houngan.description: Unlocks Armageddon — spend all Voodoo Essence to unleash total war. All enemies in 60 ft take 3d8 damage per Essence spent and are poisoned for 1 minute.

shadowbane.name: Hexbreaker Focus
shadowbane.description: Your Hexbreaker charges build 50% faster against evil magic users. Shadow Step costs no charges when you have 0 charges. Roll 1d4 when entering stealth - on 4, gain +1 Hexbreaker charge.

shadowbane.name: Shadow Mastery
shadowbane.description: Gain expertise in Stealth and gain advantage on attacks from stealth. At 3+ Hexbreaker charges, stealth attacks automatically crit. Roll 1d6 when entering stealth - on 5+ per rank, become invisible to evil creatures.

shadowbane.name: Umbral Blade
shadowbane.description: Your weapon becomes infused with shadow energy. Weapon attacks from stealth deal +2d6 necrotic damage per rank and reduce enemy movement speed by 10ft for 1 round.

shadowbane.name: Silent Execution
shadowbane.description: Stealth attacks against evil magic users deal maximum damage and cannot be reduced. If target is below 50% HP, deal +4d6 bonus necrotic damage per rank.

shadowbane.name: Charge Hunter
shadowbane.description: Gain +1 Hexbreaker charge when you kill an evil magic user. Your Witch Hunter's Precision procs on every attack against evil magic users instead of every third.

shadowbane.name: Dark Burst
shadowbane.description: When you reach 3+ Hexbreaker charges, your next attack releases a burst of shadow energy dealing 3d6 necrotic damage per rank to enemies within 10ft.

shadowbane.name: Shadow Eruption
shadowbane.description: When you kill an enemy with a stealth attack, all enemies within 15ft take 4d6 necrotic damage per rank and have disadvantage on saves for 1 round.

shadowbane.name: Hexbreaker Storm
shadowbane.description: Spend 4 Hexbreaker charges to teleport to any evil magic user within 60ft and attack with advantage. Deal +6d6 bonus necrotic damage and silence target for 2 rounds.

shadowbane.name: Apex Predator
shadowbane.description: While you have 4+ Hexbreaker charges, you are invisible to non-evil creatures and gain +2 to all rolls against evil magic users. Your movement speed doubles.

shadowbane.name: Shadow Ascendant
shadowbane.description: Ultimate ability: Become a shadow entity for 1 minute. Gain 50% damage reduction, teleport 60ft as 1 action point, and attacks deal maximum damage. Costs all Hexbreaker charges.

spellbreaker.name: Anti-Magic Sentinel
spellbreaker.description: You gain advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. When you successfully save against a spell, gain +1 Hexbreaker charge and reflect 2d8 force damage back to the caster.

spellbreaker.name: Spell Intercept
spellbreaker.description: As a reaction when an enemy casts a spell within 60ft, make a ranged spell attack. If it hits, the spell is countered and you gain +2 Hexbreaker charges.

spellbreaker.name: Mana Vortex
spellbreaker.description: When you counter a spell, create a vortex that drains 2d6 mana per rank from the caster. If they have no mana remaining, they take psychic damage instead.

spellbreaker.name: Spell Nullification
spellbreaker.description: Countered spells cannot be cast again by that creature for 1 minute per rank. Additionally, dispel any one magical effect on yourself when you counter a spell.

spellbreaker.name: Ward Weaver
spellbreaker.description: Create protective wards that reduce spell damage to allies within 30ft by 1d8 per rank. Wards last 1 minute and can be maintained as a 1 action point.

spellbreaker.name: Dispel Field
spellbreaker.description: Create a 15ft radius anti-magic field for 1 minute per rank. Spells cast into the field automatically fail, and magical effects are suppressed.

spellbreaker.name: Hexbreaker Barrier
spellbreaker.description: Your anti-magic field now deals 3d6 force damage per rank to evil magic users who enter it, and prevents them from casting spells while inside.

spellbreaker.name: Spell Siphon
spellbreaker.description: When you counter a spell, you can choose to redirect it to a new target within range. The spell uses your spellcasting ability for attack rolls and saves.

spellbreaker.name: Arcane Dominator
spellbreaker.description: You can maintain concentration on two anti-magic effects simultaneously. Spells cast at you or your allies within 30ft have disadvantage.

spellbreaker.name: Anti-Magic Storm
spellbreaker.description: Ultimate ability: Create a massive anti-magic storm in 40ft radius for 1 minute. All spells fail, magical effects end, and evil magic users take 8d6 force damage per round. Costs all Hexbreaker charges.

demonhunter.name: Hunter's Instinct
demonhunter.description: You can track evil magic users by scent alone and have advantage on Perception checks to detect them. Your movement speed increases by +5ft per Hexbreaker charge.

demonhunter.name: Pursuit Mastery
demonhunter.description: You cannot be slowed or rooted while you have 3+ Hexbreaker charges. When an evil magic user moves away from you, you can use your reaction to move up to your speed toward them.

demonhunter.name: Hunter's Mark
demonhunter.description: Mark an evil magic user for 10 minutes. You can see them through walls, they cannot become invisible to you, and your attacks against them deal +2d6 radiant damage per rank.

demonhunter.name: Marked for Death
demonhunter.description: Marked targets take an additional 3d6 radiant damage per rank whenever you deal Witch Hunter's Precision true damage to any evil magic user.

demonhunter.name: Charge Surge
demonhunter.description: When you gain a Hexbreaker charge, you can move 10ft per rank as a reaction. At 5+ charges, this movement ignores difficult terrain and enemy spaces.

demonhunter.name: Condemn
demonhunter.description: Spend 3 Hexbreaker charges to knock a target back 20ft and pin them to a surface. They take 4d8 radiant damage per rank and are stunned for 1 round.

demonhunter.name: Immovable Object
demonhunter.description: When you are hit by an attack from an evil magic user, you can spend 1 Hexbreaker charge as a reaction to become immune to that attack and pull the attacker 10ft closer to you.

demonhunter.name: Hexbreaker Pursuit
demonhunter.description: When you damage an evil magic user, mark them automatically. You can have up to 3 marks active simultaneously, and switching between marked targets costs no movement.

demonhunter.name: Final Hour
demonhunter.description: Enter a state of ultimate focus for 1 minute. Gain +5 armor, +30ft movement, advantage on all attacks, and Witch Hunter's Precision triggers on every attack. Cannot be stopped.

demonhunter.name: Judgment Day
demonhunter.description: Ultimate ability: All marked targets within 60ft take 10d6 radiant damage per mark and are stunned for 1 minute. You teleport between them, attacking each once. Costs all Hexbreaker charges.

flow-master.name: Momentum Flow
flow-master.description: All stance transitions cost 1 less Momentum (minimum 1). Momentum decays 50% slower. Your Flourish abilities have +10% effectiveness.

flow-master.name: Rapid Current
flow-master.description: You can transition between any two connected stances as a 1 action point. Gain +1 Momentum when you transition stances.

flow-master.name: Water Dance
flow-master.description: While in Flowing Water stance, you can spend 1 Momentum to automatically dodge any attack. Dodge distance increased by 10ft.

flow-master.name: Liquid Motion
flow-master.description: Your movement speed increases by +10ft when you have 5+ Momentum. You can move through enemy spaces without opportunity attacks.

flow-master.name: Combo Weaving
flow-master.description: After using a stance ability, you can immediately transition to another stance at half cost (round down).

flow-master.name: Chain Flow
flow-master.description: You can perform up to 2 stance abilities in one turn by spending extra Momentum equal to the second ability's cost.

flow-master.name: Fluid Mastery
flow-master.description: Dancing Blade stance allows you to transition to ANY stance (not just connected ones) for 2 Momentum instead of 4.

flow-master.name: River Confluence
flow-master.description: Once per turn when you transition stances, you can spend 3 Momentum to perform a free stance ability from your new stance.

flow-master.name: Eternal Current
flow-master.description: Momentum cannot decay below 3. When you reach 10 Momentum, your next stance transition is free and you can choose any stance.

flow-master.name: Water Ascendant
flow-master.description: Ultimate ability: Become a flowing water elemental for 1 minute. All attacks pass through you, you take half damage from all sources, and you can teleport 30ft as a 1 action point. Costs all Momentum.

duelist.name: Precision Edge
duelist.description: Your critical hit range increases by 1 (crit on 19-20). Striking Serpent stance grants +1 to initiative rolls. Rooted Stone ripostes deal +1d4 damage.

duelist.name: Perfect Timing
duelist.description: Once per turn, you can spend 2 Momentum to make an attack as a reaction when an enemy within 30ft attacks.

duelist.name: Serpent's Precision
duelist.description: Striking Serpent stance increases your critical hit range by an additional +1 (total crit on 18-20). Critical hits generate +1 extra Momentum.

duelist.name: Duelist's Focus
duelist.description: You have advantage on attacks against enemies you damaged this turn. This advantage persists until the start of your next turn.

duelist.name: Defensive Stance
duelist.description: Rooted Stone stance grants +2 to all saving throws. While in Rooted Stone, you can spend 1 Momentum to reduce incoming damage by 1d8.

duelist.name: Counter Mastery
duelist.description: Rooted Stone ripostes can be used as reactions to any attack, not just after parries. Riposte damage is doubled.

duelist.name: Unyielding Blade
duelist.description: While wielding a weapon, you cannot be disarmed or have your weapon damaged. Rooted Stone stance prevents you from being moved against your will.

duelist.name: Dueling Mastery
duelist.description: You can challenge a single enemy as a 1 action point. While challenged, both you and the target have advantage on attacks against each other, but cannot attack others.

duelist.name: Blade Dance
duelist.description: Dancing Blade stance allows you to attack twice per action instead of once. These attacks can target different enemies within 10ft.

duelist.name: Perfect Duelist
duelist.description: Ultimate ability: Challenge all enemies within 30ft simultaneously. For 1 minute, you have advantage on all attacks and challenged enemies have disadvantage on attacks targeting anyone but you. Costs all Flourish tokens.

shadow-dancer.name: Shadow Essence
shadow-dancer.description: Shadow Step stance allows you to enter stealth even in combat. Stealth attacks generate +1 extra Flourish token. Shadow Step transitions cost 1 less Momentum.

shadow-dancer.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow-dancer.description: You can enter stealth as a 1 action point. While stealthed, you gain +2 to attack and damage rolls. Stealth lasts until you attack or take damage.

shadow-dancer.name: Phantom Step
shadow-dancer.description: Shadow Step stance allows you to teleport through walls and solid objects (but not into occupied spaces). You can teleport while prone or restrained.

shadow-dancer.name: Darkness Within
shadow-dancer.description: While in Shadow Step stance, you become immune to being targeted by divination magic. Enemies cannot detect you through tremorsense or blindsight.

shadow-dancer.name: Ambush Mastery
shadow-dancer.description: Stealth attacks deal +3d6 bonus damage. If the target was unaware of you, the attack is automatically a critical hit.

shadow-dancer.name: Shadow Eruption
shadow-dancer.description: When you exit stealth with an attack, all enemies within 10ft of your target take 2d6 shadow damage and have disadvantage on their next attack.

shadow-dancer.name: Eternal Darkness
shadow-dancer.description: Shadow Step stance creates a 15ft radius zone of magical darkness centered on you. You can see through this darkness, but enemies are blinded.

shadow-dancer.name: Shadow Weaving
shadow-dancer.description: You can transition to Shadow Step from ANY stance for 3 Momentum. While in Shadow Step, you can perform stance abilities from other stances.

shadow-dancer.name: Dance of Shadows
shadow-dancer.description: Once per turn when you transition to Shadow Step, you can teleport to a second location within 30ft as part of the transition.

shadow-dancer.name: Shadow Ascendant
shadow-dancer.description: Ultimate ability: Become a living shadow for 1 minute. You are immune to all damage, can teleport 60ft as a 1 action point, and all your attacks deal maximum damage. Costs all Momentum and 3 Flourish.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Lunar Precision
moonlight-sentinel.description: Your ranged attacks gain +1 to attack rolls. Lunar Arrow and Moonbeam have +10ft range. Full Moon phase grants +1d4 bonus radiant damage on ranged attacks.

moonlight-sentinel.name: True Shot
moonlight-sentinel.description: Once per turn when you hit with a ranged attack, you can spend 1 action point to make another ranged attack at advantage.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Lunar Guidance
moonlight-sentinel.description: Your ranged attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Full Moon phase allows you to attack twice using 1 action point when you crit.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Marksman Focus
moonlight-sentinel.description: You can mark a target using 1 action point. Your next attack against the marked target has advantage and deals +2d6 radiant damage.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Moonlight Arrow
moonlight-sentinel.description: Lunar Arrow creates a beam of moonlight that damages all enemies in a line 30ft long and 5ft wide for 2d6 radiant damage.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Radiant Burst
moonlight-sentinel.description: Rank 1: When you crit with a ranged attack during Full Moon, all enemies within 10ft of the target take 1d8 radiant damage. Rank 2: When you crit with a ranged attack during Full Moon, all enemies within 10ft of the target take 2d8 radiant damage. Rank 3: When you crit with a ranged attack during Full Moon, all enemies within 10ft of the target take 3d8 radiant damage. Rank 4: When you crit with a ranged attack during Full Moon, all enemies within 10ft of the target take 4d8 radiant damage.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Lunar Empowerment
moonlight-sentinel.description: During Full Moon, your ranged attacks reduce the target's radiant resistance by 5 per rank, to a minimum of 0.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Deadly Precision
moonlight-sentinel.description: Your critical hit range with ranged attacks increases by 1 (crit on 19-20). During Full Moon, critical hits deal maximum damage.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Lunar Sentinel
moonlight-sentinel.description: You can use your reaction to make a ranged attack when an enemy within 30ft casts a spell. Full Moon phase gives +2d6 bonus radiant damage on reaction attacks.

moonlight-sentinel.name: Celestial Archer
moonlight-sentinel.description: Ultimate ability: Summon a celestial bow for 1 minute. All ranged attacks have 120ft range, ignore cover, and deal +4d6 radiant damage. Costs 10 mana.

starfall-invoker.name: Cosmic Attunement
starfall-invoker.description: Your spells can be cast as ranged spell attacks. Starfall and Moonbeam affect +5ft radius per rank. Waning Moon phase allows you to affect one extra target with single-target spells.

starfall-invoker.name: Meteor Shower
starfall-invoker.description: Starfall creates 3 additional meteors that each deal 2d6 fire damage in 10ft radius. Meteors can be directed to different targets.

starfall-invoker.name: Celestial Storm
starfall-invoker.description: When you cast an AoE spell during Full Moon, you can spend 2 extra mana to double the radius and damage (spell level +1).

starfall-invoker.name: Cosmic Eruption
starfall-invoker.description: Enemies that die from your AoE spells explode, dealing 3d6 force damage to all enemies within 10ft.

starfall-invoker.name: Astral Bind
starfall-invoker.description: Enemies hit by Starfall are slowed for 1 round. During Waning Moon, slowed enemies are also restrained until the end of their next turn.

starfall-invoker.name: Heavenly Retribution
starfall-invoker.description: When an enemy within 60ft casts a spell, you can use your reaction to deal 4d6 radiant damage to them and all enemies within 10ft.

starfall-invoker.name: Starfall Supremacy
starfall-invoker.description: Starfall ignores spell resistance and immunity to radiant damage. During Full Moon, Starfall deals maximum damage to all targets.

starfall-invoker.name: Celestial Convergence
starfall-invoker.description: You can cast Starfall at 3rd level instead of 5th. Starfall can be concentrated on for 1 minute, creating a storm that damages enemies each round.

starfall-invoker.name: Cosmic Overload
starfall-invoker.description: When you cast Starfall, you can overload it to affect all enemies within 60ft for 1 minute, but you cannot cast Starfall again for 1 minute.

starfall-invoker.name: Starfall Invoker
starfall-invoker.description: Ultimate ability: Call down a meteor storm for 1 minute. Every round, 10 meteors rain down, each dealing 3d6 fire damage in 5ft radius (choose locations). Costs 15 mana.

moonwell-guardian.name: Lunar Healing
moonwell-guardian.description: Your healing spells gain +1d6 healing during Waxing Moon. Lunar Blessing can target one additional ally. New Moon regeneration heals 1 additional target within 30ft.

moonwell-guardian.name: Moonwell Sanctuary
moonwell-guardian.description: You can create a moonwell as an action. Allies within 20ft of the moonwell regain 1d8 HP at the start of their turns and have +1 to saves.

moonwell-guardian.name: Protective Aura
moonwell-guardian.description: Allies within 10ft of you gain +1 armor and resistance to necrotic damage. During Waxing Moon, this bonus increases to +2 armor.

moonwell-guardian.name: Lunar Shield
moonwell-guardian.description: As a reaction when an ally within 30ft takes damage, you can reduce the damage by 2d6 per rank and heal them for the reduced amount.

moonwell-guardian.name: Lunar Blessing
moonwell-guardian.description: You can bless an ally using 1 action point. Blessed allies gain +1d6 to their next attack roll, save, or healing received.

moonwell-guardian.name: Mass Restoration
moonwell-guardian.description: Moonlight Heal can affect all allies within 30ft. During Waxing Moon, Moonlight Heal also removes one curse, disease, or poison from each target.

moonwell-guardian.name: Celestial Guardian
moonwell-guardian.description: Once per turn when an ally within 60ft would be reduced to 0 HP, you can automatically stabilize them and heal them for 3d6 HP.

moonwell-guardian.name: Lunar Resurgence
moonwell-guardian.description: When you cast a healing spell, you can spend 2 extra mana to cause excess healing to create a lunar barrier that absorbs the next 2d6 damage per rank.

moonwell-guardian.name: Eternal Moonwell
moonwell-guardian.description: Your moonwell becomes permanent and can be created using 1 action point. Allies within 30ft of your moonwell cannot be frightened or charmed.

moonwell-guardian.name: Lunar Apotheosis
moonwell-guardian.description: Ultimate ability: Create a massive moonwell for 1 minute. All allies within 40ft regain 4d6 HP at the start of each turn and are immune to necrotic damage. Costs 12 mana.

shadowblade.name: Glaive Mastery
shadowblade.description: Shadow Glaive chains to +1 additional target. You can spend 1 AP to hide after a successful glaive attack.

shadowblade.name: Shadow Strike
shadowblade.description: Glaive attacks from stealth deal +2d6 bonus damage and generate +1 extra Quarry Mark. You can enter stealth using 1 AP while in combat.

shadowblade.name: Dark Presence
shadowblade.description: Enemies within 10ft of you have disadvantage on Perception checks to detect you. Your companion can enter stealth with you.

shadowblade.name: Phantom Step
shadowblade.description: Spend 2 Quarry Marks to teleport 30ft to an enemy within 60ft, appearing in stealth and attacking with advantage.

shadowblade.name: Chain Mastery
shadowblade.description: Shadow Glaive chains ignore difficult terrain and can chain through allies. Chained enemies take +1d4 damage per chain link.

shadowblade.name: Glaive Dance
shadowblade.description: After a successful glaive attack, you can spend 1 Quarry Mark to immediately attack another enemy within range.

shadowblade.name: Shadow Eruption
shadowblade.description: When you kill an enemy with a glaive attack, all enemies within 10ft take 2d6 shadow damage and cannot take reactions until your next turn.

shadowblade.name: Shadow Synergy
shadowblade.description: Your companion attacks generate Quarry Marks as if they were your glaive attacks. Stealth attacks allow you to spend 1 Quarry Mark to mark the target automatically.

shadowblade.name: Apex Predator
shadowblade.description: While you have 5 Quarry Marks, your glaive attacks crit on 18-20. You can spend 1 Quarry Mark to make a glaive attack as a reaction when an enemy attacks you.

shadowblade.name: Shadow Assassin
shadowblade.description: Ultimate: Become a shadow entity for 1 minute. All attacks are silent and cannot be heard, you phase through walls, and glaive attacks deal maximum damage. Costs 5 Quarry Marks.

bladestorm.name: Whirling Blades
bladestorm.description: Your Shadow Glaive can chain to +1 additional target (total 5). Chain damage no longer reduces after the second target — all chained hits deal at least 1d6.

bladestorm.name: Momentum
bladestorm.description: Each successful chain attack grants +1 to your next attack roll (max +3). Bonus resets if you miss. Hitting multiple enemies in one swing builds Momentum faster.

bladestorm.name: Extended Reach
bladestorm.description: Glaive chain distance increased from 5ft to 10ft. You can position further from enemies while still chaining between grouped targets.

bladestorm.name: Chain Reaction
bladestorm.description: When your glaive chains to 3+ enemies in a single attack, your next glaive attack this turn chains to +1 additional target for free (no QM cost).

bladestorm.name: Cleave
bladestorm.description: Primary glaive target takes +1d8 damage. If the primary target drops to 0 HP from your attack, all chained targets take an additional 1d6 slashing damage.

bladestorm.name: Rising Storm
bladestorm.description: Each enemy hit by your glaive chain increases your movement speed by +5ft until end of turn (max +15ft). Hit 3 enemies, move 15ft extra to reposition for next chain.

bladestorm.name: Blade Frenzy
bladestorm.description: Spend 2 QM to immediately make a second glaive chain attack after your first one resolves. Both attacks generate QM normally (subject to per-turn cap).

bladestorm.name: Storm Synergy
bladestorm.description: When you hit 3+ enemies with a single glaive attack, you and your companion each gain +2 Armor until your next turn. The storm of blades shields you both.

bladestorm.name: Hurricane
bladestorm.description: While you have 3+ Quarry Marks, your glaive attacks are AoE — all enemies within 5ft of each chain target also take half damage. Your glaive is a storm of steel.

bladestorm.name: Hurricane of Blades
bladestorm.description: Ultimate: Become a living storm of blades for 3 rounds. All glaive attacks chain to up to 8 targets within 15ft, chain damage does not reduce below 1d6, and generate +1 bonus QM per target hit (still subject to per-turn cap). Costs 5 Quarry Marks.

beastmaster.name: Primal Bond
beastmaster.description: Your companion deals +1d6 damage on all attacks. When you spend Quarry Marks on abilities, your companion gains +1d4 damage for 1 minute.

beastmaster.name: Coordinated Strike
beastmaster.description: When you and your companion attack the same enemy in the same round, both attacks gain advantage. Your companion can flank enemies 10ft away from you.

beastmaster.name: Beast Fury
beastmaster.description: Your companion can make 2 attacks per action instead of 1. When your companion crits, you gain +1 Quarry Mark.

beastmaster.name: Savage Coordination
beastmaster.description: Once per turn, when your companion attacks, you can spend 1 Quarry Mark to make a glaive attack against the same target using 1 AP.

beastmaster.name: Bestial Synergy
beastmaster.description: When you or your companion damage an enemy, the other gains +1d4 damage on their next attack against that enemy.

beastmaster.name: Primal Coordination
beastmaster.description: When you and your companion both hit the same target in one turn, that target takes +1d8 bonus damage and you generate +1 bonus Quarry Mark (bypasses per-turn cap).

beastmaster.name: Primal Hunter
beastmaster.description: Your companion gains the ability to mark targets. Marked targets take +1d6 damage from your companion and cannot hide from it.

beastmaster.name: Alpha Predator
beastmaster.description: Your companion can spend your Quarry Marks to enhance its abilities. When you spend Quarry Marks on companion enhancements, the effect is doubled.

beastmaster.name: Primal Ascension
beastmaster.description: You and your companion share all damage and healing. When either of you takes damage, the other gains temporary HP equal to half the damage taken.

beastmaster.name: Beast Lord
beastmaster.description: Ultimate: You and your companion transform into apex predators for 1 minute. Both gain +2d6 damage, advantage on attacks, and can make 2 attacks per action. Costs 5 Quarry Marks.

shadowblade.name: Vengeful Pursuit
shadowblade.description: Vengeance Points build 50% faster from successful attacks against marked targets. You can mark targets as a 1 action point, gaining +1 VP per successful attack against them.

shadowblade.name: Shadow Stalker
shadowblade.description: You can hide as a 1 action point after attacking. Stealth attacks generate +2 VP instead of +1. Marked targets cannot detect you through blindsight or tremorsense.

shadowblade.name: Predator Strike
shadowblade.description: Attacks against marked targets crit on 19-20. When you crit against a marked target, you can teleport 10ft to another enemy within 30ft.

shadowblade.name: Unseen Executioner
shadowblade.description: Marked targets below 50% HP take double damage from your attacks. When you kill a marked target, you can hide as a 1 action point.

shadowblade.name: Precision Strike
shadowblade.description: Spend 1 VP to expand your crit range to 19-20 against marked targets for one attack. On crit, generate +1 VP.

shadowblade.name: Execution Strike
shadowblade.description: Spend 4 VP to attempt to execute a target below 25% HP. Target must succeed on a CON save (DC 15 + your proficiency) or take triple damage.

shadowblade.name: Deadly Precision
shadowblade.description: Your attacks against marked targets ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Marked targets have disadvantage on saves against your abilities.

shadowblade.name: Death Mark
shadowblade.description: When your marked target dies, gain 3 VP instantly and can mark a new target as a free action. This can trigger once per round.

shadowblade.name: Apex Hunter
shadowblade.description: While you have 8+ VP, your attacks against marked targets deal maximum damage and you can spend 1 VP to attack twice as a reaction when hit.

shadowblade.name: Shadowblade Ascendant
shadowblade.description: Ultimate ability: Become a shadow entity for 1 minute. All attacks are silent, you phase through walls, attacks deal +4d6 damage, and marked targets cannot escape. Costs all VP.

jailer.name: Spectral Warden
jailer.description: Cage of Vengeance costs 1 less VP. Caged enemies take +1d6 damage from all sources and have disadvantage on escape attempts. VP decay is reduced to once every 2 turns instead of every turn.

jailer.name: Enhanced Caging
jailer.description: Cage of Vengeance lasts 1 round longer. Caged enemies cannot teleport or plane shift. You can spend 1 VP to extend any cage by 1 round.

jailer.name: Cage Torment
jailer.description: When you cage an enemy, they take 1d8 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns while caged. Simple and relentless.

jailer.name: Isolation Protocol
jailer.description: Caged enemies cannot be targeted by their allies' spells or abilities. When an ally tries to help a caged enemy, they take 2d6 force damage.

jailer.name: Mass Confinement
jailer.description: You can spend 8 VP to cage all enemies in a 20ft radius. This creates multiple smaller cages that last 2 rounds each.

jailer.name: Prison Complex
jailer.description: You can maintain up to 3 cages simultaneously. Caged enemies within 20ft of each other share damage - damage to one is split among all caged enemies.

jailer.name: Execution Chamber
jailer.description: Spend 6 VP to create an execution chamber around a caged enemy. They take double damage from all sources and cannot be healed for 3 rounds.

jailer.name: Spectral Overlord
jailer.description: Your cages become immune to dispel magic. Caged enemies generate VP for you equal to the damage they take. You can teleport between your cages as a 1 action point.

jailer.name: Iron Bars
jailer.description: Cage of Vengeance costs 4 VP instead of 6. Caged enemies have disadvantage on all saves. Cages are immune to dispel magic. Caged creatures cannot use legendary actions.

jailer.name: Vengeance Unleashed
jailer.description: Ultimate ability: All active cages explode for 4d6 necrotic damage per caged enemy, then re-form. Enemies caught in the explosion radius are caged for 3 rounds. Costs all VP.

avenger.name: Unyielding Vengeance
avenger.description: Vengeance Points max at 15 instead of 10. When you take damage, gain +1 VP. Avatar of Vengeance lasts 1 round longer and grants +1 damage per die.

avenger.name: Vengeful Strikes
avenger.description: While at 5+ VP, your attacks deal +1d6 necrotic damage. At 8+ VP, this increases to +2d6 necrotic damage.

avenger.name: Spectral Retribution
avenger.description: When you take damage, the attacker takes 2d6 necrotic damage in return. This damage increases by 1d6 for each VP you have (maximum +6d6). This effect can trigger once per round.

avenger.name: Haunting Vengeance
avenger.description: Enemies that damage you are marked with haunting vengeance. They take 3d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 3 rounds. The target can attempt a CON save (DC 10 + your proficiency) at the end of each of their turns to end this effect early.

avenger.name: Fury Buildup
avenger.description: You gain +1 VP when you kill an enemy. When you reach maximum VP, your next attack deals +4d6 force damage and knocks the target back 20ft.

avenger.name: Avatar Synergy
avenger.description: During Avatar of Vengeance, you gain +2 VP per round instead of +1. Avatar abilities cost 2 VP less to use. Avatar lasts 2 rounds longer.

avenger.name: Spectral Conflagration
avenger.description: When you activate Avatar of Vengeance, all enemies within 20ft take 4d6 necrotic damage and are haunted, taking 2d6 necrotic damage per round for 3 rounds.

avenger.name: Eternal Wrath
avenger.description: VP cannot decay below 5. When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you can spend 5 VP to automatically stabilize and enter Avatar of Vengeance.

avenger.name: Avatar Perfection
avenger.description: During Avatar of Vengeance, you are immune to necrotic damage, your attacks deal maximum necrotic damage, and you can teleport 30ft between attacks.

avenger.name: Warden Eternal
avenger.description: Ultimate ability: Become the living embodiment of vengeance for 1 minute. All damage you deal becomes force or necrotic (your choice), you take half damage from all sources, and enemies that damage you explode for 8d6 force damage in 20ft radius. Costs all VP.

vengeance-seeker.name: Unyielding Vengeance
vengeance-seeker.description: Vengeance Points max at 15 instead of 10. When you take damage, gain +1 VP. Avatar of Vengeance lasts 1 round longer and grants +1 damage per die.

vengeance-seeker.name: Vengeful Strikes
vengeance-seeker.description: While at 5+ VP, your attacks deal +1d6 necrotic damage. At 8+ VP, this increases to +2d6 necrotic damage.

vengeance-seeker.name: Spectral Retribution
vengeance-seeker.description: When you take damage, the attacker takes 2d6 necrotic damage in return. This damage increases by 1d6 for each VP you have (maximum +6d6). This effect can trigger once per round.

vengeance-seeker.name: Haunting Vengeance
vengeance-seeker.description: Enemies that damage you are marked with haunting vengeance. They take 3d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns for 3 rounds. The target can attempt a CON save (DC 10 + your proficiency) at the end of each of their turns to end this effect early.

vengeance-seeker.name: Fury Buildup
vengeance-seeker.description: You gain +1 VP when you kill an enemy. When you reach maximum VP, your next attack deals +4d6 force damage and knocks the target back 20ft.

vengeance-seeker.name: Avatar Synergy
vengeance-seeker.description: During Avatar of Vengeance, you gain +2 VP per round instead of +1. Avatar abilities cost 2 VP less to use. Avatar lasts 2 rounds longer.

vengeance-seeker.name: Spectral Conflagration
vengeance-seeker.description: When you activate Avatar of Vengeance, all enemies within 20ft take 4d6 necrotic damage and are haunted, taking 2d6 necrotic damage per round for 3 rounds.

vengeance-seeker.name: Eternal Wrath
vengeance-seeker.description: VP cannot decay below 5. When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you can spend 5 VP to automatically stabilize and enter Avatar of Vengeance.

vengeance-seeker.name: Avatar Perfection
vengeance-seeker.description: During Avatar of Vengeance, you are immune to necrotic damage, your attacks deal maximum necrotic damage, and you can teleport 30ft between attacks.

vengeance-seeker.name: Warden Eternal
vengeance-seeker.description: Ultimate ability: Become the living embodiment of vengeance for 1 minute. All damage you deal becomes force or necrotic (your choice), you take half damage from all sources, and enemies that damage you explode for 8d6 force damage in 20ft radius. Costs all VP.

primal_rage.name: Inner Fire
primal_rage.description: Your rage burns hotter. Generate +1 Rage per rank when you attack.

primal_rage.name: Fury Damage
primal_rage.description: +1 weapon damage per Rage State above Smoldering. Rank 2+: Spend 1 Rage for advantage on your next attack. Rank 4: Bonus increases to +2 per State.

primal_rage.name: Carnage Strike
primal_rage.description: Unlocks Carnage Strike - spend 40 Rage for +2d6 damage and advantage on attack.

primal_rage.name: Cataclysmic Blow
primal_rage.description: Unlocks Cataclysmic Blow - spend 80 Rage for 3d6 extra damage and knockback 10 ft.

primal_rage.name: Obliterating Strike
primal_rage.description: Unlocks Obliterating Strike - spend 100+ Rage for 4d8 damage and area effect.

primal_rage.name: Bloodlust
primal_rage.description: Rank 1: Critical hits generate +1d4 Rage. Rank 2: Critical hits generate +1d4 Rage. You can enter a Frenzied Rage State using action points. Rank 3: Critical hits generate +1d6 Rage. You can enter a Frenzied Rage State using action points. Rank 4: Critical hits generate +1d6 Rage. You can enter a Frenzied Rage State using action points and reduce Rage decay by 1.

primal_rage.name: Frenzied Strikes
primal_rage.description: Attacks while Frenzied generate +1 additional Rage per rank.

primal_rage.name: Rage Echo
primal_rage.description: When you defeat an enemy, nearby allies generate 1d6 Rage per rank.

primal_rage.name: Primal Surge
primal_rage.description: Once per combat, instantly reach Primal Rage State and gain +1d8 Rage per rank.

primal_rage.name: Rage Decay
primal_rage.description: Rage decays by 3 less per round per rank.

primal_rage.name: Overheat Resistance
primal_rage.description: Overheat threshold increases by 10 per rank.

primal_rage.name: Fury Mastery
primal_rage.description: Rage abilities cost 10 less Rage per rank.

primal_rage.name: Rage Overflow
primal_rage.description: When you would Overheat, spend all Rage on a free Obliterating Strike instead.

primal_rage.name: Apocalyptic Wrath
primal_rage.description: At Obliteration Rage State, all attacks deal +2d6 damage and you become immune to control effects.

primal_rage.name: God Mode
primal_rage.description: At Obliteration Rage State, you gain +20 temp HP and attacks have advantage.

primal_rage.name: Berserker God
primal_rage.description: Permanently locked in Obliteration state. Overheat no longer triggers. Instead, take 1d6 damage per round. Rage-spending abilities still consume Rage as normal — if Rage drops below 101, you leave Obliteration until you build back up.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Magic
blood_frenzy.description: Taking damage generates +1 additional Rage per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Rage
blood_frenzy.description: Convert HP damage to Rage. Roll 1d4 per rank - gain that much Rage instead of taking damage.

blood_frenzy.name: Crimson Wave
blood_frenzy.description: Unlocks Crimson Wave - spend 30 Rage to heal 2d8 HP and damage nearby enemies for 1d8.

blood_frenzy.name: Sanguine Eruption
blood_frenzy.description: Unlocks Sanguine Eruption - spend 60 Rage to deal 3d6 damage in 15 ft radius and heal for half.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Storm
blood_frenzy.description: Unlocks Blood Storm - spend 90 Rage to create blood storm dealing 4d6 damage per round for 3 rounds.

blood_frenzy.name: Wound Power
blood_frenzy.description: For each 25% missing HP per rank, gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

blood_frenzy.name: Bloody Retaliation
blood_frenzy.description: When damaged, your next attack gains +1d4 damage per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Life Steal
blood_frenzy.description: Weapon attacks heal you for 1d4 HP per rank when below 50% HP.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Fury
blood_frenzy.description: While below 25% HP, attacks generate +1d6 Rage per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Pain Threshold
blood_frenzy.description: You have advantage on saves while below 50% HP per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Adrenaline Rush
blood_frenzy.description: When reduced below 25% HP, gain +10 movement speed and +2 to all rolls for 1 round.

blood_frenzy.name: Berserk Healing
blood_frenzy.description: While in Carnage Rage State, regenerate 1d6 HP per round per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Deathless Fury
blood_frenzy.description: Cannot be reduced below 1 HP by attacks. Excess damage becomes Rage instead.

blood_frenzy.name: Hemorrhagic Link
blood_frenzy.description: When you damage an enemy, they bleed for 1d4 damage per round per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Vampiric Echo
blood_frenzy.description: Life Steal heals nearby allies for half the amount per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood God
blood_frenzy.description: At Obliteration Rage State, you heal 2d6 HP per round and enemies take 2d6 damage when they damage you.

blood_frenzy.name: Eternal Frenzy
blood_frenzy.description: At Obliteration Rage State, you cannot be killed while Rage remains. Death resets you to 1 HP instead.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Ritual
blood_frenzy.description: Sacrifice HP to gain Rage. Spend 10 HP to gain 20 Rage per rank.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood God Ascended
blood_frenzy.description: Unlocks Blood God Ascension - transform into a blood god, dealing damage equal to HP lost this combat.

savage_instincts.name: Primal Awareness
savage_instincts.description: You have advantage on Perception checks to detect hidden enemies per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Predator's Grasp
savage_instincts.description: Flanking attacks deal +1d6 damage per rank. You always count as flanking.

savage_instincts.name: Hunter's Instinct
savage_instincts.description: When you hit a wounded enemy, deal +1d8 damage per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Blood Scent
savage_instincts.description: You can track wounded creatures by scent. +2 to Survival checks to track bleeding enemies.

savage_instincts.name: Survival Instincts
savage_instincts.description: You have +1 armor per rank when fighting outnumbered. Maximum +5.

savage_instincts.name: Endurance Training
savage_instincts.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 5 per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Peak Conditioning
savage_instincts.description: You gain +5 ft movement speed per rank and ignore difficult terrain.

savage_instincts.name: Combat Instincts
savage_instincts.description: You have advantage on initiative rolls per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Weapon Specialization
savage_instincts.description: Choose a weapon type. You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with that weapon type per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Combat Mastery
savage_instincts.description: Reduces the Action Point cost of attacks by 1 per rank (minimum 1 AP).

savage_instincts.name: Primal Bond
savage_instincts.description: You can share senses with nearby beasts. Range 30 ft per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Animal Kinship
savage_instincts.description: Beasts have +1 to attack rolls against your enemies per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Tactical Awareness
savage_instincts.description: You can direct one ally per rank as a 1 action point, granting them +1d4 damage on their next attack.

savage_instincts.name: Leadership Presence
savage_instincts.description: Allies within 30 ft gain +1 to morale saves per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Terrain Mastery
savage_instincts.description: You gain +2 to attack rolls in natural terrain per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Environmental Adaptation
savage_instincts.description: You are resistant to environmental damage (cold, heat, etc.) per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Primal Avatar
savage_instincts.description: You can transform into a primal avatar for 1 minute. Gain +2 to all rolls and +10 temp HP.

savage_instincts.name: Battle Hardened
savage_instincts.description: You cannot be surprised and have advantage on saves against being frightened.

savage_instincts.name: Primal Force
savage_instincts.description: Your primal abilities affect a 30 ft radius per rank.

savage_instincts.name: Coming Soon
savage_instincts.description: This talent tree is under development.

earthwarden.name: Stone Bond
earthwarden.description: Your totems gain +2 HP per rank. When you place a totem, roll 1d6. On 4+ per rank, the totem gains +1 HP.

earthwarden.name: Healing Waters
earthwarden.description: Healing Totem heals +1d4 HP per rank. Rejuvenation Totem heals +1d4 HP per rank.

earthwarden.name: Sanctuary Circle
earthwarden.description: Healing Sanctuary synergy lasts +1 turn per rank and heals +1d6 HP.

earthwarden.name: Protective Synergy
earthwarden.description: When you activate a synergy, roll 1d4 per rank. On 3+, the synergy lasts +1 turn.

earthwarden.name: Sustained Sanctuary
earthwarden.description: Healing Sanctuary synergy now heals at the start of each of your turns, not just once.

earthwarden.name: Earthen Shield
earthwarden.description: Guardian Totem absorbs +2 damage per rank. Earth Totem grants +1 armor per rank.

earthwarden.name: Earth's Resilience
earthwarden.description: Allies within totem range gain +1 to saving throws per rank.

earthwarden.name: Ancestral Guardian
earthwarden.description: When a totem is destroyed, roll 1d20. On 15+ per rank, summon a stone spirit that lasts 2 turns and provides the totem's effects.

earthwarden.name: Totemic Mastery
earthwarden.description: You can maintain +1 additional totem per rank. When placing totems, roll 1d6 per rank — on 5+, increase totem radius by 5ft.

earthwarden.name: Totem Regeneration
earthwarden.description: At the start of your turn, roll 1d8 per rank. On 6+, heal one totem for 1d6 HP.

earthwarden.name: Living Earth
earthwarden.description: Totems gain +1d6 temporary HP per rank that they share with allies within range.

earthwarden.name: Earthquake Strike
earthwarden.description: Once per combat, unleash an earthquake. Enemies within totem range take 2d8 bludgeoning damage per rank and must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone.

earthwarden.name: Earthen Fortress
earthwarden.description: Allies within totem range gain resistance to non-magical damage. Enemies take 1d6 damage when they attack allies within totem range.

earthwarden.name: Spirit of the Earth
earthwarden.description: Totems can be repositioned for 0 action points. When repositioned, totems heal 1d8 HP.

earthwarden.name: Earth's Embrace
earthwarden.description: Unlocks Earth's Embrace - create a massive earthen dome around your party. Allies inside gain immunity to damage for 3 rounds. Costs all Totemic Synergy.

stormbringer.name: Elemental Focus
stormbringer.description: When you place an elemental totem, roll 1d6. On 4+ per rank, gain +1 Totemic Synergy.

stormbringer.name: Flame Enhancement
stormbringer.description: Flamecaller Totem adds +1d4 fire damage per rank to weapon attacks.

stormbringer.name: Elemental Damage
stormbringer.description: All elemental totems deal +1d6 damage per rank of their element type.

stormbringer.name: Burning Ground
stormbringer.description: Flamecaller Totem creates burning ground that deals 1d6 fire damage per rank at the start of enemy turns.

stormbringer.name: Elemental Storm
stormbringer.description: Once per combat, unleash an elemental storm. Enemies within totem range take 3d6 damage of each element type per rank.

stormbringer.name: Storm Power
stormbringer.description: Storm Totem grants +1 to spell attack rolls and DCs per rank.

stormbringer.name: Fury Synergy
stormbringer.description: Elemental Fury synergy deals +2d6 damage per element per rank.

stormbringer.name: Reduced Threshold
stormbringer.description: You can trigger synergies with 1 fewer totem per rank (minimum 3 totems).

stormbringer.name: Fury Overload
stormbringer.description: Elemental Fury synergy lasts +1 turn per rank and can be maintained by spending 2 Synergy per turn.

stormbringer.name: Lightning Strike
stormbringer.description: Storm Totem can strike enemies for 2d6 lightning damage per rank as a reaction.

stormbringer.name: Freezing Zone
stormbringer.description: Frost Totem creates a freezing zone. Enemies must succeed on a Constitution save or be frozen for 1 round.

stormbringer.name: Wind Rider
stormbringer.description: Wind Totem grants allies +20 ft movement speed per rank and advantage on Agility saves.

stormbringer.name: Primal Rage
stormbringer.description: When you activate Elemental Fury, roll 1d4 per rank. On 3+, enemies take an additional 2d6 damage of each element.

stormbringer.name: Storm Lord
stormbringer.description: When placing elemental totems, roll 1d6 per rank. On 6, you can place that totem for 0 mana.

stormbringer.name: Primal Tempest
stormbringer.description: Unlocks Primal Tempest - summon a massive storm that deals 6d6 damage of each element in 60ft radius over 3 rounds. Costs all Totemic Synergy.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Whispers
spiritcaller.description: When you place a totem, roll 1d6. On 5+ per rank, enemies within totem range have disadvantage on their next save.

spiritcaller.name: Expanded Reach
spiritcaller.description: All totems have +5 ft radius per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Walk
spiritcaller.description: You can teleport to any active totem location as a 1 action point per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Ancestral Bond
spiritcaller.description: When placing totems, roll 1d6 per rank. On 5+, grant +1 to totem HP per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Debilitating Effects
spiritcaller.description: Enemies within totem range have -1 to attack rolls and saves per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Ancestral Guidance
spiritcaller.description: Totems reveal invisible enemies within range. When placing totems, roll 1d6 per rank — on 6, reveal all hidden enemies within 30ft.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Storm
spiritcaller.description: Once per combat, unleash a spirit storm. Enemies within totem range take 2d8 psychic damage per rank and are stunned on failed Spirit save.

spiritcaller.name: Totem Projection
spiritcaller.description: You can project totem effects to a distant location within 60 ft per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Synergy
spiritcaller.description: When you activate a synergy, enemies within totem range are frightened for 1 round.

spiritcaller.name: Enhanced Synergies
spiritcaller.description: All synergy effects have their radius doubled per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Free Repositioning
spiritcaller.description: Totems can be repositioned for 0 action points per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Wind Manipulation
spiritcaller.description: Wind Totem can push enemies 10 ft per rank and create difficult terrain.

spiritcaller.name: Totemic Conduit
spiritcaller.description: You can channel spells through totems, extending their range by totem radius per rank.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Link
spiritcaller.description: You can swap positions between any two active totems as a 1 action point.

spiritcaller.name: Ancestral Echo
spiritcaller.description: When a totem effect triggers, roll 1d6. On 6, the effect triggers again at reduced power.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Bind
spiritcaller.description: Enemies within totem range cannot teleport or plane shift. When they attempt to, roll 1d4 — on 1, they take 3d6 psychic damage instead.

spiritcaller.name: Ancestral Army
spiritcaller.description: When a totem is destroyed, summon 1d4 spirit warriors per rank that last 3 rounds.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Weaving
spiritcaller.description: You can connect any two totems with a spirit thread, allowing effects to chain between them.

spiritcaller.name: Spirit Realm
spiritcaller.description: Unlocks Spirit Realm - banish all enemies within totem range to the spirit world for 3 rounds. They cannot affect or be affected by anything. Costs all Totemic Synergy.

blood_reaver.name: Sanguine Mastery
blood_reaver.description: Your blood sacrifices are more efficient. Blood Token generation increases by 1 per rank. Health costs for spells are reduced by 1d4.

blood_reaver.name: Blood Rush
blood_reaver.description: After casting a life drain spell, gain +10ft movement speed per rank for 2 turns.

blood_reaver.name: Drain Efficiency
blood_reaver.description: Life drain spells restore 10% more HP per rank. Life drain spells cost 2 less mana.

blood_reaver.name: Rush of Blood
blood_reaver.description: When you drop below 50% HP, life drain spells cost 1 less AP per rank (minimum 0).

blood_reaver.name: Blood Token Mastery
blood_reaver.description: Blood Tokens enhance life drain spells by +1d6 damage per 2 tokens spent (instead of +1d4 per token).

blood_reaver.name: Sanguine Burst
blood_reaver.description: Life drain spells create a burst of blood dealing 1d8 damage per rank to enemies within 10ft.

blood_reaver.name: Blood Fury
blood_reaver.description: When you kill an enemy with a life drain spell, gain +1d6 damage per rank on all attacks for 2 turns.

blood_reaver.name: Vampiric Empowerment
blood_reaver.description: Life drain spells heal for an additional 2d6 HP per rank when cast on enemies below 50% HP.

blood_reaver.name: Blood Storm
blood_reaver.description: Once per combat, unleash a blood storm dealing 3d6 damage per rank to all enemies within 30ft and healing you for half the total damage.

spectral_master.name: Summoning Prowess
spectral_master.description: Spectral summons cost 1d6 less HP per rank. Summons gain +10 HP per rank.

spectral_master.name: Spectral Durability
spectral_master.description: Spectral summons gain +1 armor per rank and resistance to necrotic damage.

spectral_master.name: Spirit Link
spectral_master.description: You can share senses with one spectral summon per rank within 1 mile.

spectral_master.name: Spectral Offense
spectral_master.description: Spectral summons deal +1d6 necrotic damage per rank with their attacks.

spectral_master.name: Mass Summoning
spectral_master.description: You can maintain +1 additional spectral summon per rank.

spectral_master.name: Spectral Mobility
spectral_master.description: Spectral summons gain +10ft movement speed per rank.

spectral_master.name: Spectral Command
spectral_master.description: Spectral summons can use your spellcasting ability for attack rolls and DCs.

spectral_master.name: Deathly Swarm
spectral_master.description: When a spectral summon dies, it explodes dealing 2d6 necrotic damage per rank to enemies within 10ft.

spectral_master.name: Spectral Legion
spectral_master.description: Once per combat, summon a legion of 4 spectral warriors that last 1 minute and follow your commands.

void_caller.name: Void Attunement
void_caller.description: Psychic spells ignore resistance and cost 1 less HP per rank. Gain +1 to psychic spell DCs.

void_caller.name: Void Shield
void_caller.description: Gain resistance to psychic damage. Psychic spells create a shield that absorbs 2d6 damage per rank.

void_caller.name: Mind Drain
void_caller.description: Psychic spells drain 1d6 HP per rank from enemies and restore half to you.

void_caller.name: Void Eruption
void_caller.description: Psychic spells create void eruptions dealing 1d8 psychic damage per rank to enemies within 5ft.

void_caller.name: Psychic Resonance
void_caller.description: When you take psychic damage, the attacker takes 1d6 psychic damage per rank.

void_caller.name: Mental Dominion
void_caller.description: Psychic spells can charm or frighten enemies for 1 extra turn per rank.

void_caller.name: Void Mastery
void_caller.description: Psychic spells have their range doubled per rank.

void_caller.name: Psychic Storm
void_caller.description: Once per combat, unleash a psychic storm dealing 3d6 psychic damage to all enemies within 20ft.

void_caller.name: Void Nova
void_caller.description: Once per combat, create a void nova that deals 4d6 psychic damage to all enemies within 30ft and stuns them for 1 round.

auspex.name: Harmonic Sight
auspex.description: Passive: You see both the light and dark in every omen. Gain +1 to both Benediction and Malediction at the start of each combat per rank.

auspex.name: Omen Synthesis
auspex.description: Convert 2 points of one resource into 1 point of the other. Usable once per round per rank.

auspex.name: Dual Reading
auspex.description: When you generate Benediction or Malediction from a d20, gain +1 of the same type as well per rank. Stacks with Harmonic Interpretation (passive: opposite type).

auspex.name: Quick Interpret
auspex.description: Passive: Your first omen-spell each combat costs 1 less Benediction or Malediction (minimum 0) per rank.

auspex.name: Balanced Step
auspex.description: Passive: When Benediction and Malediction are within 2 points of each other, gain +1 to all saves per rank.

auspex.name: Harmonic Bolt
auspex.description: Attack: Spend 1 Benediction + 1 Malediction to deal 2d8 radiant + 2d8 psychic damage. +1d8 per type per rank.

auspex.name: Zone of Balance
auspex.description: Spend 2 Benediction + 2 Malediction to create 15ft zone for 3 rounds: allies +1 to rolls, enemies -1 to rolls. Radius +5ft per rank.

auspex.name: Resource Flow
auspex.description: Passive: When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on the same spell, refund 1 of each per rank.

auspex.name: Sign of Equilibrium
auspex.description: Passive: When an enemy within 30ft rolls a natural 20, you gain 2 Benediction. When they roll a natural 1, gain 2 Malediction.

auspex.name: Twin Blessing
auspex.description: Spend 3 Benediction + 3 Malediction to bless two allies: one gains +2 to attacks, other gains +2 to saves for 3 rounds per rank.

auspex.name: Omen Mastery
auspex.description: Passive: Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 3. You generate +1 of each resource at the start of each turn.

auspex.name: Perfect Balance
auspex.description: Passive: When you cast a spell using equal Benediction and Malediction, its effects are maximized (all dice roll maximum). Once per short rest per rank.

auspex.name: Cosmic Echo
auspex.description: When a Balanced Sign or Harmonic Bolt resolves, gain back half the spent resources (rounded down) per rank.

auspex.name: Auspice Supreme
auspex.description: Passive: All d20 rolls within 60ft generate double Benediction and double Malediction for you. Activated: Spend 8 Benediction + 8 Malediction to force all enemies to reroll their last action with disadvantage while all allies reroll with advantage.

harbinger.name: Dark Portent
harbinger.description: Passive: Every odd d20 roll generates +1 bonus Malediction. The darker the omen, the stronger you become.

harbinger.name: Ill Omen
harbinger.description: Spend 2 Malediction to curse a target with ill fortune: -1 to their next d20 roll per rank. Stacks up to 3 times.

harbinger.name: Misfortune Aura
harbinger.description: Passive: Enemies within 15ft have -1 to all d20 rolls per rank. The aura of ill omen surrounds you.

harbinger.name: Sign of Decay
harbinger.description: Spend 1 Malediction to deal 1d8 psychic damage to a target. Damage increases by 1d8 per rank. Costs 0 AP.

harbinger.name: Wasting Portent
harbinger.description: Passive: Your Malediction-powered debuffs last +1 round per rank. Ill omens linger longer.

harbinger.name: Curse Stack
harbinger.description: Spend 3 Malediction to stack an "Ill Omen" debuff on a target: -1 to all rolls per stack, max 3 stacks. Lasts 3 rounds per rank.

harbinger.name: Terrain of Ill
harbinger.description: Spend 4 Malediction to curse 20ft of terrain for 3 rounds: enemies take 1d6 psychic/turn, -10ft speed. +1d6 damage per rank.

harbinger.name: Dark Conviction
harbinger.description: Passive: When a target affected by your Malediction debuff rolls a natural 1, you gain 3 Malediction per rank.

harbinger.name: Omen of Frailty
harbinger.description: Passive: Targets affected by 2+ of your Malediction debuffs have vulnerability to psychic damage per rank.

harbinger.name: Malediction Overflow
harbinger.description: Passive: When Malediction is at max, each odd d20 roll instead deals 1d4 psychic damage to the nearest enemy per rank.

harbinger.name: Dark Revelation
harbinger.description: Passive: When you reduce a target to 0 HP with a Malediction-powered spell, regain 4 Malediction and 10 mana per rank.

harbinger.name: Ultimate Portent
harbinger.description: Spend 8 Malediction to force a target to roll all d20s with disadvantage for 3 rounds. No save per rank of additional targets.

harbinger.name: Void Gaze
harbinger.description: Passive: Your Malediction generation from natural 1s is tripled instead of doubled. Your aura radius increases by 10ft per rank.

harbinger.name: Harbinger Supreme
harbinger.description: Passive: All odd d20 rolls within 60ft generate triple Malediction. Enemies have -2 to all rolls in your presence. Activated: Spend 15 Malediction to curse all enemies in 40ft — they take 8d10 psychic damage and are stunned for 2 rounds on failed Spirit save.

hierophant.name: Cosmic Channel
hierophant.description: Passive: Every even d20 roll generates +1 bonus Benediction. The brighter the omen, the stronger your blessings.

hierophant.name: Sign of Vigor
hierophant.description: Spend 1 Benediction to heal an ally for 1d8 + Spirit modifier. Healing increases by 1d8 per rank.

hierophant.name: Blessed Terrain
hierophant.description: Passive: Your Benediction-powered terrain/zones last +1 round per rank and radius increases by 5ft per rank.

hierophant.name: Ward of Light
hierophant.description: Spend 2 Benediction to grant an ally +2 Armor for 3 rounds. Armor bonus +1 per rank.

hierophant.name: Radiant Purpose
hierophant.description: Passive: When you generate Benediction from an even natural 20, gain +3 Benediction instead of +2 per rank.

hierophant.name: Sacred Ground
hierophant.description: Spend 4 Benediction to create 15ft blessed zone for 4 rounds: allies +1 to saves, heal 1d4/turn. +5ft radius per rank.

hierophant.name: Sanctuary
hierophant.description: Spend 3 Benediction to make an ally immune to the next attack targeting them. Lasts until triggered or 1 round per rank.

hierophant.name: Divine Resonance
hierophant.description: Passive: When an ally within your blessed terrain rolls a natural 20, gain 2 Benediction per rank.

hierophant.name: Omen of Protection
hierophant.description: Passive: Allies affected by your Benediction buffs have resistance to the next damage source that hits them per rank.

hierophant.name: Benediction Overflow
hierophant.description: Passive: When Benediction is at max, each even d20 roll instead heals the nearest ally for 1d4 per rank.

hierophant.name: Divine Conduit
hierophant.description: Passive: Your Benediction cap increases by 5. All Benediction healing is increased by your Spirit modifier per rank.

hierophant.name: Cosmic Ward
hierophant.description: Spend 8 Benediction to grant all allies within 30ft +4 Armor and immunity to frightened for 5 rounds. +1 round per rank.

hierophant.name: Eternal Blessing
hierophant.description: Passive: Your Benediction generation from natural 20s is tripled instead of doubled. Blessed terrain healing increases by 1d8 per rank.

hierophant.name: Hierophant Supreme
hierophant.description: Passive: All even d20 rolls within 60ft generate triple Benediction. Allies in your presence gain +2 to all rolls. Activated: Spend 15 Benediction to create 60ft sacred zone for 1 minute — allies gain +3 to all rolls, resistance to all damage, immunity to frightened/charmed, heal 2d8/turn.

requiem.name: Death Precision
requiem.description: Passive: Prophesied outcomes on single-target spells deal +50% damage per rank.

requiem.name: Narrow Focus
requiem.description: Passive: When prophecy range has 2 or fewer values, gain +1 to resolution roll per rank.

requiem.name: Havoc from Death
requiem.description: When a target affected by your prophecy is reduced to 0 HP, gain +2 Havoc per rank.

requiem.name: Quick Prophecy
requiem.description: Your first prophecy each combat costs 2 less mana per rank.

requiem.name: Mark of Doom
requiem.description: Spend 2 Havoc to mark a target—your next prophecy against them auto-resolves as at least Base (no Outside). +1 use per rank.

requiem.name: Death Echo
requiem.description: When a prophecy deals Prophesied damage, the target takes 1d8 bonus necrotic per rank at the start of next turn.

requiem.name: Hunter's Instinct
requiem.description: Passive: You can sense targets below 30% HP. Prophecies against them gain +2 to resolution roll per rank.

requiem.name: Prophecy Mastery
requiem.description: Passive: Your narrow-range prophecies (d4+d4) deal additional damage equal to your level per rank.

requiem.name: Double Mark
requiem.description: Passive: You can have 2 Death Marks active simultaneously per rank.

requiem.name: Doom Savant
requiem.description: Passive: Havoc cost of single-target prophecy spells reduced by 2. Prophesied damage increased by your Spirit modifier per rank.

requiem.name: Unstoppable Doom
requiem.description: Passive: Targets affected by your prophecies cannot be healed above 50% HP per rank.

requiem.name: Executioner
requiem.description: Passive: When you reduce a target to 0 HP with a Prophesied prophecy, refund the Havoc cost.

requiem.name: Requiem Supreme
requiem.description: Passive: All single-target Prophesied effects deal maximum damage. Activated: Spend 15 Havoc to place a prophecy that requires no range roll—target takes 20d12 necrotic damage. If below 25% HP, reduced to 0.

endbringer.name: Escalation
endbringer.description: Passive: Every round a delayed prophecy ticks, its damage increases by +1d6 per rank.

endbringer.name: Doom Aura
endbringer.description: Passive: Enemies within 15ft have -1 to all rolls per 3 Havoc you hold (max -3) per rank.

endbringer.name: Havoc Accumen
endbringer.description: Passive: Your Havoc maximum increases by 3 per rank.

endbringer.name: Delayed Payoff
endbringer.description: Passive: Delayed prophecies generate +1 bonus Havoc per round they remain active per rank.

endbringer.name: Consuming Doom
endbringer.description: Passive: When a delayed prophecy detonates, all enemies within 10ft of the target take half the damage per rank.

endbringer.name: Aura Expansion
endbringer.description: Spend 3 Havoc to expand doom aura to 30ft and increase penalty by -1 per rank. Lasts 3 rounds.

endbringer.name: Escalating Havoc
endbringer.description: Passive: Every round of combat past round 1, gain +1 Havoc per rank (passive generation).

endbringer.name: Doom Resonance
endbringer.description: Passive: When you have 10+ Havoc, all prophecy resolution rolls gain +2 per rank.

endbringer.name: Accumulated Power
endbringer.description: Passive: Detonation of delayed prophecies deals +2d8 damage per round the prophecy was active per rank.

endbringer.name: Crescendo
endbringer.description: Passive: After round 5 of combat, all your prophecies auto-Prophesize on the first resolution roll per round.

endbringer.name: Unstoppable Escalation
endbringer.description: Passive: Your delayed prophecies cannot be dispelled or removed early. They always run their full duration.

endbringer.name: Overwhelming Doom
endbringer.description: Passive: Your doom aura penalty cap increases to -8. Enemies at -5 or worse are also frightened.

endbringer.name: Endbringer Supreme
endbringer.description: Passive: All delayed prophecies deal double damage on detonation. Doom aura is always active (no concentration). Activated: Spend 15 Havoc to trigger ALL active prophecies simultaneously with maximized Prophesied effects.

cataclysm.name: Area Mastery
cataclysm.description: Passive: All prophecy areas increase by 5ft radius per rank. Earn +1 Havoc per target hit in area prophecies.

cataclysm.name: Multi-Prophecy
cataclysm.description: Passive: You can have +1 simultaneous area prophecy active per rank (base 1, max 3 with 2 ranks).

cataclysm.name: Overlapping Doom
cataclysm.description: Passive: When two of your area prophecies overlap, the overlapping zone deals double damage per rank.

cataclysm.name: Scattered Prophecy
cataclysm.description: Passive: Area prophecies that hit 3+ targets generate +1 bonus Havoc per rank.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm Table
cataclysm.description: Spend 3 Havoc to roll on an enhanced d8 table for area effects (fire/necrotic/psychic/force/stun/prone/slow/heal reversal). +1 table option per rank.

cataclysm.name: Chain Reaction
cataclysm.description: Passive: When a Prophesied area prophecy hits, 1 target per rank triggers a secondary 1d8 explosion affecting adjacent creatures.

cataclysm.name: Terrain Scorch
cataclysm.description: Passive: Your area prophecies leave behind difficult terrain for 3 rounds per rank. Enemies in terrain take 1d4 fire/round.

cataclysm.name: Convergence
cataclysm.description: Passive: When you detonate 2+ area prophecies in the same round, all resolution rolls gain +2 per rank.

cataclysm.name: Blast Amplification
cataclysm.description: Passive: Prophesied area effects deal +1d8 damage per 3 Havoc you currently hold per rank.

cataclysm.name: Devastation
cataclysm.description: Passive: Your area prophecy dice are upgraded: d6→d8, d8→d10, d10→d12. Area size +10ft.

cataclysm.name: Simultaneous Doom
cataclysm.description: Passive: When 3+ area prophecies are active, you gain +3 Havoc per round passively.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm Core
cataclysm.description: Passive: All area prophecy damage ignores 5 resistance. Critical hits in your zones generate double Havoc.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm Supreme
cataclysm.description: Passive: All area prophecies auto-Prophesize on the first target. Earn Havoc equal to number of targets hit. Activated: Spend 15 Havoc to create a 60ft zone for 3 rounds where ALL dice rolls are subject to your prophecy range—every d20 result triggers table effects.
